title: Accountant
description:
Job description - One Accounting 
 
 Job Summary: 
The Senior Accountant at our Accounting firm is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, preparing financial statements, and ensuring compliance with accounting standards and regulations. This role requires a keen understanding of accounting principles, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support the financial health of the firm and its clients.
 
 Responsibilities: 
 
 Bookkeeping and General Ledger: 
 Record day-to-day financial transactions and ensure the accuracy of the general ledger for our clients. Maintain organized and up-to-date accounting records. 
 Financial Reporting: 
 Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with accounting standards. Generate financial reports for management and clients, as required. 
 Tax Compliance: 
 Assist in the preparation of tax returns and ensure compliance with local and national tax regulations. Stay informed about changes in tax laws that may impact the firm or its clients. 
 Payroll: 
 Assist in running the payroll in a timely manner Generate payroll reports and correspondence with clients regarding their payroll. 
 Accounts Payable and Receivable: 
 Manage the accounts payable process, including vendor invoices and payments. Monitor accounts receivable, follow up on outstanding invoices, and ensure timely collections. 
 Bank Reconciliation: 
 Reconcile bank statements and other financial accounts on a monthly basis for the clients. Investigate and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner. 
 Adhoc duties : 
 Support the Management with adhoc duties like sending email responses to clients on various matters, preparation of once off reports as requested by clients, preparation of internal reports for the Management as requested. 
 Audit Support: 
 Assist in the preparation for internal audits and reviews. Provide necessary documentation and support during audit processes. 
 Client Interaction: 
 Work closely with clients to gather financial information and address queries, if required to do so. 
 Software Utilization: 
 Utilize accounting software and other financial tools efficiently. Stay updated on advancements in accounting technology. 
 Compliance and Regulations: 
 Ensure adherence to accounting principles, standards, and regulatory requirements. Keep abreast of changes in accounting regulations and communicate their impact. 
 HST/GST (Goods and Services Tax): 
 Manage end-to-end HST/GST compliance, including filing returns and maintaining necessary documentation. Stay updated on HST law changes and communicate their impact on the organization. Assist in HST audits and assessments. 
 Annual Return Filing: 
 Prepare and file annual returns as required by applicable laws. Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data for annual return filing. 
 Reconciliation: 
 Conduct periodic reconciliations of financial transactions, including bank statements, vendor accounts, customer accounts or any other GL accounts as necessary. Investigate and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner. 
 Qualifications: 
 Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Professional certification such as CPA (Certified Public Accountant) or CA (Chartered Accountant) is preferred. Proficiency in accounting software such as Quickbooks, Xero, Zoho books and Microsoft Excel. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of Indian/ Canadian tax laws. 
This job description is a general overview of the accountant position within a CA firm and may be subject to modification based on the firm's evolving needs.

Key Skills: Payroll,Bank Reconciliation Statement,Taxation,Accounts Receivable,Accounts Payable,Financial Reporting,Compliance,audit

title: Senior Manager, Technical Accounting
description:
Job Summary Glean is seeking a Senior Manager, Technical Accounting to lead complex accounting analysis, policy implementation, and controls across finance processes and systems. This role combines strong technical accounting judgment with hands-on execution: assessing new and complex transactions, documenting accounting conclusions, translating requirements into scalable processes, and implementing effective controls across the accounting environment. The successful candidate will partner closely with Accounting, Finance Systems, Revenue, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Sales Operations, Procurement, auditors, consultants, and business leaders. This role is well suited to a technically strong accounting leader who can move from accounting conclusion to operational implementation and sustainment. You will Lead technical accounting assessments and prepare clear, well-supported accounting memos under US GAAP and, where relevant, IFRS. Advise on revenue recognition, COGS, commissions, equity and stock-based compensation, investments, financial statements, leases, intercompany transactions, and other complex accounting matters. Evaluate new products, contracts, commercial arrangements, investments, and business initiatives for accounting and reporting implications. Maintain and improve accounting policies, position papers, documentation standards, and technical accounting playbooks. Partner with external auditors and advisors to resolve technical accounting questions and align on conclusions. Translate accounting conclusions into practical requirements for close procedures, reconciliations, reporting, systems configuration, and control activities. Partner with external consultants to develop and implement process narratives, risk and control matrices (RACMs), control documentation, and testing procedures. Lead India IFC readiness, including walkthroughs, risk assessment, control-owner alignment, testing support, deficiency evaluation, and remediation. Strengthen business-process and system controls across key accounting areas, working with Finance Systems and IT to embed approvals, access controls, data validations, segregation of duties, and exception reporting. Establish sustainable control ownership, monitoring, evidence retention, remediation tracking, and reporting to Finance leadership, using automation and AI where appropriate and auditable. Define and execute a phased roadmap for building an in-house Internal Audit and Controls function while retaining consultants for specialist and independent support. Serve as a trusted accounting advisor to senior Finance and cross-functional leaders, driving alignment when priorities or interpretations differ. Establish clear governance, decision rights, operating rhythms, and accountability for technical accounting and controls initiatives. Coach and develop team members, raising the quality of accounting analysis, documentation, control ownership, and execution. Communicate risks, decisions, dependencies, and recommendations succinctly to Finance leadership. About you Chartered Accountant, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification. Typically 8-12+ years of progressive experience in technical accounting, controllership, financial reporting, internal controls, or audit, preferably in a high-growth technology or SaaS environment. Strong working knowledge of US GAAP; practical exposure to IFRS and multi-entity accounting is preferred. Big 4 experience is preferred. Experience supporting SOX readiness, IFC, ICFR, or controls-based audits. Experience implementing controls in a multi-entity, multi-system environment. Experience with accounting policy implementation following new products, acquisitions, investments, or significant commercial changes. Practical experience evaluating AI-enabled finance workflows and establishing human-in-the-loop controls. Strong technical accounting judgment, written communication, stakeholder-management, prioritization, and execution skills. Ability to translate accounting conclusions into scalable, practical, and auditable operational processes. Location This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

 Experience: 2 to 7+ Years
 Location: Hyderabad

 Job Summary: 
 We are looking for Accountants with 2 to 7+ years of relevant accounting experience , preferably with experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Consulting . 
 As an Executive in the Accounts department, your primary responsibility will be to manage financial transactions, maintain accurate financial records, support financial reporting, handle payroll and accounting activities, and ensure compliance with applicable financial and statutory requirements. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial transactions, general accounting, payroll processing, taxation, and India & US statutory compliance. 
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
 General Accounting & Financial Transactions: Handle day-to-day accounting activities and financial transactions. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records. Apply accounting principles correctly while recording financial transactions. Maintain the general ledger and ensure all entries are accurate and timely. Reconcile accounts and identify and resolve discrepancies or errors. Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities. 
 Financial Reporting: Prepare and analyze Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, Cash Flow Statements , and other financial reports. Generate weekly/monthly MIS and financial reports for management. Provide accurate financial information to support management decision-making. Assist with financial analysis and reporting requirements. 
 Accounts Payable: Process vendor invoices and ensure accuracy and timely payments. Maintain accurate vendor records and payment details. Track vendor payments and outstanding amounts. Coordinate with internal departments to resolve invoice discrepancies and payment issues. 
 Accounts Receivable: Manage customer/client invoicing and billing. Track accounts receivable and outstanding payments. Follow up on overdue payments and support timely collections. Maintain accurate customer/client account records. Track consultant billing, pay rates, bill rates, expenses, and margins. 
 US IT Staffing Accounting: Handle accounting activities related to US IT Staffing and IT Consulting operations . Work with consultant, client, and vendor financial transactions. Understand and support C2C, W2, and 1099 consultant billing/payroll processes. Verify consultant timesheets, billing details, pay rates, and invoices. Track consultant payroll, billing, expenses, and margins. Coordinate with US-based teams regarding billing, payroll, payments, and accounting matters. 
 Payroll Processing: Collaborate with the HR/Payroll team to process payroll accurately and on time. Verify employee and consultant payroll information. Ensure proper deductions and tax withholdings are accounted for. Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documents. Ensure payroll-related activities are completed within timelines. 
 Indian Statutory Compliance & Taxation: Handle general accounting activities related to Indian statutory compliance. Support TDS calculations, deductions, payments, and TDS returns . Ensure proper recording and documentation of TDS-related transactions. Assist with taxation-related accounting and compliance activities. Maintain required statutory records and documents. Coordinate with internal teams and external professionals for statutory compliance requirements. 
 Budgeting & Forecasting: Assist in preparing and monitoring the company's budget. Support financial forecasting and variance analysis. Compare actual financial results against budgets and identify variances. Highlight areas of concern and opportunities for cost improvement. 
 Financial Analysis: Analyze revenue, expenses, profitability, and staffing-related financial data. Identify trends, opportunities, and areas for cost reduction or revenue improvement. Provide relevant financial insights to management. 
 Compliance & Audit: Ensure accounting activities follow applicable accounting principles, financial regulations, and internal controls. Maintain proper financial documentation and records. Assist with internal and external audits. Provide required financial information and supporting documents during audits. 
 Financial Software & Systems: Use accounting software and financial systems to maintain financial data and generate reports. Work with tools such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Zoho Books, Tally , or similar accounting software. Use MS Excel for accounting, reconciliation, reporting, and financial analysis. Stay updated with relevant software enhancements and accounting best practices. 
 Communication & Coordination: Coordinate with Finance, HR, Payroll, Operations, Recruiting, Bench Sales, and Management teams. Communicate with clients, vendors, consultants, and US-based teams regarding financial matters. Provide timely financial information and support business decisions. Maintain good organizational skills and ensure accounting activities are completed within deadlines. 
 Required Skills: 2 to 7+ years of relevant accounting experience. Experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Consulting is preferred. Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial transactions . Experience with payroll processing, India & US statutory compliance, taxation, and general accounting . Knowledge of TDS calculations, deductions, payments, and returns . Good knowledge of MS Excel . Experience with AP, AR, invoicing, billing, payments, and reconciliation. Knowledge of consultant billing/payroll is an advantage. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good communication and organizational skills. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work with US-based teams and in US business hours . 
 Preferred Candidate Profile: Candidates with experience in the following industries will be preferred: US IT Staffing US IT Consulting IT Staffing & Recruitment IT Services US Payroll Staffing & Consulting 
 Important: Candidates without prior US IT Staffing / US Staffing accounting experience may not be considered.

The incumbent partners closely with Tax, Treasury, Operations and Procurement to safeguard cash flow, protect margins on travel bookings, and support timely period-end close. Key RESPONSIBILITIES Accounts Payable & Invoice Operations Oversee end-to-end processing of vendor bills, purchase orders and travel service invoices, ensuring 3-way match, correct GL coding and cost-centre allocation. Execute timely payment runs via NEFT, RTGS, wire transfers and corporate credit cards, and maintain payment calendars for critical suppliers (airlines, hotel chains, DMCs). Manage travel agent commissions, refunds, chargebacks and B2B vendor ledger entries; ensure accurate accrual of unbilled costs at period end Administer employee expense reimbursements and corporate card settlements in line with policy Statutory Compliance Ensure timely and accurate TDS deduction, deposit and quarterly return filings, including issuance of Form 16A to vendors. Ensure correct GST treatment on vendor invoices; perform monthly reconciliation of Input Tax Credit against GSTR-2B and follow up with vendors on mismatches. Coordinate TCS and foreign-remittance compliance for overseas supplier payments, working with the Tax Assistant and under the review of the Senior Finance Manager. Support advance tax workings, tax audit schedules and any inquiries from tax authorities relating to AP transactions. Vendor Management & Reconciliations Perform monthly and quarterly vendor account reconciliations and drive clearance of outstanding and aging balances. title: IT Operations - Manager
description:
Were proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work , a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well-being and growth. At Tarento, you ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. 
 
 Job Description - IT Operations / IT Manager 
 Location: Bangalore| Experience: 10+ years |Team: 5-8 IT professionals | User base: ~500-person IT organization 
 About the Role We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive IT Operations Lead / IT Manager to lead and optimize the technology environment supporting a 500-person IT organization. The role combines strategic IT leadership with hands-on operational ownership across infrastructure, IT service management, end-user computing, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, compliance, vendor management, automation, and technology governance. The successful candidate will lead a team of 5-8 IT professionals, ensure stable and secure day-to-day operations, and drive continuous improvement, automation, cost optimization, and exceptional service delivery. 
 1. IT Operations, Service Management & Service Delivery Lead day-to-day IT operations, ensuring availability, performance, reliability, resilience, and security of infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, cloud services, and end-user technology. Own IT Service Management processes covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management through the IT ticketing platform. Establish, govern, and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, ticket ageing, response/resolution targets, and user satisfaction. Act as the escalation point for critical and major incidents; coordinate troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident reviews. Drive continuous service improvement aligned with ITIL best practices and business priorities. Develop monthly SLA and operational reports covering Internet uptime, service uptime, ticket volumes, ageing, resolution performance, and recurring issues. Maintain a strong customer-service culture and provide empathetic, professional support to internal users. 2. Team Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of 5-8 IT support and infrastructure professionals. Assign work, establish priorities, monitor performance, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of IT issues. Define objectives, KPIs, development plans, knowledge-sharing practices, and operational ownership across the team. Foster a collaborative, supportive, accountable, and continuous-improvement-oriented culture. Coordinate cross-functional teams during major incidents, audits, projects, technology changes, and transformation initiatives. 3. IT Infrastructure, Network & End-User Computing Oversee enterprise infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, virtualization, wireless, firewalls, cloud environments, and end-user devices. Ensure high availability and reliability of critical IT systems and services. Manage wireless access points, hardware firewalls, switches, network equipment, Internet circuits, and associated vendor services. Manage the complete lifecycle of laptops, desktops, mobiles, peripherals, and accessories from procurement and provisioning through refresh and secure disposal. Own user onboarding, role changes, access provisioning, offboarding, asset recovery, and access-card coordination with HR. Perform monthly Internet bandwidth and capacity checks and recommend upgrades based on usage and business demand. Maintain disk-capacity and infrastructure-health reports and proactively address capacity risks. 4. Cloud Management & Cost Optimization Manage and optimize cloud resources across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where applicable. Support cloud services and customer-facing workloads hosted on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Monitor availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational health of cloud resources. Track monthly cloud bills, analyze consumption trends, forecast spend, and drive FinOps-style cost optimization. Define cloud adoption standards and ensure appropriate governance, tagging, access controls, backup, and lifecycle management. Balance on-premises and cloud workloads to optimize performance, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership. 5. Software, License, Patch & Configuration Management Manage Microsoft 365/O365 licenses and project-specific software licenses, including allocation, renewal, usage, and cost optimization. Oversee software deployment, application inventory, endpoint configuration, and patch management using tools such as ManageEngine Desktop Central/Endpoint Central. Implement and govern automated OS patching for employee workstations and servers. Maintain accurate software and hardware inventories and ensure appropriate licensing compliance. Track software renewals, support contracts, certificates, and technology lifecycle milestones. 6. DevOps, Git & CI/CD Operations Provide operational leadership and governance for DevOps tooling and practices. Manage and support Git, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps environments as applicable. Perform periodic Git/GitLab access reviews and ensure least-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties. Support CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment reliability, and operational stability in collaboration with development and DevOps teams. Lead infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management practices using Terraform and Ansible where applicable. Support containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. 7. Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance Define and implement IT security policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls. Act as the IT/security escalation point and support enterprise security governance and risk management. Conduct vulnerability checks and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities. Manage endpoint protection and antivirus/EDR platforms such as Cortex and ensure security agents remain healthy and current. Oversee identity and access management, privileged access, access reviews, endpoint security, network security, and incident response. Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and support ISO 27001 certification and audit requirements. Participate in quarterly audits, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and management reviews. Coordinate cybersecurity incidents, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned. 8. Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy & Governance Define and govern enterprise IT architecture standards, technology reference models, and infrastructure principles. Establish vendor evaluation frameworks and technology selection criteria. Define cloud adoption policies, technology lifecycle standards, and application rationalization roadmaps aligned with business strategy. Partner with C-suite and executive leadership to translate business objectives into technology roadmaps and investment priorities. Present IT performance metrics, risk posture, cybersecurity status, governance outcomes, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, automation, AIOps, and cloud platforms, and assess their operational and business value. 9. AI, AIOps & Automation Lead adoption of AIOps capabilities such as ML-based event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and automated first-line remediation. Drive AI-powered ITSM capabilities including intelligent ticket classification, AI-driven routing, NLP-based resolution recommendations, and predictive SLA-breach alerts. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT operations, support processes, monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities. Architect and manage infrastructure for AI workloads, including on-premises GPU platforms and cost-optimized cloud AI services where appropriate. Measure operational improvements from AI and automation initiatives, including reduced downtime, faster MTTR, and lower operating cost. 10. Proactive Maintenance, Upgrades & Business Continuity Plan and execute quarterly firmware upgrades for wireless access points and network equipment. Implement and maintain automated OS patching and upgrade cycles for end-user systems and servers. Perform planned server OS upgrades and maintain application/platform upgrade schedules. Perform quarterly GitLab version upgrades with appropriate validation, backup, rollback, and change-management controls. Maintain backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience plans for critical services. Use monitoring and capacity data to identify and resolve issues before they impact users or customers. 11. Monitoring, Reporting & Operational Governance Develop and maintain monthly IT dashboards covering service uptime, Internet uptime, network bandwidth, patch compliance, license renewals, ticket performance, disk usage, cloud spend, and security posture. Produce monthly SLA and KPI reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders. Maintain operational dashboards and trend analysis to identify recurring incidents, capacity risks, cost anomalies, and improvement opportunities. Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset records, service ownership information, escalation matrices, and operational runbooks. Maintain and share access-card server details with HR in accordance with access governance procedures. 12. Procurement, Vendor & Contract Management Own procurement of IT hardware, software, licenses, accessories, network equipment, and technology services. Manage vendor, MSP, telecom, cloud, and technology-partner relationships. Define and monitor vendor SLAs, KPIs, contracts, renewals, service quality, and operational performance. Lead vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations, renewals, and corrective actions in collaboration with procurement and leadership. Ensure third-party services meet requirements for availability, security, compliance, performance, and cost. 13. IT Budget & Financial Management Own IT CapEx and OpEx planning, forecasting, budget tracking, and financial reporting. Manage cloud spend forecasting and optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Optimize software licensing, infrastructure, telecom, support, and vendor costs without compromising service quality or security. Present technology investment proposals and cost-benefit analysis to leadership. 14. Client & Stakeholder Interaction Participate in client calls and technical discussions as required. Provide service status, operational updates, logs, evidence, and technical information to clients in coordination with relevant teams. Translate technical issues into clear business impact, resolution status, risk, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders. Build strong relationships with business leaders, customers, vendors, and internal technology teams. Preferred Qualifications & Certifications ITIL 4 certification. ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor; CISSP or CISM is advantageous. AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud certifications. CompTIA or other infrastructure/security certifications. TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification. PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent project-management certification. Terraform, Kubernetes, or DevOps-related certifications. Key Competencies IT Operations Leadership Infrastructure & Network Management Cloud & FinOps IT Service Management & ITIL Cybersecurity & Compliance DevOps & Automation AI/AIOps & Intelligent IT Operations Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy Vendor & Contract Management Budget & Cost Management Problem-Solving & Incident Management Customer Service & Empathy Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management Proactive Approach & Continuous Improvement Team Leadership & People Development Key Performance Indicators IT infrastructure and service availability / uptime. SLA compliance, ticket resolution time, backlog, and user satisfaction. Major incident frequency, MTTR, recurrence, and root-cause closure. Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance. Cloud spend against budget and measurable cost optimization. Software/license compliance and renewal management. Vendor/MSP performance against contractual SLAs. Audit findings, security compliance, and ISO 27001/ISMS performance. Change success rate and change-related incidents. Automation/AIOps adoption and measurable reduction in downtime and operational effort. Successful delivery of infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle activities, and technology roadmaps. Role Impact The IT Manager / IT Operations Lead is accountable for building a stable, secure, scalable, cost-effective, and business-aligned IT environment. The role combines strong operational discipline with strategic technology leadership, proactive service improvement, automation, cybersecurity governance, cloud optimization, and people leadership. The successful candidate will help transform IT into a highly reliable, measurable, customer-focused, and continuously improving technology function.

title: Manager, Finance Operations
description:
Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: Description: Footer Overall Purpose of The Job The Manager, Finance Operations oversees the day-to-day financial transaction cycle of Aspire Lifestyles India u2014 booking settlements, vendor payables, receivables, refunds, agent commissions, payment gateway operations, and the associated reconciliations. The role owns the operational close for the transaction cycle, ensures alignment of financial operations with corporate goals, safeguards controls and compliance, and partners with Operations, Sales, Technology and the wider Finance team (Reporting, Tax, Treasury) to enable accurate, timely and well-controlled financial outcomes. The role leads a team of Reconciliation Specialists and is a key contributor to process automation and continuous improvement across the Finance Operations function. Key RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end booking-to-settlement cycle: airline Billing and Settlement Plan reconciliations, GDS feeds, hotel and DMC payouts, aggregator settlements and traveller refunds. Oversee high-volume accounts payable and accounts receivable operations, ensuring accurate matching against booking inventories and supplier statements before release. Manage global agent commissions, incentive payouts and B2B ledger positions; ensure timely and accurate settlement in line with contractual terms. Oversee payment gateway operations, including reconciliation and monitoring of Pass-through and Merchant of Record transactions, chargebacks and gateway fees. Own the month-end and year-end close for the Finance Operations sub-ledgers (AP, AR, gateway, agent commissions), including accruals, provisions and reconciliations to the general ledger. Prepare and review unit-level and product-level profitability analyses for leadership; explain movements, margins and variances against plan. Deliver operational MIS, payment forecasts, aging analyses, settlement dashboards, gateway performance to the Head of Finance and business leadership. Coordinate closely with the Manager, Financial Reporting and the Tax function to ensure timely statutory reporting, tax compliance and consolidation inputs Design, operate and continuously improve internal controls over the transaction cycle (segregation of duties, approval matrices, exception reviews, reconciliation signoffs). Ensure compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), company policies and Standard Operating Procedures across the operations team. Support GST, TDS and other statutory workings for AP/AR transactions in coordination with the Tax function; oversee resolution of GSTR-2B mismatches with vendors. Serve as the primary Finance Operations interface for internal, statutory and tax auditors; own timely closure of audit observations. Monitor and forecast cash outflows and inflows arising from the transaction cycle; partner with Treasury on funding requirements and FX exposures on cross-border settlements. Optimise working capital through disciplined payment runs, refund cycles, dispute resolution and receivables collection. Drive automation and simplification across the transaction cycle (invoice capture, reconciliation, workflow approvals, payment file generation, gateway reconciliation Standardise SOPs and drive measurable improvement in turnaround time, accuracy and control effectiveness Lead, develop and mentor a team of Reconciliation Specialists responsible for BSP, GDS, gateway, vendor and agent-commission reconciliations across the transaction cycle Key Metrics / Success Measures Timely and accurate operational close: sub-ledger close completed within 4-5 business days of month-end with zero material post-close adjustments. Payment discipline: on-time payment rate of [u2265 98%] and DPO within targeted range. BSP, gateway and agent-commission reconciliations completed monthly with all breaks investigated and cleared within the following month. Zero missed statutory due dates for AP/AR-related tax filings; clean statutory, internal and tax audits with no significant Finance Operations observations. Accurate and timely unit-level profitability reporting to leadership within agreed cadence. Job Profile Requirements 9 to 12 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance operations, including at least 3 years leading a team. Prior experience in the travel, hospitality or aviation sector strongly preferred, ideally with exposure to BSP settlements, GDS environments, DMC/aggregator payouts and payment gateway operations Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO); comfort with finance systems integrations and reconciliation tools. Advanced MS Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query); familiarity with BI tools (Power BI / Tableau) an advantage. Sound knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Indian tax laws (GST, TDS, withholding on cross-border payments). Understanding of payment gateway mechanics, Pass-through vs Merchant of Record models, and card scheme / chargeback processes. Strong leadership presence with the ability to lead cross-functional and cross-regional teams. Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills; able to engage confidently with leadership and external partners. Analytical and problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail. Sound judgment in applying policy and controls while resolving exceptions pragmatically. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and ethics. Effective under time pressure and shifting priorities; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across close, audit and business cycles. Qualifications Bachelors degree in accounting/finance or equivalent experience. Chartered Accountant (Mandatory). Required Languages: Good spoken and written English language skills Travel Requirements: Not applicable / minimal.

title: Manager Workforce Management - Dialer
description:
Position Summary The Operations Dialer Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, monitoring, and continuous optimization of outbound and inbound dialing strategies supporting first-party credit card collections. This role serves as a key liaison between Collections Operations, Workforce Management, Analytics/MIS, Compliance, Technology, clients, and third-party vendors, ensuring that account inventory, staffing, contact strategies, dialer capabilities, and business objectives are aligned to maximize collections performance while maintaining operational and regulatory compliance. The Operations Dialer Manager is expected to act as a subject matter expert in dialer strategy and collections operations, capable of representing the organization in discussions with clients, technology providers, telecommunications vendors, and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate has strong experience in first-party credit card collections, understands delinquency-stage strategies and customer segmentation, and has hands-on knowledge of the LiveVox contact center and dialer platform. --- Key Responsibilities Dialer Strategy & Management Develop and execute daily, weekly, and monthly dialing strategies for first-party credit card collection portfolios. Configure and manage LiveVox campaigns, services, skill groups, dialing modes, account segmentation, and contact strategies. Determine appropriate dialing treatments based on delinquency stage, account risk, customer behavior, historical contactability, payment likelihood, and operational priorities. Optimize predictive, automated, manual, and agent-initiated dialing strategies based on portfolio requirements. Manage account penetration and attempt strategies to balance contact rates, collections performance, customer experience, and regulatory requirements. Evaluate campaign performance throughout the day and make real-time adjustments based on staffing, account inventory, penetration, contact rates, and collection results. Coordinate campaign reruns, prioritization strategies, and reassignment of account inventory when necessary. Identify opportunities to improve contact efficiency while reducing unnecessary or low-value dialing activity. --- Collections Operations Support collection strategies across various stages of delinquency, including early-stage, mid-stage, and late-stage credit card collections. Demonstrate working knowledge of key collections concepts, including: o Days Past Due and delinquency buckets o First Payment Default o Promise to Pay o Right Party Contact o Payment conversion o Account penetration o Customer contactability o Risk segmentation o Roll rates and forward flow Partner with Operations leadership to translate portfolio and client objectives into actionable dialer strategies. Identify opportunities to increase successful customer contacts and payment conversions without unnecessarily increasing dialing volume. Evaluate account inventory, staffing, agent utilization, and strategy performance to determine whether performance gaps are driven by manpower, account quality, contactability, dialer strategy, or operational execution. Provide recommendations to Operations leaders regarding staffing allocation, campaign priorities, account treatment, and contact strategy. --- Client, Vendor & Stakeholder Management Serve as a primary point of contact and dialer subject matter expert during discussions with clients, Operations leaders, technology teams, and third-party vendors. Participate in client meetings, business reviews, strategy sessions, and performance discussions related to collections and dialer performance. Present dialer performance, trends, strategy results, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Translate complex dialer and operational data into clear business insights appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences. Work directly with clients to understand portfolio objectives, performance expectations, strategy requirements, and operational priorities. Partner with Operations stakeholders to ensure dialer strategies support frontline execution and overall collections objectives. Coordinate with vendors supporting: o Dialer and contact center technology o Telecommunications services o Branded Caller ID o Caller authentication o Phone intelligence and contactability o Data and analytics solutions Manage vendor-related issues, enhancement requests, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation activities. Evaluate proposed vendor solutions and new technologies based on operational value, cost, expected performance improvement, and implementation requirements. Coordinate testing and validation of new vendor features or dialer capabilities prior to production deployment. Escalate vendor performance, system, or service issues when necessary and track issues through resolution. Maintain productive relationships with clients and vendors while balancing operational requirements, technical limitations, compliance considerations, and business objectives. Support client inquiries and investigations involving dialer behavior, contact strategies, campaign configurations, or performance results. --- Performance Management & Analytics Monitor and analyze dialer and collections KPIs, including: o Attempts o Live Voice / Connect Rate o Right Party Contact Rate o RPC per Attempt o Promise to Pay Rate o Payment / Collection Rate o Contact-to-Payment Conversion o Accounts Worked o Penetration Rate o Average Handle Time o Talk Time o Wrap Time o Agent Occupancy o Idle / Ready Time o Abandonment Rate o Answering Machine Detection performance Perform trend, segmentation, and comparative analysis to identify opportunities for campaign optimization. Evaluate performance by delinquency segment, risk level, account population, time of day, agent group, site, and dialing strategy. Develop or support forecasting models for dialing volume, staffing requirements, contact rates, and expected collection outcomes. Conduct root-cause analysis when operational or client performance targets are missed. Develop clear recommendations and action plans based on analytical findings. Prepare performance summaries, dashboards, and executive-level presentations for internal leadership and clients. --- LiveVox Administration & Optimization Maintain strong working knowledge of LiveVox functionality, including: o Campaign and service configuration o Dialing strategies o Skill groups o Contact lists o Agent routing o Predictive dialing o Answering Machine Detection o Call disposition and result codes o Caller ID and branded calling solutions o Campaign pacing o Contact attempt controls o Reporting and Call Detail Records Troubleshoot campaign and dialing issues in coordination with Technology teams, LiveVox support, and other external vendors. Validate dialer configuration changes before implementation. Monitor system behavior to identify potential inefficiencies, routing issues, pacing concerns, or unusual contact patterns. Coordinate with LiveVox and other technology partners on platform enhancements, defects, upgrades, and new functionality. Support User Acceptance Testing and production validation for changes affecting dialer operations. --- Compliance & Risk Management Ensure dialing strategies comply with applicable company policies and regulatory requirements governing consumer communications and collections. Partner with Compliance, Legal, clients, and technology teams when implementing changes that may affect dialing frequency, calling windows, customer consent, contact treatment, or caller identification. Maintain appropriate controls around account attempts, contact frequency, time zones, phone number treatments, and calling hours. Monitor dialing activity for potential compliance risks and escalate concerns when necessary. Support audits and investigations involving dialer activity, customer contact attempts, and campaign configurations. Ensure changes requested by Operations, clients, or vendors are evaluated for potential compliance and customer-experience impact prior to implementation. --- Cross-Functional Leadership Serve as the primary dialer strategy partner for Operations leadership. Collaborate closely with: o Collections Operations o Client Leadership o Workforce Management o Business Analytics / MIS o Quality Assurance o Compliance o Information Technology o Telecommunications teams o LiveVox and other technology vendors Coordinate staffing and dialer capacity to ensure available agents are effectively utilized. Communicate strategy changes, campaign priorities, and performance expectations to Operations teams. Facilitate discussions between technical and operational stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions are practical and aligned with business objectives. Participate in performance reviews, client business reviews, strategy meetings, project discussions, and executive presentations. Influence stakeholders across multiple departments even when direct reporting relationships do not exist. --- Continuous Improvement Conduct controlled tests of new dialing strategies, account segmentation approaches, contact frequencies, campaign schedules, and dialing technologies. Measure pre- and post-implementation results to determine strategy effectiveness. Develop business cases for new dialer capabilities, vendor solutions, or process improvements. Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting. Develop repeatable processes, dashboards, and decision frameworks for dialer management. Partner with clients and vendors to identify emerging opportunities to improve customer contactability and collection performance. Stay informed about emerging technologies affecting collections, including: o AI call screening o Branded Caller ID o Caller authentication o Predictive analytics o Customer contact optimization o Alternative communication channels o Phone intelligence and contactability solutions --- Required Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Analytics, or related field preferred. Minimum 3-5 years of experience in credit card collections, consumer finance, or contact center operations. Experience supporting or managing first-party credit card collections strongly preferred. Hands-on experience with LiveVox or a comparable predictive dialer/contact center platform. Experience interacting directly with clients, external vendors, and Operations stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to lead strategy and performance discussions with both internal and external business partners. Strong understanding of credit card delinquency and collections processes. Experience developing or managing outbound dialing strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel. Experience interpreting large operational datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations. Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and business requirements to technical teams. --- Preferred Qualifications Experience managing multiple collection segments or delinquency buckets. Experience with SQL and Snowflake or similar data warehouse platforms. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools. Knowledge of Workforce Management concepts including staffing, occupancy, shrinkage, and interval-level capacity planning. Experience with automated reporting and campaign performance dashboards. Experience working with multiple contact center locations or outsourced operations. Experience participating in client-facing business reviews and operational strategy meetings. Experience managing technology or telecommunications vendor relationships. Knowledge of branded caller identification, STIR/SHAKEN, call authentication, and telecommunications concepts. Familiarity with predictive analytics, customer segmentation, and payment likelihood models. Experience conducting vendor evaluations, pilots, testing, and implementation projects. --- Core Competencies Strategic Thinking Translates collections and client objectives into practical account and dialing strategies. Client & Stakeholder Management Builds credibility with clients, Operations leaders, technical teams, and vendors while effectively balancing competing priorities. Vendor Management Works effectively with external technology and service providers to resolve issues, evaluate solutions, and implement improvements. Analytical Decision-Making Uses data to identify performance gaps, opportunities, and appropriate corrective actions. Operational Leadership Understands the relationship between staffing, agent behavior, account inventory, technology, and collection performance. Technical Dialer Knowledge Comfortable working directly with LiveVox configurations, campaign performance, troubleshooting, and call-level data. Collections Expertise Understands the customer lifecycle, delinquency progression, contact strategies, and payment behavior within first-party credit card collections. Compliance Awareness Maintains strong controls around customer communication practices and dialing activity. Communication & Influence Able to clearly explain technical and analytical findings to frontline Operations, clients, vendors, and executive audiences. --- Key Performance Indicators Success in this role may be measured through: Improvement in Right Party Contact Rate Payment / Collection conversion Promise to Pay performance Account penetration Contact efficiency per dialing attempt Agent occupancy and utilization Dialer capacity utilization Reduction of unnecessary or unproductive attempts Achievement of portfolio and client collection targets Compliance with dialing and customer-contact requirements Effectiveness of strategy tests and continuous improvement initiatives Timely resolution of dialer and vendor-related issues Successful implementation of client and vendor initiatives Quality and effectiveness of stakeholder communication and recommendations --- Position Objective The Operations Dialer Manager is expected to ensure that the right accounts are contacted, through the right strategy, at the right time, with the appropriate level of effort and available staffing, while effectively representing the organization s dialer strategy with internal Operations stakeholders, clients, and technology partners. The role continuously balances five priorities: Collections Performance | Contact Efficiency | Agent Utilization | Compliance | Client & Stakeholder Alignment

title: Senior Manager - Data & Analytics
description:
The Role We are looking for a hands-on leader to own the data, analytics, and AI portfolio end to end - and the team that builds it. You are the single point of accountability between business stakeholders and the analytics organization: gathering and pressure-testing requirements, turning ambiguous problems into a prioritized roadmap, and leading the developers, analysts, and data scientists who deliver scalable, trusted, widely adopted products. This is not a role that manages from a distance. You will be in the requirements sessions, the data model reviews, the SQL, the dashboard design critiques, and the model evaluations - and you will be measured on adoption and business outcomes, not backlog size or model sophistication. What You'll Do Team Leadership & Talent: Lead the team. Manage a talented team of senior and junior developers, analysts, and data scientists - setting direction on best practices, engineering standards, and alignment with team priorities. Develop people. Mentor team members, connecting their personal and professional goals to real career growth; set the standard for rigor and craft. Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements: Be the trusted partner. Serve as the primary interface to the different organizations and run structured discovery to elicit underlying needs, not feature requests. Write requirements that hold up. Translate business questions into testable specs: source systems, grain, metric definitions, SLAs, quality thresholds, and acceptance criteria. Drive a single source of truth for core metrics and arbitrate definitional conflicts. Simplify the complex. Navigate ambiguous, politically loaded problems and distill them into actionable messaging that aligns with business priorities and lands with executives. Prioritization. Roadmap & Datamart Strategy: Own the roadmap. Manage, prioritize, and align data, reporting, and analytics requirements with business needs, overseeing development and implementation. Make trade-offs explicit. Apply a consistent prioritization framework - value, reach, effort, risk, strategic fit - and communicate the rationale transparently, including to stakeholders you deprioritize. Shape strategy at the table. Play a key role in cross-functional committees defining data mart strategy, governance, and policy; invest ahead of demand in capabilities that make future requests cheaper to serve. Visualization & Experience Design: Design for the decision. Set the standard for how analytics is presented - choose the right visual for the question, build a clear hierarchy, and design every dashboard around the decision the user is trying to make rather than the data that happens to be available. Own the design system. Define and enforce visualization standards across the portfolio - chart conventions, color, typography, layout, naming, interaction patterns, and accessibility - so products look and behave consistently and stay maintainable as the team grows. Prototype, test, and prune. Wireframe and iterate with real users before building; validate with usage data and feedback, and retire dashboards that dont drive action. Technical Leadership: Warehouse, BI & Pipelines: Lead technically. Hands-on in advanced SQL on Snowflake, with the credibility to review the teams work rather than take it on faith. Design for scale. Oversee scalable pipelines and workflows that process large, diverse, unstructured datasets with high performance and reliability; automate cleaning, integration, and analysis in SQL and Python. Enable self-service. Champion governed datasets, semantic layers, and intuitive dashboards that let non-technical users answer their own questions - over one-off extracts and bespoke reports. Optimize what exists. Drive innovation in data architecture, dashboard performance, and cost efficiency; champion data quality and accuracy through lineage, testing, and clear ownership. Data Science, AI & Machine Learning: Set the AI agenda. Identify, size, and prioritize the use cases where ML and generative AI create real business value - and say no to the ones that dont. Deliver GenAI experiences. Build generative AI into the analytics stack - natural-language querying, conversational BI, automated insight generation, AI-assisted documentation and discovery. Adoption, Measurement & Communication: Measure what matters. Define success metrics for every product - adoption, time-to-insight, data freshness, decisions enabled, cost - and hold the team accountable to them. Drive adoption and clarity. Lead enablement through documentation, training, and change management; present insights, risks, and trade-offs to audiences from individual engineers to the executive staff. We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bengaluru office in compliance with Everpures policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave. What You Bring Experience & Leadership: 15+ years in analytics, business intelligence, data science, or data platform roles, including 4+ years directly managing teams. An advanced degree in statistics, data science, or computer science preferred. Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise data, BI, or analytics portfolio from requirements through production adoption, with evidence of business impact - plus a track record of solving complex problems and using data to influence senior stakeholders. Domain expertise in one or more of: finance, customer, or product. Experience with CRM and ERP datasets strongly preferred. Technical Depth: Advanced SQL - able to write, review, optimize, and debug complex analytical queries independently; deep experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse. Knowledge of Python, including package development and production-quality code standards. Hands-on with enterprise BI and semantic layer tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, ThoughtSpot) and what makes them perform at scale; working knowledge of governance, lineage, observability, and access control. Visualization & Design: Strong data visualization craft - fluent in chart selection, visual hierarchy, and the principles that separate a clear view from a cluttered one. Able to take a dense, ambiguous dataset and present it so an executive understands it in seconds. Genuine design sensibility: layout, whitespace, typography, purposeful color, and accessibility (including colorblind-safe palettes). A portfolio of dashboards or reports you designed is welcome. Experience establishing visualization standards or a design system across a BI portfolio, and comfort wireframing and iterating with users. Familiarity with UX principles and design tools such as Figma is a plus. Business & Communication Skill: Sophisticated stakeholder management: build consensus across functions, hold a position under pressure, and say no without damaging the relationship. Connect data and AI investments to business outcomes and articulate ROI in the language of the function being served. Excellent written and verbal communication - equally capable of a one-page decision memo and an executive presentation.

title: Logistic Assistant
description:
Role & responsibilities We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Logistics Assistant to support our UAE operations from our Chennai office. The role will primarily focus on logistics documentation, shipment coordination, data management, and communication with the UAE-based logistics and operations teams . 
 The successful candidate will ensure that all logistics and shipment-related documentation is prepared accurately and on time, while maintaining proper records and providing timely administrative support to the UAE operations. Key Responsibilities Prepare, verify, and maintain logistics and shipment-related documentation for UAE operations. Coordinate with UAE-based logistics, warehouse, sales, and operations teams for documentation requirements. Prepare and maintain commercial invoices, packing lists, delivery documents, shipping documents, certificates, and other logistics paperwork . Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping agents, transporters, suppliers, and customers as required. Track shipment documentation and ensure all required documents are available before shipment and delivery. Maintain proper digital and physical filing of logistics records and documents. Update shipment and logistics information in ERP/HRMS/Logistics systems or relevant databases . Follow up on shipment status, delivery documentation, and pending documents with relevant stakeholders. Assist in preparing logistics reports, shipment summaries, and document trackers. Ensure accuracy of customer, supplier, product, quantity, and shipment information in all documentation. Support the UAE team with document retrieval, data entry, reporting, and other logistics-related administrative activities. Coordinate with internal departments to resolve documentation discrepancies or missing information. Ensure documents are handled confidentially and maintained in accordance with company procedures. Provide general administrative and coordination support to the UAE logistics function. 
 Preferred candidate profile Good knowledge of logistics and shipping documentation . Strong documentation and data-entry skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Outlook, and other MS Office applications . ERP/Logistics software knowledge will be an advantage. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to communicate effectively with teams in India and the UAE. Good written and spoken English. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Strong organizational and record-management skills. Ability to work independently while coordinating with a remote UAE team. 
 Preferred Qualifications & Experience 
 Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field . 1 to 3 years of experience in logistics documentation, shipping coordination, supply chain administration, or a similar role. Experience handling documentation for international shipments/import-export will be preferred. Experience supporting GCC/UAE operations will be an added advantage. Candidates with experience in the chemical distribution, trading, or industrial products sector will be preferred. 
 Important Note This position will be based in the Chennai office and will support the UAE region remotely . The role will involve regular coordination with UAE-based colleagues, customers, suppliers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners. The candidate should therefore be comfortable working according to UAE business requirements and timelines .

title: Senior Manager - Systrack
description:
Overview This role sits within PepsiCos global IT Operations team and focuses on transforming the way IT incidents and service requests are handled through intelligent automation and self-healing. The Self-Healing and Service Desk Automation Specialist plays a key role in designing, developing, and deploying automated solutionsprimarily using SysTrack Selfhealto proactively detect and resolve issues before they impact users. Youll work closely with service desk teams, infrastructure engineers, and digital workplace specialists to identify automation opportunities, build playbooks, and continuously enhance system performance and user experience. Beyond technical delivery, the role emphasizes data-driven decision-making, agile collaboration, and end-user experience improvement. In essence, this role is about bridging IT operations and automation engineeringturning reactive support into proactive, self-healing systems that reduce tickets, improve MTTR, and enhance digital experience across the enterprise. Responsibilities Be a part of a global engineering team responsible for designing, developing, and deploying self-healing and automation solutions. Design and implement automated solutions using SysTrack Selfheal to resolve IT incidents and service requests efficiently. Drive improvements in the Digital Employee Experience (DEX) score through targeted automation and self-healing use cases. Collaborate closely with the End-User Computing (EUC) and Global Workspace Services (GWS) teams to ensure the proper implementation of permanent fixes (solves) derived from Problem Management to address root causes impacting DEX. Develop and maintain playbooks for self-healing actions, ensuring accuracy and effectiveness. Integrate SysTrack Selfheal with existing IT infrastructure and monitoring tools. Analyse incident and service request data to identify opportunities for automation. Collaborate with the Service Desk team to identify and prioritize automation initiatives. Continuously monitor and improve the performance of self-healing automation. Provide technical support to the Service Desk team on SysTrack Selfheal functionalities. Stay up to date on the latest advancements in SysTrack Selfheal, automation best practices, and other relevant ITSM/ITOM tools. Agile software development practices for customizations to the platform and applications. Implement ITSM modules, workflow customization, ticketing process automation, report development, dashboard creation, and system configurations. Deliver a high level of knowledge and customer service within the ITSM Suite. Organize and prioritize development efforts, interface with vendors and management, and potentially coordinate the efforts of additional administrators. Consider dependencies, relationships, and integration points to ensure proper solution integration with other systems when applicable. Effectively manage and execute high-level tasks assigned via user stories. Qualifications Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Total 11+ years of experience in IT Operations/Service Management/Service Desk /End User Computing arena: 5+ years of working knowledge of Selfheal or Digital Experience (DEX) monitoring tools, like Systrack, Nexthink, Riverbed, Aptean, etc. 8+ years of experience in IT Process Automation using tools like UiPath, Automation Anywhere, etc. 5+ Years of experience working on the ServiceNow Platform (ITSM, Process Mining, etc.) 10+ years of ITIL experience, certified ITIL v3 Expert/Intermediate or ITIL 4 Practitioner. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Must have very strong storytelling and MS PowerPoint skills. Understanding of Agile ways of working Scrum ceremonies. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to concisely express complex issues/solutions.

title: Regulatory Manager
description:
Role Summary Reporting to the Regional Regulatory Head, the Regulatory Manager, India & Middle East is responsible for defining and implementing regulatory strategies that enable compliant, timely and sustainable business growth across India and Middle East markets. The role serves as the primary regulatory business partner and regulatory voice for the IME organization. It influences portfolio, innovation, market-entry, product-classification and launch decisions by translating complex regulatory requirements into clear business options, risk assessments and actionable recommendations. The Regulatory Manager oversees a large and diverse product portfolio, balancing the operational demands of high-volume categories, particularly cosmetics, with the technical complexity and higher regulatory risk associated with OTC products, medical devices, dietary supplements, household products and electrical products. This position works closely with Commercial, Marketing, R&D, Quality, Legal, Supply Chain, Product Development and Global Regulatory Affairs to establish priorities, resolve regulatory barriers and balance compliance, business value, resource requirements and speed to market. It also leads interactions with distributors, consultants, agencies and, where appropriate, regulatory authorities. Success in this role requires a combination of regulatory leadership, sound technical judgment, portfolio management, execution discipline, cultural awareness and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority. Strategy and Functional Expertise Develops and implements regulatory strategies that support compliant and sustainable business growth across India and the Middle East. Provides regulatory feasibility assessments for new products, market expansion, product classifications, claims and portfolio changes. Balances regulatory compliance, business risk and speed to market, particularly across cosmetics, OTC products, medical devices, dietary supplements, household products and electrical products. Translates complex regulatory requirements into clear business options and actionable recommendations. Applies sound regulatory judgment in ambiguous situations and identifies when technical or senior-level escalation is required. Monitors regulatory developments and assesses their potential impact on products, launches and business continuity. Maintains accurate regulatory documentation, performance metrics and management reporting. Promotes standardized, risk-based and efficient regulatory processes for a high-volume, multicategory portfolio. Leadership and Influence Acts as the regulatory voice and trusted business partner for India and Middle East leadership. Influences senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without relying on direct authority. Leads discussions involving regulatory risk, portfolio priorities, market entry, product classification and speed-to-market decisions. Provides clear direction, removes obstacles and holds the regulatory team and stakeholders accountable for agreed deliverables. Develops team capability through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing and stretch assignments. Builds effective relationships across Commercial, Marketing, R&D, Quality, Legal, Supply Chain, Product Development and Global Regulatory Affairs. Communicates complex issues clearly and persuasively, adapting the message to technical and nontechnical audiences. Demonstrates openness, curiosity and a willingness to listen to different perspectives, challenge assumptions and learn from local-market expertise. Promotes collaboration, inclusion and trust across organizational, geographic and cultural boundaries. Program Development / Project Management Leads regulatory programs and projects from strategy through implementation, ensuring clear scope, priorities, ownership and timelines. Manages multiple registrations, renewals, amendments, launches and regulatory-change initiatives simultaneously. Prioritizes projects according to regulatory risk, business impact, urgency and resource requirements. Monitors project progress, performance, deadlines, dependencies and spending. Anticipates regulatory barriers and coordinates timely actions to resolve issues. Works cross-functionally to identify market and distributor requirements and convert them into executable plans. Establishes practical governance, metrics and reporting to support timely decisions and stakeholder visibility. Manages consultants, agencies and other external partners, ensuring quality, confidentiality, accountability and effective use of resources. Identifies opportunities to simplify processes, reduce rework and improve regulatory productivity. Impact / Reach Supports a diverse, high-volume portfolio across India and multiple Middle East markets. Influences strategic and operational decisions involving regulated products, market access, launches and business continuity. Operates across country, regional and global teams, connecting local regulatory requirements with broader business priorities. Builds strong internal and external partnerships with business leaders, distributors, consultants, agencies and regulatory authorities. Demonstrates agility and cultural awareness when working across different markets, regulatory systems and business practices. Works openly and effectively in multicultural environments, respecting local perspectives while maintaining global standards. Creates clarity and alignment in complex situations where regulatory, commercial, technical and supply considerations may compete. Adjusts communication style, content and approach to meet the needs of different cultures, functions and levels of seniority. Education and Experience University degree from an accredited institution in pharmacy, chemistry, life sciences, engineering, regulatory affairs or another relevant technical field. Significant progressive experience in Regulatory Affairs within consumer health, consumer products or another multicategory regulated environment. Demonstrated experience supporting India, Middle East, GCC markets or similarly complex and diverse regulatory environments. Broad regulatory knowledge across at least two relevant categories, such as cosmetics, OTC medicines, medical devices, dietary supplements, household products, consumer products or electrical products. Experience managing high-volume portfolios and technically complex or ambiguous regulatory matters. Previous supervisory, people-management or team-lead experience. Experience working with distributors, consultants, agencies and regulatory authorities. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages relevant to India and Middle East are advantageous. Experience working successfully with geographically dispersed and multicultural teams. Skills and Competencies Strong strategic thinking, regulatory judgment and business acumen. Results-oriented, action-oriented and accountable for delivery. Ability to make timely, high-quality decisions with incomplete or changing information. Excellent prioritization and portfolio-management capabilities. Strong project and program-management skills. Excellent verbal, written, presentation and negotiation skills. Ability to explain complex regulatory matters clearly, concisely and persuasively. Strong influencing and stakeholder-management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Open-minded, curious and willing to explore alternative regulatory pathways and solutions. Comfortable asking questions, seeking different perspectives and constructively challenging established approaches. Culturally aware, adaptable and genuinely open to working with diverse teams, markets and ways of doing business. Strong collaboration, relationship-building and conflict-resolution skills. High attention to detail, organization, accuracy and confidentiality. Resilient and effective in complex, ambiguous and rapidly changing environments. Committed to continuous learning, process improvement and practical innovation.
