title: Delivery Manager
description:
Anchanto | Job Description PBU Delivery & Agile Operations Manager - OMS Location: Pune, India | Reports to: Product Business Unit Head | Experience: 6+ Years | Type: Full time, Work from Office About the Role Anchanto is a global enterprise-grade B2B SaaS company. We provide cloud software for brands, retailers, and logistics providers to manage orders, inventory, marketplaces, fulfilment, parcel tracking, and omnichannel commerce. As Anchanto evolves toward integrated Product Business Units (PBUs), we need a leader who can run the delivery operating system of a business unit. This role combines multi-pod Scrum leadership, program delivery, resource and capacity planning, financial visibility, operational governance, and PBU administration. This is not a ceremony-only Scrum Master role. The person is expected to independently create structure, maintain a single view of all commitments, challenge unrealistic plans, hold senior stakeholders accountable, and ensure work gets delivered with speed, predictability, and quality. The role requires a strong presence with Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Customer Delivery, Support, and the PBU Head. Why This Role Exists The PBU model brings Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Implementation, and Support closer together around a single product outcome. To make this model work, the PBU needs one owner for delivery rhythm, portfolio visibility, resource loading, risk management, operational discipline, and leadership reporting. This role exists to ensure that the PBU does not depend on fragmented trackers, informal follow-ups, or late escalations. What You Will Own The role owns nine areas. The expectation across all of them is the same: strong ownership, data over opinion, early visibility of risk, clear accountability, and reliable execution. Multi-pod Scrum and Agile delivery management Manage approximately 6 to 10 active Scrum teams or delivery pods in parallel, with the ability to scale the operating cadence as the PBU grows. Ensure effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily Scrum, reviews, retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums without creating unnecessary ceremony. Ensure every pod has a clear sprint goal, ready backlog, acceptance criteria, realistic capacity plan, visible dependencies, and agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Monitor and improve commitment reliability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, scope churn, spillover, defect leakage, escaped defects, and release predictability. Improve velocity and flow sustainably without compromising quality or using story points as an individual productivity measure. Coach teams toward self-organisation while holding teams and leaders accountable for agreed process and delivery standards. Identify recurring blockers, late requirements, delayed QA, weak Jira hygiene, and process failures, and drive root-cause corrective action. Integrated delivery and portfolio planning Maintain one consolidated delivery plan across product roadmap, customer projects and customisations, technical debt, innovation, compliance, production incidents, and L3 support. Translate PBU priorities into executable milestones, pod plans, owners, dependencies, and resource requirements. Maintain visibility of planned versus actual progress, delivery confidence, critical path, scope changes, customer commitments, and roadmap displacement. Ensure customer-specific work does not silently displace roadmap commitments without an explicit business decision. Classify work as reusable product capability, hybrid product/customer work, or customer-specific customisation to support the right product and commercial decision. Support quarterly planning, monthly operating reviews, and major reprioritisation decisions with clear options and impacts. Maintain decision logs for material scope, priority, resource, budget, and date changes. Resource loading and capacity management Maintain a current capacity and allocation view across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Design, Implementation, and Support. Identify overload, underutilisation, shared-resource conflicts, skill bottlenecks, and single points of failure before they affect delivery. Recommend pod composition based on work requirements, available skills, and delivery risk. Present practical trade-off options when capacity is insufficient, including scope reduction, phased delivery, resequencing, date revision, temporary reallocation, hiring, or contracting. Prevent teams from accepting commitments without validated scope, dependencies, and confirmed capacity. Track planned versus actual utilisation and explain material variance. Delivery accountability and stakeholder leadership Act as the operating owner for PBU delivery and ensure commitments are converted into clear plans, owners, dates, and closure. Hold Product Managers, Engineering Managers, QA Leads, Architects, and other stakeholders accountable for agreed actions and standards. Conduct difficult delivery conversations when scope, dates, quality, resource availability, or process discipline are at risk. Challenge unrealistic commitments, incomplete requirements, unsupported dates, and unapproved customer promises with facts and alternatives. Escalate unresolved issues to Engineering Heads, the PBU Head, or leadership with impact, options, recommendation, and decision required. Maintain a visible and credible presence across the PBU; this role must not operate as a passive coordinator or status chaser. Financial and commercial governance Work with Finance and PBU leadership to track planned versus actual effort, budget consumption, forecast to complete, vendor or contractor cost, rework, and support cost. Maintain operational cost visibility for major roadmap initiatives and customer projects. Support customer-project margin and cost-to-value discussions by providing reliable delivery, effort, and forecast data. Identify material variance early and recommend corrective action. Ensure scope changes are reflected in effort, schedule, resource, and commercial discussions. Distinguish clearly between effort, cost, budget, billing, revenue, and margin. Formal accounting remains with Finance; this role owns the reliability of delivery inputs. Quality, release, and production governance Create and maintain PBU-level release-readiness criteria covering functional completion, regression, integration, security, performance, open defects, rollback, monitoring, and support readiness. Facilitate go/no-go discussions and provide a clear delivery recommendation based on risk and evidence. Track defect leakage, production incidents, rework, release failures, and recurring root causes. Ensure RCAs have clear owners, corrective actions, due dates, and verified closure. Include L3 support and production incidents in capacity plans so support demand is visible rather than treated as an unplanned interruption. Ensure delivery speed does not compromise quality, security, customer experience, or compliance. PBU administration and team operations Coordinate smooth onboarding for new PBU members, including access, tools, product orientation, process induction, stakeholder introductions, role clarity, and required training. Coordinate employee exits with HR, IT, Security, Finance, and functional managers, including access revocation, knowledge transfer, work reassignment, asset return, and documentation handover. Maintain the PBU roster, role map, allocation view, onboarding status, and critical knowledge coverage. Identify skill gaps and coordinate training, coaching, hiring, or external support. Ensure critical knowledge and delivery responsibility are not concentrated with one individual. Compliance and operational controls Track PBU obligations related to ISO, GDPR, information security, data retention, customer audits, internal controls, and market or regulatory requirements. Coordinate with Security, Legal, Compliance, Product, and Engineering owners to ensure actions and evidence are completed on time. Maintain compliance actions, evidence, owners, and due dates, and escalate overdue or high-risk items. Ensure compliance work is included in delivery plans and resource allocations rather than managed outside the operating plan. Support audit preparation and closure of observations for the PBU. Leadership reporting, systems, and continuous improvement Create a concise weekly PBU operating report covering delivery health, milestones, confidence, capacity, roadmap versus customer work, quality, production health, cost or effort variance, risks, recovery actions, and decisions required. Run weekly delivery reviews, cross-pod dependency reviews, release-readiness reviews, monthly leadership reviews, and quarterly planning retrospectives. Ensure Jira, Confluence, portfolio views, RAID logs, decision logs, and dashboards operate as trusted systems of record. Automate reporting, Jira hygiene, risk detection, meeting summaries, dependency tracking, and readiness checks wherever practical. Use AI and automation responsibly to improve delivery speed, data accuracy, and management visibility. Measure whether process changes improve predictability, quality, flow, and team effectiveness; remove governance that does not create value. Cross-Functional Operating Model Partner Primary partnership area PBU Head PBU priorities, investment choices, portfolio trade-offs, budget, and final escalation decisions Product Management Roadmap, problem definition, business value, requirements readiness, and product-versus-custom decisions Engineering Managers / Engineering Head Technical execution, engineering capacity, architecture, quality practices, skill development, and people leadership QA, DevOps, Security, and Architecture Release readiness, test coverage, environments, production health, security, compliance, and technical dependencies Customer Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success Customer commitments, implementation milestones, scope changes, commercial assumptions, and escalation Finance Budget, cost rates, forecast, project financials, margin visibility, and reconciliation HR, IT, and Administration Onboarding, exits, access, assets, employee operations, and workforce records What Good Looks Like After 12 to 18 Months The PBU has one trusted, current view of all roadmap, customer, technical, compliance, and support commitments. Six to ten parallel pods operate with predictable delivery rhythm, clear dependencies, and strong quality discipline. Leadership receives concise, decision-ready visibility rather than manual status collection. Capacity conflicts, skill gaps, and delivery risks are identified early and resolved through explicit trade-offs. Customer commitments do not silently displace roadmap work. Quality, security, release readiness, and production health are integrated into delivery planning. Budget, effort, and cost variance are visible and used in priority and investment decisions. Onboarding, exits, access, compliance, and audit actions are completed reliably and on time. The PBU operates proactively and independently, with fewer escalations caused by unclear ownership or missing information. The delivery operating model improves continuously through automation, AI, and measurable process improvement. Skills and Experience 6+ years across software delivery, program management, project management, Agile delivery, product operations, or engineering operations. At least 5 years managing Agile software delivery teams, including demonstrated responsibility for multiple teams or workstreams in parallel. Experience managing at least 4 teams directly; experience with 6 or more parallel squads or pods is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience in integrated delivery planning, resource loading, capacity management, risk and dependency management, and release governance. Experience challenging senior stakeholders and influencing Product, Engineering, QA, and customer-facing teams without direct reporting authority. Working knowledge of budgeting, planned-versus-actual effort, forecast variance, vendor cost, and project financial health. Strong Jira, Confluence, dashboarding, and executive reporting capability. Good understanding of software development, APIs, environments, CI/CD, testing, production support, and release management. Ability to create structure where information, ownership, and processes are fragmented. Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to present clearly to Engineering Heads, PBU Heads, and senior leadership. Preferred Experience Enterprise SaaS, B2B software, e-commerce, supply chain, OMS, WMS, logistics, or fulfilment domain exposure. Experience with OMS, order orchestration, e-commerce, marketplace integrations, order lifecycle management, or omnichannel fulfilment is preferred. Experience with customer implementations, product customisation, and roadmap-versus-customer trade-offs. Experience managing 30 or more people across virtual or cross-functional pods. Experience with L3 support, production incidents, RCAs, and operational service levels. Exposure to ISO, GDPR, SOC 2, information security, or customer audit controls. Experience using Power BI, Jira Plans, Advanced Roadmaps, Aha!, or other portfolio-management tools. Experience with AI-enabled delivery, workflow automation, or reporting automation. CSM, PSM, SAFe, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification. Leadership Behaviours We Expect Managers at Anchanto are expected to operate with high ownership, solve problems rather than escalate confusion, use systems and data over opinions, communicate clearly and directly, challenge constructively, build trust through reliability, improve processes continuously, collaborate without bureaucracy, and act with urgency and accountability. What This Role Is Not A ceremony-only Scrum Master role. A Jira administrator or meeting coordinator. A passive follow-up or status-chasing role. A PMO reporting role that presents problems without recommendations. A substitute Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Finance partner, or Compliance specialist. A role that accepts every stakeholder commitment without validating scope, capacity, quality, and commercial impact. Success Measures Indicative KPI What it measures Multi-pod delivery predictability Commitment reliability, milestone adherence, and delivery confidence across parallel pods Delivery flow Cycle time, lead time, throughput, ageing work, and spillover trends Quality and release health Defect leakage, escaped defects, release failures, production incidents, and RCA closure Capacity effectiveness Resource conflicts, overload, underutilisation, single points of failure, and planned-versus-actual allocation Portfolio visibility Accuracy and completeness of the integrated PBU plan and decision log Customer commitment governance Customer work accepted with validated feasibility and no hidden roadmap displacement Financial visibility Planned-versus-actual effort, cost variance, forecast accuracy, and project financial inputs Risk and dependency management Critical risks identified early, owned, and closed within agreed timelines PBU administration Onboarding, access, exit, knowledge transfer, and roster accuracy against SLA Compliance readiness ISO, GDPR, security, audit, and regulatory actions closed on time with evidence Leadership reporting Accuracy, timeliness, clarity, and decision usefulness of weekly and monthly PBU reports Automation and improvement Reduction in manual reporting and measurable improvement from AI or workflow automation Closing At Anchanto, faster delivery must come with stronger ownership, better quality, and clearer business visibility. This role builds and runs the operating system that enables a Product Business Unit to deliver as one accountable team. If you are comfortable managing multiple delivery pods, making difficult trade-offs, challenging senior stakeholders, and creating structure in a fast-moving environment, this is an opportunity to shape how Anchanto scales its product delivery model.

title: Fleet Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FLEET MANAGER Company: Prashar Road Carriers Pvt. Ltd.
 Industry: Transportation and Logistics
 Department: Fleet Operations
 Reporting To: Head of Department / Director
 Location: Delhi NCR
 Employment Type: Full-Time About the Company Prashar Road Carriers Pvt. Ltd. is an established logistics company operating since 1993. The company provides Full Truck Load, Part Truck Load, local transportation, warehousing, air, rail and express cargo services across India. Job Summary The Fleet Manager will be responsible for the profitable, safe and efficient operation of the company’s owned commercial vehicles. The role includes vehicle planning, driver management, route monitoring, maintenance control, fuel management, documentation, trip profitability and daily reporting. The Fleet Manager will be personally accountable for ensuring maximum vehicle utilisation, minimum operating cost, timely deliveries and strict control over drivers, fuel, repairs, advances and vehicle documents. Key Responsibilities 1. Vehicle Planning and Utilisation Plan and deploy every vehicle to achieve maximum monthly running and revenue. Coordinate with the Traffic, Commercial, Marketing and Operations teams for availability of profitable loads. Minimise vehicle idle time, empty running and unnecessary detention. Arrange suitable return loads before or immediately after delivery. Ensure vehicles are not dispatched on commercially unviable trips without written approval. Maintain a daily availability and placement plan for all vehicles. Prioritise profitable movement on approved routes, including Delhi NCR, Gujarat, Vapi and Mumbai sectors. 2. Driver Management Recruit, verify and manage qualified heavy-commercial-vehicle drivers. Verify driving licence, Aadhaar, address, police verification, references and previous employment before deployment. Conduct daily communication with every driver regarding location, vehicle condition, delivery status and next movement. Ensure drivers follow assigned routes, scheduled halts and company instructions. Monitor driver attendance, conduct, driving discipline and performance. Prevent unauthorised vehicle use, route deviation, overloading and carrying of unauthorised goods or passengers. Enforce zero tolerance for alcohol, drugs, theft, misbehaviour and unsafe driving. Arrange replacement drivers promptly to avoid vehicle idling. Recommend driver incentives or disciplinary action based on measurable performance. 3. Trip and Route Monitoring Monitor every vehicle through GPS, SIM-based tracking, toll records and direct driver communication. Ensure a tracking link is generated and shared for every dispatched vehicle. Track loading, departure, transit, arrival, unloading and POD collection. Immediately escalate delays, breakdowns, accidents, route deviations or customer-related issues. Ensure drivers complete the required daily running while complying with road-safety and mandatory-rest requirements. Maintain accurate estimated and actual delivery timelines. Coordinate with customers, branches and unloading locations for timely vehicle release. 4. Fuel and Mileage Control Record fuel issued and purchased vehicle-wise and trip-wise. Monitor mileage against the prescribed vehicle benchmark. Cross-check fuel consumption with kilometres travelled, GPS records, load weight and route conditions. Prevent fuel theft, false bills, unauthorised refuelling and excess consumption. Investigate every case of mileage below the approved benchmark. Maintain fuel-card, cash-fuel and diesel-advance records. Submit a weekly vehicle-wise mileage and fuel-variance report. 5. Maintenance and Breakdown Management Maintain preventive-maintenance schedules for every vehicle. Ensure timely servicing, lubrication, tyre inspection, brake inspection and replacement of essential parts. Conduct or arrange pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections. Maintain vehicle-wise repair and maintenance history. Obtain estimates and approval before undertaking major repairs. Verify repair bills, replaced parts and workshop work before payment approval. Keep breakdown time and repair expenses under strict control. Maintain relationships with reliable workshops, mechanics, tyre vendors and roadside-assistance providers. Ensure spare tyres, tools, safety equipment and essential emergency items are available in every vehicle. 6. Tyre Management Maintain a tyre register containing tyre number, make, purchase date, fitting date, vehicle position and kilometres covered. Monitor tyre rotation, alignment, air pressure, retreading and replacement. Investigate premature tyre failure and driver negligence. Control tyre inventory and disposal of scrap tyres. Submit a monthly tyre-cost and tyre-performance report. 7. Documentation and Legal Compliance Ensure that the following documents remain valid and available:
 Registration Certificate Fitness Certificate National and state permits Insurance Pollution Under Control Certificate Road tax FASTag Driver’s licence E-way bill and consignment documents Any other statutory transport documents Maintain a document-expiry calendar and initiate renewals well in advance. Ensure compliance with applicable transport, road-safety and motor-vehicle regulations. Maintain records of challans, accidents, insurance claims and legal matters. Prevent dispatch of any vehicle or driver with expired or incomplete documents. 8. Trip Expenses and Advance Control Prepare and approve trip-expense estimates according to route, distance, tolls, fuel and applicable allowances. Record all advances issued to drivers. Ensure that every driver submits bills and settles the previous trip advance before receiving a new advance, except with written approval. Verify tolls, fuel bills, repair bills, loading/unloading expenses and other trip expenses. Prevent duplicate, inflated, unsupported or unauthorised claims. Submit completed trip sheets and supporting documents to Accounts within the prescribed timeline. 9. Delivery and POD Control Ensure safe and timely delivery of every consignment. Instruct drivers to obtain a properly signed and stamped Proof of Delivery. Ensure PODs are collected and submitted within 15 days of delivery or within the customer’s prescribed timeline. Maintain a daily pending-POD report. Coordinate with drivers, branches and customers to recover pending PODs. Immediately report shortages, damages, remarks, refusal of delivery or detention. Hand over PODs and trip documents to the ERP/Billing team against acknowledgement. 10. Accident and Emergency Management Respond immediately to accidents, breakdowns, theft, cargo damage and other emergencies. Arrange police intimation, photographs, survey, towing, repairs and alternate vehicles wherever required. Inform management, the customer, insurer and concerned authorities without delay. Protect the cargo and prevent further loss after an incident. Maintain complete accident and insurance-claim documentation. Conduct an internal review and recommend preventive measures after every major incident. 11. Cost and Profitability Control Prepare a vehicle-wise and trip-wise profitability statement. Monitor the following costs:
 Fuel Driver salary and allowance Toll and route expenses Repairs and maintenance Tyres Insurance and permits Detention and penalties EMI and depreciation, where applicable Empty-running cost Compare expected revenue with the complete trip cost before deployment. Identify loss-making vehicles, routes, customers and operating practices. Recommend measures to improve fleet profitability and asset utilisation. Work with the Commercial Manager to determine minimum viable freight for each route. Mandatory Daily Report The Fleet Manager must submit a written daily report every evening containing: Vehicle number Driver name and contact number LR/GR number Customer name Origin and destination Loading date Current vehicle location Current trip status Expected delivery date Actual delivery status POD status Advance paid Fuel purchased Kilometres travelled Mileage achieved Freight revenue Trip expenses Vehicle availability Breakdown or maintenance status Next-load planning Issues requiring management attention Failure to submit the daily report without valid authorisation may be treated as failure to perform assigned duties and may affect attendance and performance evaluation. Key Performance Indicators Performance will be evaluated on: Vehicle utilisation percentage Loaded kilometres versus empty kilometres Monthly revenue per vehicle Trip-wise and vehicle-wise profitability Fuel efficiency and mileage variance On-time pickup and delivery percentage Average vehicle idle time Return-load arrangement Maintenance cost per kilometre Number and duration of breakdowns Tyre life and tyre cost per kilometre Driver retention and discipline Accident and challan frequency Timely settlement of driver advances Percentage of PODs received within 15 days Accuracy and punctuality of daily reports Compliance with documentation and renewal deadlines Required Qualifications and Experience Graduate or diploma holder; transport or automobile qualification preferred. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience managing commercial trucks or heavy vehicles. Practical knowledge of 12-wheel, 14/15-wheel and multi-axle vehicles is preferred. Strong understanding of diesel consumption, mileage, tyres, repairs, permits, tolls and trip expenses. Experience managing drivers and resolving on-road operational issues. Knowledge of major transport routes, especially Delhi NCR, Gujarat and Maharashtra. Comfortable using GPS systems, WhatsApp, email, Excel and transport ERP software. Ability to prepare daily MIS and vehicle-wise profitability reports. Willingness to remain available for urgent fleet matters outside normal working hours. Essential Skills Strong leadership and driver-handling ability High level of honesty and accountability Commercial and cost-control mindset Knowledge of vehicle maintenance Route and load-planning ability Negotiation and vendor-management skills Crisis-management capability Accurate documentation and reporting Basic Excel and ERP proficiency Clear written and verbal communication Behavioural Expectations The Fleet Manager must: Protect company vehicles, cargo, money and reputation. Maintain complete transparency in fuel, repairs, advances and vendor dealings. Never accept commissions or personal benefits from workshops, fuel stations, drivers or vendors. Avoid providing false vehicle locations, fabricated reports or incorrect expense information. Immediately disclose accidents, cargo damage, theft, breakdowns and financial irregularities. Maintain confidentiality of company rates, customers and operational information. Follow management instructions and cooperate with all departments. Any fraud, deliberate misreporting, fuel theft, unauthorised expense, document manipulation or concealment of material information may result in disciplinary action, including termination and recovery of losses as permitted by law. Compensation Salary will be based on experience, operational knowledge and interview performance. A performance-linked incentive may be offered against measurable improvements in fleet utilisation, mileage, cost control, POD compliance and profitability. Application Details Interested candidates may submit their CV along with details of: Current and expected salary Notice period Commercial fleet size previously managed Types of vehicles handled Routes managed Experience with GPS, ERP and fleet MIS References from previous employers Prashar Road Carriers Pvt. This role supports proposal, contract, and execution phases, ensuring schedule rigor, transparency, and alignment with business objectives. The position plays a key role in improving planning maturity, schedule quality, and delivery performance across projects and portfolios. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Engineering & Project Scheduling Develop, release, and maintain complex, integrated engineering project schedules using Primavera P6, ensuring alignment with scope, execution strategy, and contractual requirements. Execute project schedules for assigned Gas Power Business scopes (including Gas Turbine/Generator/Steam Turbine/HRSG and Balance of Plant engineering), ensuring schedule integrity throughout the project lifecycle. Convert proposal and tender schedules into fully integrated contract schedules, adjusting activity logic, durations, and sequencing based on finalized engineering scope. Prepare and manage Tender Time Schedules (TTS), Overall Time Schedules (OTS), Master Time Schedules (MTS), System Time Schedules (STS), and portfolio-level schedules as required. Proposal & Contract Support Partner with ITO and Proposal teams to define engineering support requirements, develop schedule assumptions, scope matrices, and delivery sequences. Participate in deviation and clarification meetings, supporting schedule alignment during proposal and contract finalization. Provide schedule inputs for contract negotiations and support preparation of contract documentation. description:
Job Summary Yashuss Unlimited, a premier provider of technology solutions and services, is seeking a highly adept Support Executive to deliver mission-critical assistance throughout the post-implementation lifecycle of enterprise applications.
 This role demands a fusion of technical acumen and client-centric expertise, focusing on diagnosing intricate system anomalies, optimizing application configurations, and facilitating seamless user adoption.
 The ideal candidate will leverage profound knowledge of cloud-based ecosystems to resolve technical impediments expeditiously, ensuring operational continuity and maximizing ROI for clients in dynamic business environments. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Post-Implementation Support:- 
 Deliver sustained technical sustenance to clients post-deployment, orchestrating system diagnostics to uphold optimal performance and mitigate disruptions in production environments.
 Execute root-cause analyses on configuration discrepancies, functional anomalies, and performance bottlenecks using structured troubleshooting methodologies.
 Impart expert counsel on application utilization paradigms, empowering clients to harness advanced features for enhanced productivity and strategic alignment.
 Technical Issue Resolution:- 
 Field and triage client escalations pertaining to application architecture, integration protocols, and operational workflows via multichannel support vectors.
 Employ robust ticketing frameworks to log, categorize, and prioritize incidents, adhering to SLA-driven resolution timelines and ITIL best practices.
 Remediate application-centric malfunctions through algorithmic debugging and, when requisite, orchestrate escalations to specialized engineering cohorts for intricate resolutions.
 User Assistance and Training:- 
 Facilitate resolution of access governance issues, parametric configurations, and process orchestration queries, ensuring compliance with security postures and data integrity standards.
 Curate and disseminate bespoke training artifacts, including interactive modules and knowledge repositories, to accelerate user proficiency in application ecosystems.
 Orchestrate virtual or on-premise training engagements, elucidating feature sets, API integrations, and customization capabilities to foster autonomous client operations.
 Documentation and Knowledge Base Management:- 
 Author comprehensive repositories of recurrent anomalies, resolution algorithms, and FAQs to fortify an enterprise-grade knowledge management system.
 Iteratively refine user documentation suites and diagnostic playbooks in response to emergent patterns or evolutionary application enhancements.
 Maintain immutable audit trails of support interactions, leveraging metadata for analytics-driven insights into service efficacy.
 Client Relationship Management:- 
 Sustain transparent, protocol-driven dialogues with stakeholders, provisioning real-time status telemetry on incident lifecycles to engender trust.
 Champion client delight via proactive outreach, sentiment analysis, and preemptive remediation strategies tailored to individual deployment profiles.
 Cultivate enduring partnerships by synthesizing client telemetry into actionable intelligence, reinforcing organizational loyalty and advocacy.
 Application Monitoring and Feedback:- 
 Institute vigilant oversight of post-deployment application metrics using monitoring tools to preemptively flag deviations and orchestrate corrective interventions.
 Aggregate and synthesize client feedback vectors on solution efficacy, distilling insights into enhancement roadmaps for iterative product evolution.
 Synergize with deployment architects to refine implementation blueprints, infusing support-derived heuristics to optimize future rollout cadences.
 Collaboration with Implementation and Development Teams:- 
 Interface seamlessly with cross-functional squads in implementation and R&D domains to streamline deployment pipelines and expedite fault isolation.
 Channel client-derived intelligence upstream, informing architectural refinements, feature augmentations, and patch deployments in agile development cycles. Requirements: 
 Education:- Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline; certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, or equivalent are advantageous.
 Experience:- 
 2-5 years in a support desk or client-facing IT service role, with demonstrable expertise in application lifecycle management and post-implementation sustenance.
 Proven track record in supporting cloud-native applications (e.g., Zoho Suite, CRM/ERP platforms like Salesforce or SAP), including integration troubleshooting and performance tuning.
 Technical Skills:- 
 Profound proficiency in diagnostic tools and methodologies for resolving issues in distributed systems, APIs, and database interactions.
 Mastery of ticketing and CRM systems (e.g., Zoho Desk, Zendesk, Freshdesk) for incident management and workflow automation.
 Familiarity with foundational business process modeling in domains such as CRM, sales automation, marketing orchestration, and ERP integrations.
 Competence in scripting basics (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation of routine diagnostics and report generation.
 Soft Skills:- 
 Exemplary communication prowess, adept at demystifying complex technical constructs for non-technical audiences while maintaining precision.
 Robust interpersonal acumen to navigate stakeholder dynamics and foster collaborative resolutions in high-stakes scenarios.
 Acute problem-solving aptitude, enabling efficient multitasking across concurrent support vectors in fast-evolving tech landscapes.
 Resilience and adaptability to thrive in a 24/7 support paradigm, with a commitment to continuous learning in emerging technologies.
 Preferred Qualifications:

 Experience with analytics tools for support metrics (e.g., integrating with BI platforms like Tableau or Power BI).
 Prior exposure to AI-assisted support tools for predictive issue detection and automated resolutions.

Immerse yourself in a culture of innovation, professional advancement, and collaborative excellence, supported by competitive remuneration, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities to influence the future of enterprise support.

title: Project Engr I
description:
Company Summary Honeywell International Inc. is a Fortune 100 industrial technology company that makes a variety of commercial and consumer solutions, engineering services and aerospace systems for a wide variety of customers, from private consumers to major corporations and governments. The company operates four business units, known as Strategic Business Units - Honeywell Aerospace, Honeywell Building Technologies (HBT), Safety and Productivity Solutions (SPS), and Honeywell Performance Materials and Technologies. HONEYWELL CONNECTED ENTerPRISE (HCE) We are building a smarter, safer and more sustainable world. That s the power of Connected. That s the power of Honeywell. Our company invents and manufactures technologies that address some of the most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, productivity and global urbanization. We are uniquely positioned to blend physical products with software to support connected systems that improve buildings, factories, utilities and aircraft and that enable a safer, more comfortable and more productive world. Our solutions enhance the quality of life of people around the globe and create new markets and even new industries. HONEYWELL CONNECTED INDUSTRIAL (HCI) Honeywell Connected Industrial (HCI) Line of business is a leading provider of software offerings in the Process Industry which includes Oil and Gas, Refining, Petrochemicals, Paper, MMM industry. These offerings drive measurable business results for customers. The business is focused on outcome-based software solutions and engineering services, converting data into actions for the customer which enables greater reliability, safety and uptime & profitability. These solutions uniquely combine domain expertise and industry proven technology. Global Engineering Services (GES) Global Engineering Services is the key largescale engineering, productivity, new growth initiative and process standardization enabler for HPS and outside HPS. With the largest skilled engineering pool available to PAS, LSS, HCP and Cyber and ready to expand to other GBEs, GES helps win GMPs and executes them, does design, engineer and execute all the other PAS, LSS, HCI and Cyber projects based out of major engineering centers at India, China, Bucharest and Uzbekistan, helps all the LOBs to carry out engineering and process standardization to improve the engineering quality and productivity and also supports all the LOBs in supporting migrations and long-term service contracts. THE OPPORTUNITY The Project Engineer I/Project Engineer II (APC/Optimization) will support the lead to implement Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer projects and assist in onsite user training as necessary. The candidate should have a very strong career interest in Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer work. YOU MUST HAVE Has a at least 10+ years of experience in refining/petrochemical, MMM industry. Has a background in Chemical Engineering principles and operations. Knowledge of regulatory control and advanced control. Understands optimization principles. Experience in implementing global optimization programs is advantages. Good communication and writing skills. Knowledge of Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer, DCS and real-time database technologies. Good team player. Strong ability to maintain good working relationship with customers. WE VALUE Demonstrated project experience implementing commercial off-the-shelf software for APC such as DMC3/DMC Plus, SMOC, PACE, ROMeo. Experience in deploying APC or maintenance management strategies in an operating company. Candidates having experience in plant operations. Experience in plant startup & commissioning Configuration experience working on control systems, DCS / PLC / Safety Systems. Advanced post graduate degree in a technical discipline. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The role will have a broad set of responsibilities encompassing the following: Execute Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer projects including assessment, kick-off, pre-test, plant test, design, modeling, configuration, installation, commissioning, and post-audit. Implement RMPCT Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer/Control Performance Monitor technologies as Lead Consultant/Engineer Perform/Participate in Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer studies, proof of concepts/trial evaluation and provide user training. Review the economic targets for the Advanced Process Controllers, suggest and incorporate necessary changes, to provide the right direction to the controllers. This may be required to incorporate the new economic indicators, if any, and make the controller to constantly work towards the current economic objectives. Identify, advise, and incorporate modifications to the controller configuration, in terms of proposing addition of new variables/ constraints, deletion of the redundant variables, wherever found necessary. Identify faulty regulatory control loops in the system (DCS level) and carryout tuning of existing regulatory controller at Distributed control systems. Lead cross function teams such as the Customer Support and R&D to resolve Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer issues. Support Sales and Marketing to grow Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer licenses and services business. Support and train junior personnel

title: Account Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced accounting professional to manage daily accounts, Tally entries, invoicing, banking, GST and TDS compliance, financial documentation and management reports. The candidate should independently maintain accurate books and coordinate with management and the companys Chartered Accountant. 
 Role & responsibilities 1. Accounting & Tally Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses and journal entries in Tally. Maintain ledgers, reconcile balances and ensure accurate supporting documents. Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, petty cash and expense reimbursements. Complete monthly closing entries, including provisions, accruals and depreciation. 2. Profit & Loss and Financial Reports Prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements, balance sheet schedules and cash-flow reports. Review income, expenses and margins; highlight unusual entries or cost increases. Prepare reports on outstanding payments, collections, sales, purchases and expenses. Submit accurate monthly MIS reports to management within agreed timelines. 3. GST & TDS Prepare GST workings, reconcile purchase records with GSTR-2B and coordinate return filing. Check GST details on sales and purchase invoices and maintain input tax credit records. Calculate applicable TDS, prepare payment workings and coordinate returns and certificates. Maintain compliance records and follow up with the CA on discrepancies and pending matters. 4. Banking & Payments Perform bank reconciliations and track receipts, payments and bank charges. Prepare vendor payment schedules and banking instructions for authorised approval. Maintain banking documents and coordinate routine queries with banks. Monitor cash and bank balances and report upcoming payment requirements. 5. Invoicing & Commercial Documents Prepare quotations, proforma invoices, sales invoices, credit notes and debit notes as required. Verify invoices against purchase orders, agreed prices, payment terms and delivery records. Prepare or coordinate e-invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans and supporting documents where applicable. Coordinate with sales, purchase and dispatch teams for accurate and timely billing. 6. Receivables, Payables & Documentation Follow up on customer payments and reconcile customer and vendor accounts. Maintain ageing reports and highlight overdue balances. Organise invoices, vouchers, purchase orders, bank records and statutory documents. Provide records and schedules for audits, assessments and CA reviews. Maintain confidentiality and follow company approval procedures. 
 Preferred candidate profile Strong practical knowledge of Tally Prime and MS Excel. Hands-on experience in GST, TDS, bank reconciliation and monthly accounts closing. Ability to prepare and explain P&L statements and accounting reports. Good attention to detail, communication and follow-up skills. Ability to manage deadlines and work independently. Experience in manufacturing, trading or export businesses is an advantage. Performance Expectations Accurate, up-to-date books with complete supporting documents. Timely monthly closing and management reporting. Regular reconciliation of banks, customers and vendors. Timely compliance preparation and escalation of pending issues. Properly approved payments and prompt reporting of discrepancies.

title: Expense Analyst
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if youre ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. Job Summary As an Expense Analyst at Everpure, you will safeguard company resources and deliver an exceptional employee experience by modernizing our global Travel & Expense (T&E) operations. Operating at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and policy governance, you will partner cross-functionally across global business units to optimize expense auditing, minimize financial risk, and drive process automation. This role offers the opportunity to leverage cutting-edge platforms like Concur and AppZen to transform routine audits into strategic operational insights. Responsibilities Drive Global Audit Excellence: Execute comprehensive expense report reviews using Concur Expense and AppZen AI tools, auditing expenditures, foreign exchange rates, and itemized costs to guarantee adherence to Everpure's Global T&E policies. Optimize Processes & Automation: Utilize data analytics and Intelligence Reporting to identify operational bottlenecks, streamline auditing workflows, and scale process efficiency across global business units. Mitigate Financial Risk & Enhance Controls: Proactively evaluate expense patterns to strengthen internal controls, preventing duplicate reimbursements, identifying system inconsistencies, and reducing fraud risk. Deliver High-Touch Stakeholder Support: Serve as a subject matter expert for global employees, resolving complex T&E queries promptly while delivering high-quality customer service. Standardize Operational Documentation: Maintain robust departmental documentation and collaborate across finance teams to establish standardized reporting and continuous T&E process improvements. What You Bring 4+ years of professional experience in global expense auditing, financial analysis, and corporate expense policy enforcement. In-depth expertise using modern expense management and analytics technologies, specifically Concur Expense, AppZen, Concur Intelligence Reporting, and Google Workspace tools. Strong analytical, data-driven, and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to evaluate complex expense data, apply sound corporate judgment, and handle sensitive information confidentially. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a customer-centric mindset focused on collaborating effectively across diverse, cross-functional teams. We are primarily an in-office environment, and therefore you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: IT Operations - Manager
description:
Were proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work , a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well-being and growth. At Tarento, you ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. 
 
 Job Description - IT Operations / IT Manager 
 Location: Bangalore| Experience: 10+ years |Team: 5-8 IT professionals | User base: ~500-person IT organization 
 About the Role We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive IT Operations Lead / IT Manager to lead and optimize the technology environment supporting a 500-person IT organization. The role combines strategic IT leadership with hands-on operational ownership across infrastructure, IT service management, end-user computing, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, compliance, vendor management, automation, and technology governance. The successful candidate will lead a team of 5-8 IT professionals, ensure stable and secure day-to-day operations, and drive continuous improvement, automation, cost optimization, and exceptional service delivery. 
 1. IT Operations, Service Management & Service Delivery Lead day-to-day IT operations, ensuring availability, performance, reliability, resilience, and security of infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, cloud services, and end-user technology. Own IT Service Management processes covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management through the IT ticketing platform. Establish, govern, and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, ticket ageing, response/resolution targets, and user satisfaction. Act as the escalation point for critical and major incidents; coordinate troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident reviews. Drive continuous service improvement aligned with ITIL best practices and business priorities. Develop monthly SLA and operational reports covering Internet uptime, service uptime, ticket volumes, ageing, resolution performance, and recurring issues. Maintain a strong customer-service culture and provide empathetic, professional support to internal users. 2. Team Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of 5-8 IT support and infrastructure professionals. Assign work, establish priorities, monitor performance, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of IT issues. Define objectives, KPIs, development plans, knowledge-sharing practices, and operational ownership across the team. Foster a collaborative, supportive, accountable, and continuous-improvement-oriented culture. Coordinate cross-functional teams during major incidents, audits, projects, technology changes, and transformation initiatives. 3. IT Infrastructure, Network & End-User Computing Oversee enterprise infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, virtualization, wireless, firewalls, cloud environments, and end-user devices. Ensure high availability and reliability of critical IT systems and services. Manage wireless access points, hardware firewalls, switches, network equipment, Internet circuits, and associated vendor services. Manage the complete lifecycle of laptops, desktops, mobiles, peripherals, and accessories from procurement and provisioning through refresh and secure disposal. Own user onboarding, role changes, access provisioning, offboarding, asset recovery, and access-card coordination with HR. Perform monthly Internet bandwidth and capacity checks and recommend upgrades based on usage and business demand. Maintain disk-capacity and infrastructure-health reports and proactively address capacity risks. 4. Cloud Management & Cost Optimization Manage and optimize cloud resources across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where applicable. Support cloud services and customer-facing workloads hosted on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Monitor availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational health of cloud resources. Track monthly cloud bills, analyze consumption trends, forecast spend, and drive FinOps-style cost optimization. Define cloud adoption standards and ensure appropriate governance, tagging, access controls, backup, and lifecycle management. Balance on-premises and cloud workloads to optimize performance, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership. 5. Software, License, Patch & Configuration Management Manage Microsoft 365/O365 licenses and project-specific software licenses, including allocation, renewal, usage, and cost optimization. Oversee software deployment, application inventory, endpoint configuration, and patch management using tools such as ManageEngine Desktop Central/Endpoint Central. Implement and govern automated OS patching for employee workstations and servers. Maintain accurate software and hardware inventories and ensure appropriate licensing compliance. Track software renewals, support contracts, certificates, and technology lifecycle milestones. 6. DevOps, Git & CI/CD Operations Provide operational leadership and governance for DevOps tooling and practices. Manage and support Git, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps environments as applicable. Perform periodic Git/GitLab access reviews and ensure least-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties. Support CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment reliability, and operational stability in collaboration with development and DevOps teams. Lead infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management practices using Terraform and Ansible where applicable. Support containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. 7. Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance Define and implement IT security policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls. Act as the IT/security escalation point and support enterprise security governance and risk management. Conduct vulnerability checks and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities. Manage endpoint protection and antivirus/EDR platforms such as Cortex and ensure security agents remain healthy and current. Oversee identity and access management, privileged access, access reviews, endpoint security, network security, and incident response. Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and support ISO 27001 certification and audit requirements. Participate in quarterly audits, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and management reviews. Coordinate cybersecurity incidents, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned. 8. Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy & Governance Define and govern enterprise IT architecture standards, technology reference models, and infrastructure principles. Establish vendor evaluation frameworks and technology selection criteria. Define cloud adoption policies, technology lifecycle standards, and application rationalization roadmaps aligned with business strategy. Partner with C-suite and executive leadership to translate business objectives into technology roadmaps and investment priorities. Present IT performance metrics, risk posture, cybersecurity status, governance outcomes, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, automation, AIOps, and cloud platforms, and assess their operational and business value. 9. AI, AIOps & Automation Lead adoption of AIOps capabilities such as ML-based event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and automated first-line remediation. Drive AI-powered ITSM capabilities including intelligent ticket classification, AI-driven routing, NLP-based resolution recommendations, and predictive SLA-breach alerts. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT operations, support processes, monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities. Architect and manage infrastructure for AI workloads, including on-premises GPU platforms and cost-optimized cloud AI services where appropriate. Measure operational improvements from AI and automation initiatives, including reduced downtime, faster MTTR, and lower operating cost. 10. Proactive Maintenance, Upgrades & Business Continuity Plan and execute quarterly firmware upgrades for wireless access points and network equipment. Implement and maintain automated OS patching and upgrade cycles for end-user systems and servers. Perform planned server OS upgrades and maintain application/platform upgrade schedules. Perform quarterly GitLab version upgrades with appropriate validation, backup, rollback, and change-management controls. Maintain backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience plans for critical services. Use monitoring and capacity data to identify and resolve issues before they impact users or customers. 11. Monitoring, Reporting & Operational Governance Develop and maintain monthly IT dashboards covering service uptime, Internet uptime, network bandwidth, patch compliance, license renewals, ticket performance, disk usage, cloud spend, and security posture. Produce monthly SLA and KPI reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders. Maintain operational dashboards and trend analysis to identify recurring incidents, capacity risks, cost anomalies, and improvement opportunities. Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset records, service ownership information, escalation matrices, and operational runbooks. Maintain and share access-card server details with HR in accordance with access governance procedures. 12. Procurement, Vendor & Contract Management Own procurement of IT hardware, software, licenses, accessories, network equipment, and technology services. Manage vendor, MSP, telecom, cloud, and technology-partner relationships. Define and monitor vendor SLAs, KPIs, contracts, renewals, service quality, and operational performance. Lead vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations, renewals, and corrective actions in collaboration with procurement and leadership. Ensure third-party services meet requirements for availability, security, compliance, performance, and cost. 13. IT Budget & Financial Management Own IT CapEx and OpEx planning, forecasting, budget tracking, and financial reporting. Manage cloud spend forecasting and optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Optimize software licensing, infrastructure, telecom, support, and vendor costs without compromising service quality or security. Present technology investment proposals and cost-benefit analysis to leadership. 14. Client & Stakeholder Interaction Participate in client calls and technical discussions as required. Provide service status, operational updates, logs, evidence, and technical information to clients in coordination with relevant teams. Translate technical issues into clear business impact, resolution status, risk, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders. Build strong relationships with business leaders, customers, vendors, and internal technology teams. Preferred Qualifications & Certifications ITIL 4 certification. ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor; CISSP or CISM is advantageous. AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud certifications. CompTIA or other infrastructure/security certifications. TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification. PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent project-management certification. Terraform, Kubernetes, or DevOps-related certifications. Key Competencies IT Operations Leadership Infrastructure & Network Management Cloud & FinOps IT Service Management & ITIL Cybersecurity & Compliance DevOps & Automation AI/AIOps & Intelligent IT Operations Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy Vendor & Contract Management Budget & Cost Management Problem-Solving & Incident Management Customer Service & Empathy Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management Proactive Approach & Continuous Improvement Team Leadership & People Development Key Performance Indicators IT infrastructure and service availability / uptime. SLA compliance, ticket resolution time, backlog, and user satisfaction. Major incident frequency, MTTR, recurrence, and root-cause closure. Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance. Cloud spend against budget and measurable cost optimization. Software/license compliance and renewal management. Vendor/MSP performance against contractual SLAs. Audit findings, security compliance, and ISO 27001/ISMS performance. Change success rate and change-related incidents. Automation/AIOps adoption and measurable reduction in downtime and operational effort. Successful delivery of infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle activities, and technology roadmaps. Role Impact The IT Manager / IT Operations Lead is accountable for building a stable, secure, scalable, cost-effective, and business-aligned IT environment. The role combines strong operational discipline with strategic technology leadership, proactive service improvement, automation, cybersecurity governance, cloud optimization, and people leadership. The successful candidate will help transform IT into a highly reliable, measurable, customer-focused, and continuously improving technology function. 
 Required Skills IT Infrastructure cybersecurity, compliance IT service management vendor management end-user computing compliance devops

title: Treasury Manager
description:
Job Summary Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. The Role As our International Treasury Manager, you will shape and safeguard Everpures financial foundation across international entities. Partnering closely with Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Legal, Payroll and Accounts Payable, you will lead regional cash management, optimize intercompany liquidity, and scale high-impact banking infrastructure. You will leverage AI-enabled tools and automated workflows to transform cross-border financial operations into a seamless, high-performing growth engine. This role offers the unique opportunity to drive capital efficiency, mitigate risk, and directly fuel Everpures global expansion. What You'll Do Optimize Global Liquidity & Capital: Mastermind regional cash optimization strategies and intercompany funding structures to maximize capital efficiency, execute short-term investments, and minimize idle liquidity across international entities. Lead Banking Relationships & Governance: Serve as the strategic operational lead for international financial institutions, managing account lifecycles, user access controls, and periodic KYC compliance to maintain robust financial governance. Build Predictive Cash Models & Trade Finance: Develop high-accuracy liquidity forecasts and deploy AI-assisted analytics to evaluate cash variance, while managing Letters of Credit (LCs) to ensure trade compliance and support business scale. Drive Cross-Functional Excellence & Compliance: Partner with Accounting, FP&A, and Tax to execute month-end close reconciliations, support financial audits, and continuously automate treasury processes for maximum organizational speed. What You Bring Treasury Expertise: 6+ years of progressive corporate treasury experience managing complex international cash operations, intercompany liquidity, and trade finance within a global enterprise environment. Systems & Automation Mastery: Technical proficiency in ERP platforms, Treasury Management Systems (TMS), and AI-driven automation tools to modernize workflows, reporting, and forecasting accuracy. Strategic Collaboration & Execution: Outstanding analytical and cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of translating financial insights into actionable outcomes alongside Legal, Tax, and Accounting partners. Work Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: Manager, Finance Operations
description:
Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: Description: Footer Overall Purpose of The Job The Manager, Finance Operations oversees the day-to-day financial transaction cycle of Aspire Lifestyles India u2014 booking settlements, vendor payables, receivables, refunds, agent commissions, payment gateway operations, and the associated reconciliations. The role owns the operational close for the transaction cycle, ensures alignment of financial operations with corporate goals, safeguards controls and compliance, and partners with Operations, Sales, Technology and the wider Finance team (Reporting, Tax, Treasury) to enable accurate, timely and well-controlled financial outcomes. The role leads a team of Reconciliation Specialists and is a key contributor to process automation and continuous improvement across the Finance Operations function. Key RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end booking-to-settlement cycle: airline Billing and Settlement Plan reconciliations, GDS feeds, hotel and DMC payouts, aggregator settlements and traveller refunds. Oversee high-volume accounts payable and accounts receivable operations, ensuring accurate matching against booking inventories and supplier statements before release. Manage global agent commissions, incentive payouts and B2B ledger positions; ensure timely and accurate settlement in line with contractual terms. Oversee payment gateway operations, including reconciliation and monitoring of Pass-through and Merchant of Record transactions, chargebacks and gateway fees. Own the month-end and year-end close for the Finance Operations sub-ledgers (AP, AR, gateway, agent commissions), including accruals, provisions and reconciliations to the general ledger. Prepare and review unit-level and product-level profitability analyses for leadership; explain movements, margins and variances against plan. Deliver operational MIS, payment forecasts, aging analyses, settlement dashboards, gateway performance to the Head of Finance and business leadership. Coordinate closely with the Manager, Financial Reporting and the Tax function to ensure timely statutory reporting, tax compliance and consolidation inputs Design, operate and continuously improve internal controls over the transaction cycle (segregation of duties, approval matrices, exception reviews, reconciliation signoffs). Ensure compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), company policies and Standard Operating Procedures across the operations team. Support GST, TDS and other statutory workings for AP/AR transactions in coordination with the Tax function; oversee resolution of GSTR-2B mismatches with vendors. Serve as the primary Finance Operations interface for internal, statutory and tax auditors; own timely closure of audit observations. Monitor and forecast cash outflows and inflows arising from the transaction cycle; partner with Treasury on funding requirements and FX exposures on cross-border settlements. Optimise working capital through disciplined payment runs, refund cycles, dispute resolution and receivables collection. Drive automation and simplification across the transaction cycle (invoice capture, reconciliation, workflow approvals, payment file generation, gateway reconciliation Standardise SOPs and drive measurable improvement in turnaround time, accuracy and control effectiveness Lead, develop and mentor a team of Reconciliation Specialists responsible for BSP, GDS, gateway, vendor and agent-commission reconciliations across the transaction cycle Key Metrics / Success Measures Timely and accurate operational close: sub-ledger close completed within 4-5 business days of month-end with zero material post-close adjustments. Payment discipline: on-time payment rate of [u2265 98%] and DPO within targeted range. BSP, gateway and agent-commission reconciliations completed monthly with all breaks investigated and cleared within the following month. Zero missed statutory due dates for AP/AR-related tax filings; clean statutory, internal and tax audits with no significant Finance Operations observations. Accurate and timely unit-level profitability reporting to leadership within agreed cadence. Job Profile Requirements 9 to 12 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance operations, including at least 3 years leading a team. Prior experience in the travel, hospitality or aviation sector strongly preferred, ideally with exposure to BSP settlements, GDS environments, DMC/aggregator payouts and payment gateway operations Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO); comfort with finance systems integrations and reconciliation tools. Advanced MS Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query); familiarity with BI tools (Power BI / Tableau) an advantage. Sound knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Indian tax laws (GST, TDS, withholding on cross-border payments). Understanding of payment gateway mechanics, Pass-through vs Merchant of Record models, and card scheme / chargeback processes. Strong leadership presence with the ability to lead cross-functional and cross-regional teams. Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills; able to engage confidently with leadership and external partners. Analytical and problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail. Sound judgment in applying policy and controls while resolving exceptions pragmatically. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and ethics. Effective under time pressure and shifting priorities; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across close, audit and business cycles. Qualifications Bachelors degree in accounting/finance or equivalent experience. Chartered Accountant (Mandatory). Required Languages: Good spoken and written English language skills Travel Requirements: Not applicable / minimal.
