description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don t just provide data; we provide certainty . We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500 , protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria s Secret . As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity. The Culture Memo: Our Operating System Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. Extreme Ownership: We don t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish. The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time. Methodology & Rigor: We don t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable. Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly. The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup. The Perks & Ownership: We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren t just an employee; you are a partner in our success. Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 
 Role Overview: We are looking for an SDE II - Sensors to build customer-deployed security software that runs inside enterprise environments and continuously discovers assets, evaluates exposures, and securely communicates telemetry back to SAFE. 
 This role is suited for engineers with strong C++, Go or Python programming skills, Windows/Linux, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals , particularly those who have worked on endpoint agents, security sensors, network/security products, or other long-running system software . What Youll Do: Design and develop lightweight security sensors/agents running inside customer environments. Build capabilities for asset discovery, network scanning, vulnerability detection and exposure validation . Develop reliable, long-running system software with a focus on performance, resource usage, concurrency, and stability . Work extensively with Windows/Linux internals, processes, sockets, filesystems, networking and system APIs . Build communication between distributed sensors and the SAFE cloud with secure authentication, encryption, retries and offline recovery . Implement sensor lifecycle management, including installation, configuration, health monitoring and software/rule updates. Debug complex issues spanning application code, operating systems, customer networks, proxies, firewalls and infrastructure . Build strong diagnostics, telemetry and logging so problems can be investigated without requiring direct access to customer systems. Participate in low-level and high-level design discussions and independently own well-defined components/features through production. What Were Looking For: 3-6 years of software development experience , preferably building systems, infrastructure or security products. Strong programming experience in one or more of C++, Go or Python . Strong understanding of Windows/Linux and operating-system fundamentals . Good understanding of networking concepts, including: TCP/IP and sockets DNS HTTP/HTTPS TLS Proxies Routing NAT Firewalls and network segmentation Experience with multithreading/concurrency, asynchronous programming and inter-process communication . Understanding of software security and secure communication practices. Ability to troubleshoot issues independently across code, OS and network boundaries . Strongly Preferred: Experience building endpoint agents, sensors, collectors, daemons or system services . Experience working on cybersecurity, endpoint security, vulnerability management, micro-segmentation, EDR or network security products . Experience building software deployed across large heterogeneous enterprise environments . Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, vulnerability scanners and exposure management . Experience with secure auto-update / software distribution mechanisms . Familiarity with containers and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes . Experience developing software that needs to operate reliably across Windows and Linux environments . What Good Looks Like: You should be comfortable going beyond: "The API returned an error." and investigating: Sensor process socket DNS proxy/firewall network cloud service to determine exactly where and why something failed. You should be equally comfortable reasoning about: Why is a process consuming excessive CPU or memory Why communication works in one customer network but fails in another How to safely upgrade thousands of deployed sensors How to recover when a sensor loses connectivity for several hours How to execute security scans without destabilising customer infrastructure How to collect enough diagnostics to troubleshoot systems you cannot directly access The ideal candidate is fundamentally a systems/security engineer who can build reliable software , rather than a conventional CRUD/backend application developer. If you re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that s redefining security, we want to hear from you!

title: AI engineering Lead
description:
Job Summary Your role sits exactly there. You will own a defined slice of the Applied AI roadmap - architecting the agentic and retrieval systems behind it, owning their lifecycle in production, and growing a small team of engineers who build alongside you. It is deliberately a hands-on leadership role: you keep writing and reviewing code while owning delivery, quality, and the growth of the people on your team. A Day in the Life You own AI systems end to end - from problem framing with product and customer teams through architecture, evaluation, deployment, and the cost and latency profile they run at. System ownership: Architecture. Design production agentic and RAG systems that meet real customer scale and reliability requirements, not benchmark conditions. Orchestration depth: Apply agent design patterns with judgment - memory, tool routing, multi-agent coordination, and explicit failure handling - and decide deliberately where autonomy stops and a human takes over. Retrieval quality: Own the retrieval pipeline as a first-class system: chunking strategy, embedding model selection, vector stores, re-ranking, and relevance tuning against measured outcomes. LLMOps lifecycle: Own model and prompt versioning, eval pipelines running in CI, observability (tracing, token and cost dashboards), and the guardrails and safety filters that ship with every release. Model strategy: Select, fine-tune, and serve SLMs and open models - LoRA and QLoRA, quantization, inference optimization, GPU and serving trade-offs. Engineering economics: Optimize latency, cost, and accuracy together, and make defensible build-versus-buy and model-selection calls you can explain to both engineers and executives. Beyond the codebase Define and execute the quarterly roadmap for your area, and translate ambiguous business problems into machine learning problems with clear solution workflows. Work with business leaders and customers directly to understand where the workflow actually breaks, then build for that. Partner with the data platform and applications teams so your capabilities land inside their products and workflows rather than beside them. Set the coding and evaluation standards for your team, and lead design reviews. Pursue published work or patents where the problem warrants it - particularly in healthcare AI. What You Need 6+ years in data science, applied ML, or AI engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-powered products. Healthcare experience is a plus. Deep NLP and GenAI experience. Statistical and classical machine learning is good to have on top of that. Strong hands-on Python - building highly scalable, performant enterprise applications, plus optimization technique. Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks: PyTorch and/or HuggingFace transformers. At least one shipped GenAI product with a genuinely complex architecture - multiple agents, memory, retrieval, and agent OTEL/tracing in production. Working command of modern fine-tuning: PEFT methods, with LoRA and QLoRA preferred. Hands-on experience with at least one ML platform - Databricks, Azure ML, or SageMaker. Experience leading engineers, formally or as a technical lead - you have owned other people's output, not only your own. Strong written and spoken communication, with a customer-focused instinct in both conversation and documentation. Preferably a Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. The engineering baseline we assume Everything above sits on top of independent delivery. This role assumes you can already do the following without supervision: Build production-grade RAG and LLM/SLM-powered features end to end with limited supervision. Work fluently in at least one orchestration framework - LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or equivalent - to compose multi-step, tool-using flows. Design retrieval pipelines and tune them for relevance: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, re-ranking. Implement prompt engineering, function and tool calling, and reliable structured-output parsing. Write and run evals - golden sets, LLM-as-judge - to measure quality and catch regressions before customers do. Containerize and deploy services (Docker, REST/gRPC) with an eye on latency, token cost, and basic guardrails. Document well and participate actively in code review. Good to have API frameworks for robust web applications - FastAPI or Django preferred. Comfort with at least one hyperscaler cloud. Papers or patents, especially in healthcare AI.

description:
Job Summary The Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) team is building a next-generation Edge-to-Cloud machine learning pipeline to power Multi-Lane Free Flow (MLFF) tolling across Indian highways. As a Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in scaling our architecture to handle high-speed traffic, extreme environmental edge cases (mud, glare, tampering), and highly localized typography. You will take ownership of model training, failure mode diagnostics, and the active learning ecosystem that bridges our lightweight Edge models with massive Cloud Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Job Type Full-Time Responsibilities Model Development & Fine-Tuning: Train, optimize, and evaluate state-of-the-art object detection, Pose Estimation (for License Plate Normalization), and Optical Character Recognition models for high-speed, noisy highway environments. Failure Diagnostics & Data Curation: Analyze large-scale, unstructured video data from tolling gantries. Utilize dimensionality reduction and advanced clustering techniques on high-dimensional vehicle embeddings to mathematically isolate and diagnose visual failure modes. Active Learning & AutoGT: Build and maintain programmatic feedback loops using Cloud VLMs to automate ground truth generation (AutoGT) and dynamically retrain edge models based on real-world anomalies. Tracking & Heuristics: Implement and refine temporal tracking logic and spatial prior mathematics to stabilize OCR predictions and handle object occlusion. Multimodal Fusion Readiness: Collaborate on architecting feature embeddings that fuse 2D visual data with physical sensor telemetry (LiDAR profiling, Radar speed). Edge Optimization: Collaborate with deployment engineers to ensure models adhere to strict latency and compute constraints for real-time edge hardware execution.

The ideal candidate is a subject-matter expert in India payroll and statutory compliance, with direct, hands-on experience helping organizations adjust to new Labour Codes and revised income tax regimes. Key Responsibilities India Payroll Management Manage end-to-end payroll processing for employees in India, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Support payroll audits and statutory audits by providing required documentation and reports. Lead the organization s readiness and compliance efforts for India s new Labour Codes (Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security, and Occupational Safety, Health & Working Conditions) as they are rolled out and notified by state. Assess the impact of new Labour Code and tax regime changes on compensation structures, payroll calculations, benefits, and statutory contributions, and drive the changes needed to stay compliant. Track legislative developments and proactively flag compliance risks and required process changes. Drive payroll process improvements and standardization initiatives. Maintain confidentiality and security of employee payroll data. Perform payroll-related audits, compliance reviews, and reporting activities. Employee Support & Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll-related employee queries. Collaborate with HR, Finance, Tax, Benefits, Compensation, and external payroll vendors. Provide payroll analysis, reports, and insights to business stakeholders as needed. 
 
 Systems & Reporting Utilize HRIS and payroll systems effectively for payroll administration and reporting. Prepare monthly payroll reports, variance analysis, reconciliations, and management dashboards. Support payroll system implementations, enhancements, and testing activities when required. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in human resources, Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or related field. 5-8 years of India payroll experience. Demonstrated, hands-on experience leading compliance efforts tied to India s new Labour Codes and the new income tax regimes Deep knowledge of Indian payroll legislation, taxation (TDS), and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Gratuity). Experience managing payroll vendors and third-party payroll providers. Hands-on experience with HRIS and payroll systems. Workday and ADP Celergo preferred. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and payroll reconciliations. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. High attention to detail and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information. Preferred Qualifications Experience working for multinational corporation in a centralized corporate function, supporting assigned geographic regions. Exposure to payroll operations across APAC, EMEA, and/or Americas regions. Experience in payroll transitions, process improvement, or automation initiatives. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 Broad function: The Senior Data Engineer - VARTA SENSE will be responsible for designing, developing, and managing scalable and reliable data pipelines that form the core data foundation of the VARTA SENSE platform. The role will work closely with the ML Lead, Solution Architect, Backend Engineering team and other technology stakeholders to transform complex banking and transaction data into standardized, reusable and production-ready datasets and features. The position requires strong hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, data pipelines, orchestration, data quality and distributed data processing, with particular emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability and secure deployment within restricted banking environments. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Data Pipeline Development & Engineering: Design and develop scalable batch, incremental and production-grade data pipelines for large volumes of transaction and customer data. Build standardized and reusable data models and canonical schemas for transactions, customer attributes, offers, exposure and outcome events. Develop configurable ingestion and mapping frameworks to integrate data received from different banks and source systems. Manage pipeline orchestration including dependencies, checkpointing, retries, partial failures, backfills and safe replay mechanisms. Implement deduplication, late-arriving data handling, incremental loads, CDC, watermarking and merge/upsert processing. Data Quality, Reconciliation & Governance: Establish strong data-quality controls, automated testing, source-to-target reconciliation and schema validation. Ensure data lineage and schema evolution are properly managed across pipelines. Proactively identify and prevent issues such as missing data, duplicate records, incorrect aggregations, silent data loss and double counting. description:
Role Overview We are looking for a Staff Engineer - Database & Data Infrastructure to help define and drive the technical direction of database infrastructure across the company. This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who has designed and operated database systems at significant scale and can apply that experience to company-wide challenges. You will work across engineering teams to shape database architecture, establish scalable patterns and platforms, anticipate future constraints, and lead initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, developer experience, and infrastructure efficiency. This is not a traditional DBA role. While deep database expertise is essential, the role is focused on architecture, platform strategy, and company-level technical impact. Responsibilities Define and evolve the long-term database and data infrastructure strategy across the company. Design architectures capable of supporting the next order of magnitude of growth in data volume and traffic. Establish architectural standards and paved roads for database selection, data modeling, partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, availability, and data lifecycle. Lead complex, cross-team initiatives such as database migrations, re-platforming, sharding, multiregion architectures, and major scalability improvements. Identify systemic reliability, scalability, and capacity risks before they become critical production problems. Drive database platform capabilities that make infrastructure more self-service, observable, reliable, and easier to operate for engineering teams. Develop strategies for capacity planning, data growth, archival, disaster recovery, and infrastructure efficiency. Identify opportunities to materially improve database infrastructure cost and performance at company scale. Evaluate new database technologies and architectures and make pragmatic build-vs-buy and technology-selection decisions. Partner with senior engineers and engineering leadership on architecture and long-term technical direction. Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar for database and distributed-systems engineering across the organization. Requirements Significant experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior individual contributor, solving infrastructure or database problems across multiple teams. Deep understanding of database internals and distributed systems, including storage, indexing, partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, transactions, availability, and failure modes. Experience designing and operating production database systems with multi-terabyte or larger datasets. Experience with high-throughput systems handling 30K-50K+ operations per second, preferably at substantially higher scale. Strong production experience across multiple database technologies and database architectures, including both relational and NoSQL/distributed systems. Experience leading major architectural changes, migrations, or scaling initiatives involving multiple engineering teams. Strong understanding of database reliability, capacity planning, observability, and infrastructure economics. Ability to take ambiguous technical problems, establish a direction, build alignment, and drive them through execution. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence engineers and engineering leadership without relying on organizational authority. Relevant Technology Experience We value breadth of database architecture experience and depth of fundamentals over expertise in our specific technology stack. Experience in any programming language like Node.js, Java, Python Experience with several technologies such as the following would be relevant: Relational & Distributed SQL: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Amazon Aurora, Google Cloud Spanner, CockroachDB, TiDB, YugabyteDB, Vitess NoSQL & Distributed Databases: MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, ScyllaDB, HBase, Cosmos DB, Couchbase, Firestore Search & High-Throughput Systems: Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Redis/Valkey Large-Scale Analytical Systems: ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, Pinot, Druid You do not need experience with all of these technologies. We are looking for engineers who understand database and distributed-system fundamentals deeply enough to reason about trade-offs and make strong architectural decisions across different technologies What Success Looks Like Build database architecture that can support 5-10 future growth Reduce systemic reliability and scalability risks Simplify how engineering teams consume and operate database infrastructure Make better company-wide technology and architecture decisions Improve the economics of operating databases at scale Establish technical standards that continue to create value as the organization grows Success in this role is measured by the lasting technical and organizational impact you create - not simply by the systems you personally build or operate. We are looking for an engineer who can combine Deep database expertise Distributed systems thinking Architectural judgment Strong execution Company-wide technical influence

title: Principal Firmware Engineer
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Principal Firmware Engineer to lead the design, development, and optimization of embedded systems. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Secure Boot, RTOS, Linux kernel, device drivers, peripheral interfaces, and bus protocols, as well as open-source software development. This role requires strong problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve complex hardware and software issues while ensuring security, performance, and scalability of embedded solutions. Responsibilities Architect, develop, and optimize embedded software solutions for secure and high-performance systems. Implement and maintain Secure Boot, and other security measures for embedded platforms. Work on RTOS environment and Linux kernel driver development, including optimizing device drivers and upstreaming. Develop and integrate software for various peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, SGPIO, eSPI, etc.) and bus protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, etc.). Diagnose and resolve complex hardware and software issues, leveraging debugging tools and methodologies. Conduct performance analysis and tuning of embedded software systems to ensure efficiency and reliability. Define and implement scalable and maintainable embedded software architectures. Engage in open-source development, contributing to Linux or similar embedded software projects. Work closely with hardware engineers, security experts, and system architects to develop robust embedded solutions. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices for embedded software development. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 20+ years of experience in embedded software development, with a strong background in C/C++. Expertise in Root of Trust (RoT), Secure Boot, and cryptographic security principles. Extensive experience with RTOS, Linux kernel, and device driver development. Strong debugging skills using JTAG, GDB, and other embedded debugging tools. Experience in performance profiling and optimization for embedded systems. Proven ability to diagnose hardware and software interaction issues. Experience in open-source Linux development or similar community-driven software projects. Strong understanding of system-level software architecture and real-time performance constraints. Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, etc.) and bus protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, etc.) driver development. Experience in Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) is a plus. Proven ability to debug low-level PCIe issues using analyzers is a plus. In-depth knowledge of PCIe protocol, including root port, SRIOV. Familiarity with machine learning acceleration on embedded platforms. Experience with hardware bring-up and board support packages (BSPs). Knowledge of Yocto, Buildroot, and other Linux build systems. Note: Any Aziro location is suitable, but Pune is preferred.

title: FEA Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a candidate who will be responsible for finite element analysis (FEA) activities using MSC Nastran and OptiStruct and support knowledge development projects. Your mission will be to support new product development for FEA activities and assist in FEA knowledge development at Global Engineering Center India Airpower. You should have a very high penchant for engineering analysis and analytical work. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 You perform advanced FEA analyses for a wide range of applications and products. In close collaboration with your internal client and with the necessary creativity you translate your findings to a performant and cost-effective design. The client is guided by you from the moment you receive the request up to the implementation of the solution. In all projects a customer focused approach is crucial. You are able to analyze the client's problem and assess if he needs a simple hand calculation or a more complex FEA simulation. It is your task to select the most efficient and accurate solution strategy to tackle the job. Components analyzed include compressor/pump frames, rotors, housings etc. Type of analyses includes linear static, non-linear and dynamic calculations. You remain up to date with the latest developments in the CAE/FEA domain. You identify opportunities to improve and/or expand our calculation models and tools. And together with your colleagues you introduce these improvements in our processes worldwide and develop the static structural and dynamic competence domain in Atlas Copco. Interaction with overseas Atlas Copco customers on a regular basis is required. Provide CAE support to customers in phase of product development and product enhancement. Support competence development and following best practices in CAE. Compliance to ISO Procedures. 
 
 Experience requirements 
 2-4 years of FEA experience, experience on compressors/pumps is an added advantage. 
 
 Knowledge 
 An in-depth knowledge of FEA, Applied Mechanics, Dynamics of structure. Hands-on experience in HyperMesh / HyperView / SimLab / Inspire / SimSolid as pre/post-processor and Nastran/OptiStruct as solver is a must, and the candidate needs to be a dependable resource to the team in these areas. Should be able to perform linear, nonlinear and dynamic analysis on 3D solid components. Experience on pressure vessels or power train is essential. Ability to convert problem statements into FEA model strategy definition and results into solutions is essential. The ideal candidate shall be able to judge and interpret the analysis results with a critical attitude. Should possess FE modeling reviewing skills and quality awareness. Experience in the areas below is an added advantage Performing modal / frequency-response / random-vibration / vibration-fatigue calculations/ Experience on Rotordynamics simulations Correlation of simulation results to test particularly in the dynamics domain Experience in providing solutions to vibration problem Knowledge of standards/codes (ASCE/EN/DNV) is an added advantage Knowledge of ASME Sec. VIII Div.1/2 for strength and fatigue analysis of vessels is desired Experience in below programming skills is an added advantage Unix-Shell scripts TCL/TK Python Matlab HTML AI/Machine Learning 
 
 Educational requirements 
 M.Tech/M.E. 
 
 Personality requirements 
 Research attitude Good interpersonal skills and positive attitude. Dynamic and energetic. Good presentation, business communication and analytical skills. High achievement drive and willingness to accept challenges Customer focused.

title: Senior AI Full-Stack Engineer
description:
What we are looking for Senior AI Full-Stack Engineer Company: Grey Chain AI Location: Remote Experience: 8+ Years Employment Type: Full Time 
 About the Role We are growing our engineering teams and hiring senior full-stack engineers who have already shipped LLM-powered features to real users and want to do it at the level of a platform rather than a single app. You will work flexibly across two kinds of work, and most engineers here do both. Platform work: building the capabilities of our agent platform itself new agent types, tools and MCP servers, skills, the codeexecution sandbox, workflow and long-running task infrastructure, ingestion pipelines, and the graph, vector and ontology layers that agents reason over. Product work: building client-facing AI products on that platform, from data model to API to UI, integrated into the client's Microsoft 365, Salesforce or identity estate, and deployed into their own cloud environment. Both kinds of work share a shape: a Python backend, a React/Next.js front-end, PostgreSQL underneath, an LLM in the loop, and an enterprise client at the end of it who expects the result to be secure, multi-tenant, auditable and fast. You will own features end to end schema, service, agent behaviour, UI, tests, and the evals that prove the LLM part actually works. You will join engineering teams that already ship to production. We expect you to raise the bar on them: through the quality of your own work, your code reviews, and your willingness to say when something is not good enough. 
 What you will build and own Agentic features, end to end. Design and build agent workflows that solve real enterprise tasks: retrieval over client documents and structured data, multi-step tool use, specialised agents that hand off to one another, long-running jobs with durable state, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Own the prompts, the tool definitions, the orchestration logic and the evals not just the API around them. Tools, MCP servers and skills . Build the tools agents call MCP servers over client systems and internal services, skills that package repeatable capabilities, and sandboxed code execution for data analysis. Design them so they are safe to expose to an LLM: strict schemas, least-privilege credentials, idempotency, and clear failure modes. Data layer. Design PostgreSQL schemas that hold up under multi-tenant load and years of client data. Build ingestion pipelines for documents, structured data and enterprise sources; own chunking, embedding, indexing and the vector, graph and ontology structures that make retrieval accurate. Write the SQL that analytics agents generate and know when they are generating it badly. Enterprise integration. Integrate with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Salesforce and client identity providers using OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, including delegated and On-Behalf-Of flows so agents act with the user's permissions, not a service account's. Respect the client's existing RBAC and data boundaries in everything you build. Multi-tenant product engineering. Build features that are tenant-isolated by construction: row-level security or schema-per-tenant where appropriate, tenant-scoped credentials and vector indexes, per-tenant cost attribution, audit logging that a client's security team will accept. Front-end . Build the interfaces through which users work with agents chat and task UIs, streaming responses, citations and provenance, review-and-approve flows, dashboards and admin consoles in React/Next.js and TypeScript, to a standard you would put in front of a client executive. Quality and evaluation. Write the tests. Build eval sets for every LLM-driven feature and run them on every change. Instrument agents with tracing so that when a client asks "why did it say that", you can answer. 
 What we are looking for 
 Must have 
 5-8 years building production web applications, with the last 2+ spent as a full-stack engineer owning features from database to UI. You have shipped LLM features to real users RAG, tool-calling, structured extraction or agent workflows using Claude, OpenAI, Bedrock or Azure OpenAI APIs, and you can talk concretely about what went wrong: hallucinations, latency, token cost, prompt regressions, retrieval misses, and how you measured and fixed them. • Strong Python backend engineering: FastAPI or similar async frameworks, typed code (Pydantic, mypy), background workers, and API design you would be happy to hand to another team. Strong React/Next.js and TypeScript you build the UI well, not merely tolerate it. Streaming, optimistic updates, complex forms and accessible components should all be familiar. Deep PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing and query performance, migrations, transactions, and experience with pgvector or a comparable vector store. Enterprise integration in production: at least one of Microsoft Graph / SharePoint, Salesforce, or OAuth 2.0 / OIDC SSO against Entra ID or Okta including the delegated-permission flows, not just app-only tokens. Multi-tenant SaaS experience: tenant isolation, RBAC, audit logging, and the discipline to keep data from one client from ever reaching another. You test your work and expect others to. Unit, integration and LLM evals are part of the definition of done, not a follow-up ticket. Clear written and spoken English; comfortable demoing to and taking questions from client stakeholders. 
 Strongly preferred 
 Hands-on with agent frameworks and protocols: MCP servers, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or comparable; durable workflow engines such as Temporal. Experience with sandboxed code execution for LLM-driven data analysis, or with graph databases and ontology-driven data models. Document processing at scale: OCR, layout-aware parsing, table extraction, chunking strategies. Observability for LLM applications: tracing platforms such as LangFuse or LangSmith, eval frameworks, cost dashboards. Working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) enough to own your service's deployment, not to run the cluster. Experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) as a serious part of your workflow. 
 How we work 
 Remote, India-based. Occasional travel to Delhi NCR for team days. Working hours. Standard India working hours. Our clients are in the UK, Europe and the Middle East, so you will occasionally take a late-afternoon or evening call to cover overlap this is the exception, not the routine. Ownership. You own what you ship. When a feature you built misbehaves in production, you lead the fix and the explanation. Joining. We are hiring for an immediate need and strongly prefer candidates who can join right away or are already serving notice. 
 Why this role You will build agentic systems that enterprises actually run their work on not demos across the full stack, from ingestion and retrieval through agent orchestration to the interface a client's team uses every day. You will work alongside engineering leadership that builds hands-on and knows exactly what good looks like, on a platform whose scope is growing faster than we can hire for it.

title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
description:
Job Summary AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members. The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Position expectations Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra Own well-scoped projects end to end on weekly-to-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly Solve day-to-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non-standard problems Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search and bring interesting developments back to the team Qualifications 3+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it Nice to Have Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries Familiarity with Jira and related tools Success measures In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes In six months, you will own a well-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best

title: Data Analyst
description:
Role: Data Analyst (Analytics & Insights) 
We are looking for a sharp, curiosity-driven Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. You won't just be "pulling data"; you will be the bridge between raw numbers and strategic decisions. 
In this role, you will own the full data lifecycle - from building automated pipelines and sleek visualizations to presenting high-stakes insights to our Product and leadership council. If you enjoy debunking myths with data and finding "the why" behind the "what," you'll fit right in. 
 Core Responsibilities: Metric & Dashboard Ownership: Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards that serve as the "source of truth" for the business. Insight Generation: Go beyond the surface level. Analyze trends and anomalies to provide actionable recommendations that drive growth. Stakeholder Communication: Lead the weekly Analytics Council reviews, translating complex technical findings into clear, executive-level narratives. Experimentation (A/B Testing): Design experiment frameworks, calculate sample sizes, and perform post-hoc analysis to determine the success of product or marketing changes. Ad-hoc Analysis: Support rapid-fire business questions with deep-dive investigations to support urgent decision-making. Automation & Efficiency: Identify repetitive manual reporting tasks and build scripts or workflows to automate them, freeing up time for high-value analysis. Innovation & Process Improvement: Constantly evaluate our data stack and methodologies. Propose new tools, statistical models, or data collection techniques to keep us ahead of the curve. 
 Technical Requirements 
 - Data Querying: Advanced SQL (Window functions, CTEs, Query optimization) - Visualization: Proficiency in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker - Programming: Python or R (specifically for data manipulation and automation) - Experimentation: Understanding of hypothesis testing, p-values, and confidence intervals - Data Cleaning: Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) 

 What Makes You a Great Fit 
- The "So What?" Factor: You don't just report that a metric moved; you explain why it moved and what the business should do about it.
- Precision: You have a high bar for data integrity. You'd rather double-check a join than present a wrong number.
- Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift based on new data.
- Storytelling: You can take a messy spreadsheet and turn it into a compelling 3-slide deck for executives.

 Qualifications 
- Experience: 2.5 years in an analytical role (Product, Marketing, or Business Analytics).
- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, etc.).
- Communication: Proven experience presenting to senior leadership or cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Skills: Power BI,Data Visualization,Tableau,Python,SQL,Data Analytics,Data analysis,Analytics

title: Automation Quality Engineer - Mobile (SDET)
description:
Role Overview 
 We are not hiring manual testers. We are looking for an Automation Quality Engineer who builds quality in someone who writes the app-facing automation and contributes to the code that makes our mobile products testable and reliable. If you think of QE as engineering writing code, owning frameworks, and shipping confidence with every release this role is for you. Seniority is not the advantage here; maturity, smartness, and the ability to communicate clearly are what set candidates apart. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Test Automation & Engineering 
 - Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for our mobile apps (Android and iOS) UI, functional, integration, and regression that run reliably in CI.
 - Write real code alongside the team: build test utilities, harnesses, mocks, and the small pieces of app/service code that make features testable.
 - Own the automation framework for your area keep it clean, fast, and low-maintenance rather than a source of flaky failures.
 Mobile Quality & Coverage - Own end-to-end quality for the features you cover, from reading the requirement to shaping the test strategy to signing off on the release.
 - Test across the mobile surface: API and backend contracts behind the app, performance and responsiveness on real devices, offline/edge conditions, and cross-device/OS compatibility.
 - Investigate failures to root cause, reproduce cleanly, and file reports crisp enough to need zero follow-up questions.
 Quality in the Pipeline 
 - Integrate automated checks into the build and release pipeline so quality gates run automatically on every commit and deploy.
 - Contribute to shift-left practices catching issues during the build, not after it.
 - Explore AI-assisted testing to generate, maintain, and prioritize tests, and to auto-add coverage based on the nature of changes.
 Collaboration & Communication - Partner closely with developers during the build, raising the bar on testability in design discussions and code reviews.
 - Communicate defects, risks, and trade-offs clearly to developers, product, and leadership, in writing and in conversation. 
 Required Qualifications - 2 to 5 years building test automation for mobile apps, or strong development skills with a genuine pull toward quality engineering.
 - Comfort writing production-quality code able to read a codebase and contribute to it, not just test-only work.
 - Hands-on experience with mobile test automation frameworks (e.g., Appium, Espresso/XCUITest, or Flutter integration testing our apps are built in Flutter) and API testing.
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them.
 - Solid fundamentals in at least one modern language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Dart, Python, or Java), version control (Git), and a working understanding of how mobile apps and their backend services interact.
 - Excellent written and spoken communication clear articulation and thoughtful, well-reasoned push-back.
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
 Preferred / Nice to Have - Exposure to our stack or its neighbours: Flutter, Node.js, React, REST/MCP-based services.
 - Experience with device farms or cloud device testing (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, Firebase Test Lab).
 - Familiarity with performance, accessibility, or security testing on mobile.
 - Interest in AI-assisted testing using AI tools to generate, maintain, or prioritize tests.
 Soft Skills / Traits - Sharp judgment and quick learning matter more than years of experience.
 - Strong communication and articulation, with technical and non-technical audiences alike.
 - High ownership mentality treats the quality of every release as a personal responsibility.
 - Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving AI SaaS company.
 - Collaborative works closely with engineering, product, and QA/DevOps teams.

title: Staff Engineer- Network Security & Attack Path Intelligence
description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don t just provide data; we provide certainty . We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500 , protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria s Secret . As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity. The Culture Memo: Our Operating System Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. Extreme Ownership: We don t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish. The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time. Methodology & Rigor: We don t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable. Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly. The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup. The Perks & Ownership: We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren t just an employee; you are a partner in our success. Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 
 As a Staff Engineer - Network Security & Attack Path Intelligence, you will define and lead the technical direction of Safe s network reachability and attack-path intelligence capabilities across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will be the hands-on architect behind systems that connect network topology, identities, vulnerabilities, security controls, and business-critical assets to determine how attackers can move through an enterprise environment. You ll collaborate with product, backend, graph, data, AI, and platform teams to build scalable, explainable, and enterprise-ready attack-path capabilities. This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role. You will architect systems, build prototypes, write production-quality code, and help shape how Safe s CTEM platform identifies and breaks the attack paths that pose the greatest business risk. Core Responsibilities: Architect Safe s Attack Path Intelligence: Define the architecture and data model for network topology, effective reachability, trust boundaries, identities, vulnerabilities, controls, and attack paths across complex enterprise environments. Build Core Attack Path Capabilities: Write production-quality code for network configuration parsing, reachability analysis, attack-graph construction, graph traversal, exposure chaining, and blast-radius computation. Build prototypes and evolve them into reliable, enterprise-scale services. Model Effective Network Reachability: Derive actual connectivity from routing tables, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and segmentation policies rather than relying only on documented topology. Model Attacker Movement: Build reasoning systems that connect exposed services, vulnerabilities, credentials, Active Directory privileges, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and access to critical assets. Prioritize Actionable Attack Paths: Distinguish theoretical paths from reachable, exploitable, and business-critical attack paths. Incorporate exploitability, control effectiveness, asset criticality, and business impact into prioritization. Enterprise Security Integrations: Design integrations with firewalls, routers, NAC, EDR, CMDB, Active Directory, vulnerability scanners, NetFlow, cloud platforms, and other enterprise security systems. Countermeasure Intelligence: Build a vendor-neutral model for recommending segmentation, isolation, firewall-policy changes, access-control improvements, and compensating controls. Define validation, approval, safety, and rollback requirements. AI and Graph Integration: Partner with other engineers to ensure attack-path explanations and countermeasure recommendations are evidence-backed, explainable, technically accurate, and governed through deterministic safety policies. Validation & Governance: Build reference attack scenarios, simulation environments, regression datasets, and validation frameworks to verify attack paths and proposed countermeasures without introducing unacceptable operational risk. Mentor & Multiply: Guide backend, graph, security, and platform engineers through architectural design, code reviews, prototypes, engineering standards, and complex security-domain decisions. Minimum Qualifications: Experience: 12+ years of experience in software engineering, network security, security product engineering, exposure management, or related areas, with a strong record of building and shipping production systems. Core Technical Skills Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, Go, Java, or a similar backend language Recent experience writing and shipping production-quality software-not only providing architectural or advisory guidance Strong system-design, API-design, data-modeling, and distributed-systems fundamentals Experience implementing graph traversal, rule-processing, network automation, configuration analysis, or security analytics Ability to independently prototype complex ideas and evolve them into scalable production capabilities Familiarity with graph databases and graph-processing technologies Network Security Deep understanding of enterprise on-premises, cloud, and hybrid networks Strong knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and network segmentation Experience deriving effective reachability across complex network configurations Understanding of firewall-policy analysis, change validation, control effectiveness, and security misconfiguration detection Attack Path & Identity Security Strong understanding of Active Directory, Kerberos, identity privilege paths, credential exposure, privilege escalation, and lateral movement Experience with attack graphs, attack-path analysis, threat modelling, breach simulation, or exposure chaining Ability to connect vulnerabilities and misconfigurations with network reachability and attacker behaviour Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and common enterprise attack techniques Product Engineering: Experience translating deep security-domain knowledge into scalable products, analytical systems, or security-platform capabilities. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building attack-path, network digital-twin, microsegmentation, or CTEM products Experience with graph databases and large-scale graph computation Experience with BloodHound, Nmap, Zeek, Wireshark, NetFlow, or similar technologies Experience with Forward Networks, XM Cyber, RedSeal, AlgoSec, Tufin, FireMon, or comparable platforms Experience with Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, Fortinet, Check Point, Juniper, or other enterprise network-control technologies Exposure to Pentera, AttackIQ, Picus, Horizon3.ai, or other security-validation platforms Background spanning both offensive and defensive security Experience safely validating security controls in production-like environments Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP networking Experience working with large, complex, and highly regulated enterprises Certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CISSP, CCIE Security, CCNP Security, or GIAC Published research, patents, open-source contributions, or previous technical leadership in security-product engineering is a strong plus If you re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that s redefining security, we want to hear from you!

title: Senior SQL Server DBA | On-Premise | Migration
description:
Senior SQL Server Database Administrator On-Premise | Migration & Platform Support Role Senior SQL Server Database Administrator (On-Premise) Experience 5 to 10 years Location Jaipur, Noida, Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru Engagement Client-facing, on-premise SQL Server migration and platform support 
 About the Role We are looking for a Senior SQL Server DBA to take ownership of a large, complex on-premise SQL Server estate for an enterprise client. This is a hands-on, production-facing role weighted toward server migration and platform support, alongside day-to-day operational ownership not a monitoring-only position. The estate comprises multiple clustered SQL Server instances, including a production environment distributed across three servers with a separate disaster recovery setup and a one-to-one development clone. It carries 400+ SSIS jobs, 35+ SSAS cubes and extensive SSRS usage, feeding a large downstream reporting community. You will be the person accountable for keeping this estate healthy, resolving the issues it produces, and moving it safely. 
 Key Responsibilities Migration & Modernisation Plan and execute SQL Server migrations across multi-server and clustered topologies, covering assessment, inventory, cutover and hypercare Own the full migration checkpoint set — logins with SIDs , SSISDB and its master key, SSRS encryption keys, Agent jobs, proxies, linked servers, SSAS cubes and downstream connection dependencies Design parallel-run and reconciliation approaches, define rollback criteria in advance, and validate post-migration performance against pre-migration baselines Handle legacy artefacts where original owners, credentials and documentation are no longer available 
 Daily Server Health Check & Maintenance Perform structured daily health checks across all instances: service and Agent status, database state, failed and long-running jobs, backup success, free space across data, log, tempdb and backup volumes, blocking sessions and error log review Monitor job duration against normal bands and investigate anomalies before they become failures Verify downstream data currency for priority reporting assets, including detection of jobs that succeed while loading stale or partial data Own scheduled maintenance: threshold-driven index and statistics maintenance within agreed windows, integrity checks, msdb and SSISDB history cleanup, and log file management Produce and circulate a daily health summary, and progressively automate routine checks into a single consolidated report Track capacity and growth trends — file growth, drive consumption and batch window drift — and forecast constraints ahead of impact 
 Access Management & User Support Manage the access request queue end to end across the database engine, SSAS cubes and SSRS — grant, modify and revoke within agreed SLAs Administer permissions through Active Directory groups rather than individual logins, maintaining an accurate access register Resolve access-related incidents: login failures, orphaned users after restores, permission escalation requests, service account and credential expiry, and job owner validation errors Maintain a central service account register covering owner, expiry date and dependent objects, with proactive expiry alerting Conduct periodic permission audits, remove leavers and privilege creep, and respond to audit and compliance queries on who has access to what Act as first point of contact for user-reported database and reporting access issues, with clear communication and turnaround 
 Database Administration Own backup and recovery: strategy design, verification, corruption handling and periodic timed restore drills against agreed RTO and RPO Manage instance configuration, index and statistics strategy, integrity checks and capacity planning Diagnose and resolve production incidents — blocking chains, transaction log exhaustion, tempdb contention, storage latency and query regression Establish monitoring baselines and alerting where none currently exist 
 Platform Services — SSIS, SSAS, SSRS Administer and support Integration, Analysis and Reporting Services: deployment, configuration, security, cube processing and subscription management Manage the SQL Server Agent job estate — ownership standards, proxy accounts, scheduling, dependency chains and failure triage 
 High Availability & Disaster Recovery Maintain and test clustering and DR configurations, including scheduled failover testing Own the DR runbook and document explicitly what falls outside high-availability coverage Change & Infrastructure Coordination Represent the database platform during Windows patching and infrastructure change windows — pre-checks, controlled service sequencing, post-change validation and pipeline catch-up Work with infrastructure, OS, storage and Active Directory teams, and escalate to vendor support with a supporting evidence pack Stakeholder Engagement Communicate incident status and business impact in plain language, on a predictable cadence Author root cause analyses and maintain runbooks, access registers and platform documentation 
 Required Skills & Experience Essential 6+ years administering production SQL Server, with demonstrable ownership rather than shared support Proven end-to-end server migration experience on a multi-database estate, with specific examples Strong backup and recovery capability — restore sequencing, corruption diagnosis, DBCC CHECKDB , RESTORE VERIFYONLY , and experience of real recovery scenarios Established daily operational discipline — able to describe their own health check routine and what they automated Practical experience resolving access issues across all three security models: engine logins and database roles, SSAS role-based cube security, and SSRS item-level permissions Understanding of orphaned users, SID mismatches and service account lifecycle management Hands-on SSIS administration: deployment models, SSISDB, protection levels, parameterisation and job troubleshooting Working knowledge of SSAS (including cube security and processing) and SSRS (including encryption keys and subscriptions) Performance diagnosis using wait statistics and DMVs — able to distinguish platform-bound from code-bound problems Clustering and/or Always On experience, including having performed a real failover Experience coordinating with infrastructure teams through patching and change windows Clear written and verbal communication in a client-facing setting Desirable Multi-source ETL integration experience across cloud storage, relational and SaaS sources SAP-sourced data warehouse exposure PostgreSQL or other non-SQL Server platform familiarity Partitioning strategy and large-table retention management Monitoring tooling and baseline instrumentation Experience implementing group managed service accounts (gMSAs) or automated credential rotation Microsoft certification — Azure Database Administrator Associate or equivalent 
 What Will Set a Candidate Apart Has migrated an estate where the original developers had left and the documentation did not exist Can describe a production incident they diagnosed against resistance, and how they built the evidence Has replaced a manual morning routine with an automated health report, and can explain what they chose to alert on and why Treats monitoring baselines as a prerequisite rather than a nice-to-have Knows what a high-availability configuration does not protect

title: Civil Project Coordinator
description:
Role & responsibilities : Manage and coordinate multiple ongoing construction and utility projects simultaneously. Demonstrate strong, practical knowledge of on-site execution, specifically for government projects. Act as the primary technical liaison for major state clients Ensure smooth site operations, quality control, and timely delivery for specialized works, ranging from road construction to turnkey bio-methanation plants. 
 Planning & Scheduling: - Prepare detailed project execution plans and work schedules. - Develop baseline schedules using MS Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent software. - Prepare monthly, weekly, and daily work plans. - Monitor project milestones and identify potential delays. - Prepare recovery plans whenever required. - Review project progress against approved baseline schedules and establish corrective actions. 
 Project Monitoring: - Monitor day-to-day progress of all ongoing civil works. - Track project progress against approved schedules and targets. - Prepare Daily Progress Reports (DPR), Weekly Progress Reports (WPR), and Monthly Progress Reports (MPR). - Monitor manpower, machinery, and material deployment. - Ensure optimum utilization of available resources. - Identify bottlenecks and provide practical solutions to maintain project timelines. 
 Site Coordination: - Visit project sites regularly and monitor actual progress. - Coordinate with Site Engineers, Project Managers, contractors, consultants, and clients. - Resolve execution issues through effective planning and communication. - Ensure timely availability of approved drawings, materials, machinery, and workforce. - Provide planning and execution guidance to Site Engineers and project teams. 
 Execution Monitoring: Monitor and coordinate all types of civil construction activities, including: - Road construction Flexible & Rigid Pavement - Earthwork and embankment - Buildings and industrial structures - RCC and structural works - Drainage and sewerage works - Water supply and pipeline works - Boundary walls and compound development - Landscaping and site development - Miscellaneous infrastructure works 
 Government Project Experience Mandatory / Preferred: - Candidates with experience working on government construction projects will be strongly preferred. - Experience dealing directly with West Bengal Government Departments, PWD, CPWD, WBSEDCL, WBPHED, Irrigation & Waterways, Urban Development & Municipal Affairs, Rural Development, or other government agencies will be an added advantage. - Should have a good understanding of government project procedures, departmental specifications, tender conditions, BOQ, measurement and billing procedures, work orders, approvals, inspections, and project documentation. - Experience coordinating with Departmental Engineers, Government Authorities, Consultants, and other statutory agencies. - Should be familiar with government contract administration, progress monitoring, extension of time (EOT), delay analysis, recovery planning, and resolution of site-related issues. - Preference will be given to candidates having substantial experience in West Bengal Government projects and knowledge of West Bengal PWD / relevant departmental specifications and procedures. 
 Quality & Safety: - Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and contract requirements. - Coordinate with the Quality Control team for inspections and testing. - Ensure compliance with applicable safety regulations and company HSE policies. - Monitor quality-related observations and ensure timely corrective action. Documentation & Reporting: - Maintain project documentation and progress records. - Prepare MIS reports for management. - Monitor project cash flow, physical progress, and work completion percentages. - Assist in preparing client presentations and project review meetings. - Support billing teams by verifying executed quantities and progress measurements. - Maintain records of site instructions, approvals, inspections, measurements, and other project correspondence. 
 Coordination: - Coordinate with Procurement for timely availability of materials. - Coordinate with Design, Planning, Accounts, and Project teams. - Participate in project review meetings with management, clients, consultants, and government authorities. - Escalate critical project issues to management along with practical recommendations and recovery measures. 
 

 Preferred candidate profile : - 15 to 20+ years of experience in planning, monitoring, and execution of civil/infrastructure projects. - Strong experience in project planning, scheduling, progress monitoring, and site coordination. - Experience handling multiple construction sites/projects simultaneously will be preferred. - Government project experience is highly preferred, with West Bengal Government project experience being an added advantage. - Should be capable of independently monitoring project progress and guiding Site Engineers and project teams. - Strong knowledge of MS Project / Primavera P6 and Excel-based MIS reporting. - Good understanding of construction methods, resource planning, BOQ, billing, measurements, and project documentation. - Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and leadership skills. - Willingness to travel regularly to project sites across West Bengal.

title: Sr Virtual Designer
description:
Job Summary 
 vConstruct is seeking an experienced Senior Modeler with strong structural steel detailing expertise and advanced knowledge of Tekla Structures and AISC standards. This role is responsible for independently delivering complex modelling and detailing work while providing technical guidance and support to other modelling resources. The role combines hands-on technical delivery, design interpretation, constructability, coordination, quality ownership, and team mentoring. The Senior Modeller works closely with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, BIM/VDC teams, and other stakeholders to develop accurate, coordinated, and fabrication-ready models and drawings in accordance with project requirements, client requirements, fabrication standards, and applicable codes. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support project initiation, project setup, preparation of estimates, model readiness, and project kickoff. Review client detailing manuals, project standards, details and specifications to help establish necessary documentation for effective 3D modelling and detailing. Thoroughly Interpret structural drawings, specifications, addendum, reference models, RFI s and other design information to understand and apply design intent. Support project delivery planning by coordinating modelling tasks, internal schedules, planned hours, and milestone requirements. Model primary and secondary structural steel for critical items, complex connections, miscellaneous items such as embeds, stairs, handrails, ladders etc. Review design documents for missing information, discrepancies, conflicts, and potential constructability issues and raise RFI s for technical queries. Coordinate with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, BIM/VDC teams, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues timely. Provide day-to-day technical guidance to Junior Modelers and Modelers. Support project teams in monitoring modelling progress, productivity, and delivery readiness and proactively communicate technical risks, schedule risks, challenges, and potential impacts to project leadership timely. Incorporate approved design revisions, RFIs, and client comments into models and deliverables in a controlled manner and track the COR s. Support the review and release of final deliverables in accordance with established project quality processes and client requirements. Collaborate with checkers to identify opportunities to improve modelling quality, productivity, consistency, and delivery efficiency. Maintain a strong focus on first-pass quality and minimizing downstream rework. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to support coordinated project delivery. Support effective information management, maintain consistency in model standards, numbering, templates, reports, and project-specific workflows. Contribute to the development and improvement of modelling standards, procedures, checklists, templates, and workflows. Support the development and use of Tekla custom components, auto connections, templates, reports, and other productivity tools. Share knowledge, best practices, workflows, and lessons learned with the broader team. Support technical training, skill development, and onboarding of new team members as required. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Independent ownership of complex technical assignments from interpretation through delivery. High-quality deliverables with strong first-pass quality and minimal downstream rework. Effective resolution of complex modelling, coordination, and constructability challenges. Accurate, coordinated, constructible, and fabrication-ready structural steel models and drawings. Strong collaboration with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, and other project stakeholders. Effective technical guidance and mentoring of Junior and intermediate modelling resources. Consistent application and improvement of project standards, workflows, and detailing practices. Proactive communication of technical risks, challenges, and delivery impacts. Improved modelling productivity, quality, consistency, and digital delivery capabilities. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Diploma or bachelors degree in civil engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered. 8+ years of experience in structural steel detailing, with significant experience in 3D steel modelling. Strong hands-on experience with Tekla Structures, preferably on U.S.-based structural steel projects. Strong knowledge of structural steel detailing, fabrication, and erection practices. Good working knowledge of AISC standards and U.S. structural steel detailing practices. Experience working with engineers, fabricators, Project Managers, Checkers, and multidisciplinary project teams. Demonstrated ability to provide technical guidance or mentoring to Junior and intermediate modelling resources. 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Advanced proficiency in Tekla Structures. Strong structural steel 3D modelling and detailing skills. Complex steel connections and constructability. Miscellaneous steel modelling and detailing. Strong understanding of AISC, OSHA and relevant U.S. detailing practices. Working knowledge of Tekla Power-Fab and Trimble connect. Proficiency in Bluebeam or similar review/markup tools. Understanding of BIM/VDC coordination and multidisciplinary workflows. 
 
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience with U.S. structural steel projects. Experience with Tekla automation, custom components, templates, reports, and workflow optimization. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to technical quality. Knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, or other BIM/VDC platforms. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop other team members. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and delivery commitments. A continuous improvement mindset with an interest in innovation, standardization, and knowledge sharing.

With offices in the UK, India, and China, we bring together innovation, craftsmanship, and sustainability to create designs that transform homes worldwide.
