title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description:
Job Summary At Arctic Wolf, you won t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - youll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. If you re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you! Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We re looking for a Product Manager-Platform to be part of making this/that happen. Position Overview and Objective This Technical Product Manager role drives requirements, execution, and delivery for reliable, scalable data lake infrastructure and intelligent AI/ML capabilities that power Arctic Wolf s security products and platform operations. The TPM translates complex business, security, and operational needs into clear product requirements and technical specifications-initially supporting 1-2 engineering squads (scaling to 2+) across sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and milestone tracking. The role collaborates closely with Data Engineers, Data Science Engineers, Platform Architects and cross-functional stakeholders to support use cases such as log availability, telemetry analysis, threat detection, and intelligent alerting while ensuring solutions adhere to robust data security, privacy, and governance standards. The role requires foundational technical fluency in distributed data systems and AI/ML lifecycles, Agile execution, and the ability to represent data platform capabilities authoritatively to integrating teams. Responsibilities Works with senior PMs to understand how data platform infrastructure and AI-enabled capabilities align with the broader platform vision and roadmap. Gathers and authors requirements, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data pipelines, query services, data lake access layers, and AI/ML model integration workflows. Defines project-level success criteria. Owns the product backlog and delivery execution for 1-2 engineering squads (growing to 2+), managing prioritization, dependencies, risk mitigation, and on-time release milestones. Collaborates with stakeholders (Platform Engineering, Data Science teams, Security Operations, and Architecture) to assess system capabilities, onstraints, and architectural trade-offs. Validates, where possible, that High-Level Designs (HLDs) cover all validated use cases, data processing workflows, and performance requirements for platform features. Presents direction, roadmaps, and delivery status for data platform and intelligent capabilities to development teams and consuming product stakeholders. Answers authoritatively questions from teams integrating against data platform APIs, pipelines, and data access layers: what is supported today, what needs to be specified, and what is out of scope. Identifies high-demand, heavy-lift platform requests, cost-optimization opportunities, and emerging AI use cases for consideration in future strategy and planning sessions. Knowledge & Experience Knowledge of Product Management discipline, requirements definition, and Agile/Scrum ceremonies and practices. Educational background in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or 2-5 years of equivalent technical/product experience. Foundational understanding of distributed data systems, data pipelines, relational/non-relational data modeling, REST APIs, and cloud infrastructure components (e.g., AWS, GCP). Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and lifecycle concepts (e.g., training datasets, model evaluation metrics, inference pipelines, anomaly detection, or NLP). Understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards. Begins to develop a system-level approach, understanding how data platform architecture, query performance, and indexing decisions ripple across consuming security products and operational costs. Exposure to security concepts such as logging pipelines, telemetry analysis, monitoring, or threat detection systems a plus. Complexity and Problem Solving Collaborates with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Data Science Engineers, and internal stakeholders to maintain backlog priority, sizing, and acceptance criteria for data platform and AI enablement work. Communicates and escalates unexpected delays, cross-team blockers, data quality issues, or non-prioritized asks from integrating teams. Analyzes platform telemetry, query latency/throughput, data reliability metrics, and performance signals to determine the highest-value backlog items and platform optimizations. Collaboration & Interaction Partners with Engineering to define technical acceptance criteria and ensure tickets/epics are properly documented before scheduling into sprints. Collaborates with consuming product teams and operational stakeholders to define success criteria and validate that data platform and AI features resolve the intended operational challenges. Engages Engineering to monitor telemetry related to platform usage, storage/compute efficiency, and AI effectiveness, reporting regularly on key operational metrics. Develops strong working relationships with Engineering and Data Science teams as a trusted technical subject-matter partner, and proactively collaborates with peer Product Managers as well as cross functional teams. Why This Role This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. Youll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. Youll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart. On-Camera Policy To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

title: Technical Product Manager (Japanese/English) - CS & Trust & Safety
description:
Introduction We are looking for a hands-on Technical Product Manager to own product strategy and measurable outcomes for the tools and workflows that power Customer Support (CS) and Trust & Safety (TnS) for Mercari. You will identify high-impact problems, create the roadmap, write clear product requirements, manage delivery, and measure results. This role requires strong product judgment, practical use of data and AI, and the ability to bridge Japan-based stakeholders and the India engineering team in Japanese and English. About Us Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission. Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management. For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company. About Mercari India Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercaris applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about Four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect Indias cutting-edge technology and knowledge. Our Culture To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organisation and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives. Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values: Go Bold All for One Be a Pro Move Fast Our organisation is also shaped by our four foundations: Sustainability Diversity & Inclusion Trust & Openness Well-being for Performance Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organisation. We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviours and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognised, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari s culture. Work Responsibilities Own Product Strategy and Outcomes Define the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes for CS and TnS Identify opportunities using customer feedback, operational insights, and data Define success metrics, baselines, guardrails, and post-launch measurement plans Balance customer experience, operational efficiency, risk, and business priorities Lead Discovery and Delivery Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch plans Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear priorities for engineering Manage projects from discovery through development, rollout, adoption, and iteration Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions across teams Improve CS and TnS Products Build tools and workflows that improve support quality, resolution speed, and operational productivity Improve user reports, escalations, moderation, case management, and enforcement experiences Identify opportunities for workflow simplification and automation while preserving appropriate human judgment Partner with CS, TnS, engineering, data, ML, policy, and business teams to deliver measurable impact Use AI and Connect Japan and India Use AI to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, prototyping, and product workflows Lead discussions and create clear product documentation in Japanese and English Build shared context and align Japan-based stakeholders with the India engineering team Bold Challenges The role balances customer experience, operational efficiency, marketplace risk, and business priorities while improving the tools and workflows used by CS and TnS teams. Success requires identifying high-impact problems, aligning Japan-based stakeholders and the India engineering team, and turning ambiguous operational needs into measurable product outcomes. title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Job Description Project Manager (Software Delivery) Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with experience in managing end-to-end software development projects. The ideal candidate should have a strong software development background and proven expertise in delivering fixed-scope software projects while managing multiple client engagements simultaneously. The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and successfully delivering projects within agreed timelines, scope, budget, and quality standards. The role requires close collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams, business stakeholders, and US-based customers to ensure predictable and successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities Project Delivery Lead end-to-end delivery of software development projects from project initiation through deployment and post-production support. Manage fixed-scope projects, ensuring delivery within committed scope, timelines, budget, and quality expectations. Prepare project plans, define milestones, manage dependencies, and track overall project progress. Proactively identify project risks, issues, and bottlenecks, and drive mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery. Stakeholder & Client Management Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, business stakeholders, and delivery teams throughout the project lifecycle. Conduct regular project status meetings and provide concise project updates to leadership and customers. Manage client expectations, address escalations, and ensure high customer satisfaction. Delivery & Team Management Coordinate with engineering, QA, DevOps, architects, business analysts, and product teams to drive execution. Manage multiple project engagements simultaneously while ensuring delivery commitments are met across all projects. Facilitate effective collaboration across geographically distributed teams. Project Governance Monitor project health using delivery metrics, dashboards, and KPIs. Ensure adherence to project governance processes, documentation standards, and organizational best practices. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance delivery efficiency and project outcomes. Agile & SDLC Lead projects using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies based on project needs. Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups where applicable. Ensure effective release planning, change management, and production readiness. Required Skills & Experience Around 12 years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in software project management. Strong software development background, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams and technical decision-making. Proven experience managing fixed-scope software development projects from initiation to successful delivery. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client projects and engagements simultaneously. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project management best practices. Hands-on experience with Agile (Scrum), Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies. Excellent planning, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder management skills. Strong communication, leadership, negotiation, and collaboration skills. Experience working with geographically distributed teams and global stakeholders. Ability to overlap with US business hours, with availability until approximately 11:00 PM IST as required for customer meetings and project coordination. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. PMP, CSM, PSM, or equivalent Project Management certification is preferred. Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or similar platforms. Experience managing offshore-onshore delivery models is an added advantage.

description:
Job Overview The On Premise & Azure Cloud Hosting Service Owner is accountable for the strategy, performance, and lifecycle management of the organisation’s hosting services across both traditional datacentre environments and Microsoft Azure. This role ensures that compute, storage, virtualisation, backup, and cloud hosting platforms are secure, resilient, cost optimised, and aligned with business needs. Acting as the authoritative owner of hosting services, the Service Owner defines the service roadmap, governs operational processes, and ensures that hosting platforms—whether on premise or cloud—deliver consistent, high quality outcomes. They work closely with infrastructure teams, cloud engineers, security, architecture, and external service providers to maintain service stability, manage capacity, and drive continuous improvement. The successful candidate combines deep technical understanding of hosting technologies with strong service management discipline. They provide leadership during major incidents, oversee change governance, manage vendor performance, and ensure that hosting services evolve in line with modern cloud and hybrid cloud strategies. Responsibilities & Duties* Own the full lifecycle of on-premise and Azure cloud hosting services, including compute, storage, virtualisation, backup, and platform services. Define and maintain the service strategy, roadmap, and service catalogue entries. Ensure hosting services meet performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency targets. Oversee datacentre hosting platforms (VMware/HyperV, physical servers, SAN/NAS storage, backup infrastructure). Ensure capacity, performance, and resilience are proactively managed. Govern patching, firmware updates, hardware lifecycle, and platform upgrades. Govern Azure landing zones, resource groups, compute, storage, networking, and PaaS services. Ensure cloud environments follow best practices for cost optimisation, tagging, RBAC, and security baselines. Oversee Azure policy compliance, monitoring, and automation pipelines. Ensure unused, misconfigured, or noncompliant resources are removed or corrected. Maintain accurate CMDB and asset data for all hosting components. Ensure backup success rates, retention policies, and recovery tests meet standards. Drive automation to reduce manual effort and eliminate configuration drift. Act as the hosting service authority during major incidents affecting compute, storage, or cloud services. Ensure platform upgrades and migrations follow structured release processes. Track and report on hosting performance, capacity, cost, and incident trends. Use data to identify service gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Provide regular service health updates to IT leadership and key stakeholders. Manage relationships with hosting vendors, cloud providers, MSPs, and hardware suppliers. Ensure vendors meet contractual obligations, SLAs, and performance targets. Lead service reviews and drive improvement actions across multivendor environments. Ensure hosting services comply with security policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards. Work with Security teams to manage vulnerabilities, patching, encryption, and identity controls. Maintain risk registers and ensure mitigation plans are in place for hostingrelated risks. Act as the primary point of contact for hosting service queries, escalations, and strategic discussions. Collaborate with architects, cloud engineers, application teams, and project managers. Support business change initiatives by ensuring hosting services are ready, scalable, and secure. Ensure all hosting documentation, runbooks, and operational guides are accurate and up to date. Maintain architectural diagrams, service models, and support processes. Provide training and guidance to operational teams on hosting standards and best practices.     Knowledge, Skill, ability 12+ years  working in infrastructure, systems engineering, or hosting operations. Handson experience with: VMware or HyperV virtualisation, Physical server hardware, SAN/NAS storage platforms & Backup and recovery technologies Strong experience administering Azure services, including: Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Virtual Networks, Azure Backup & Site Recovery, Resource Groups, RBAC, and Azure Policy Experience with hybrid identity, landing zones, governance, and cost optimisation. Proven experience maintaining platform hygiene across onprem and cloud environments: Patching, firmware updates, and configuration baselines, Monitoring, alerting, and capacity forecasting Experience reducing technical debt and eliminating configuration drift. Experience owning or managing a technical service within an ITILaligned environment. Strong understanding of Incident, Problem, Change, and Request processes, Risk and compliance management Experience leading post incident reviews and driving root cause remediation. Experience managing MSPs, cloud providers, hardware vendors, and datacentre partners. Ability to run service reviews, track SLAs, and drive performance improvements. Experience coordinating multivendor environments during incidents and changes. Experience working with cloud engineers, architects, security teams, and application owners. Ability to translate hosting issues into clear business language. Experience supporting project delivery and ensuring hosting readiness for new services. Experience driving improvements in hosting performance, automation, and cost efficiency. Exposure to cloud migration, modernisation, or hybrid cloud transformation initiatives. Ability to shape and deliver a hosting service roadmap.   Essential requirement (non-negotiable) * Strong experience with VMware or Hyper V virtualisation Solid understanding of physical servers, SAN/NAS storage, and backup infrastructure Ability to manage patching, firmware updates, capacity, and lifecycle upgrades Handson experience with Azure compute, storage, networking, RBAC, and governance Ability to manage Azure Policy, tagging standards, cost optimisation, and resource hygiene Experience with hybrid identity and Azure landing zone principles Proven track record of enforcing patching, configuration baselines, and security hardening Experience eliminating configuration drift and managing technical debt Ability to maintain accurate CMDB/asset data and ensure backup success rates Ability to lead hosting related major incidents with authority and clarity Strong understanding of Incident, Problem, Change, and Request processes Experience owning a technical service end to end Ability to define SLAs, KPIs, service models, and governance frameworks Experience managing MSPs, cloud providers, hardware vendors, and datacentre partners Ability to run service reviews, track SLAs, and drive performance improvements Understanding of vulnerability management, patching, encryption, and identity controls Ability to ensure compliance with audit, regulatory, and internal security standards Ability to translate hosting issues into clear business language Skilled at working with architects, cloud engineers, application teams, and leadership Clear documentation and communication during incidents and service reviews

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Position : Human Resource Executive Experience : 12 Years Reporting To : Founder / CEO or Designated Manager Employment Type : Full-time Salary: Up to 20K /Month 
 About the Role : 
 We are looking for an HR Executive who can take care of the regular HR work in the office and keep things properly organized. The person will mainly handle recruitment, employee joining, attendance, leave, documentation, employee coordination and other day-to-day HR activities. This role is suitable for someone who is comfortable talking to people, follows up on work regularly and does not wait for someone to remind them about every task. 
 What You Will Be Doing : 
 You will be responsible for handling recruitment activities, starting from finding candidates and checking CVs to arranging interviews, speaking with candidates, following up with them and coordinating their joining. You will keep track of open positions and make sure candidates are followed up properly. If there is a delay in hiring, you should be able to identify it and bring it to the manager's attention. You will also take care of the joining process for new employees, including collecting documents, KYC, induction, access, KRAs and initial training coordination. Attendance and leave records need to be maintained properly. Employee documents and other HR records should also be kept updated and confidential. You will coordinate with managers regarding employee KRAs and performance reviews and make sure the required information and follow-ups are completed on time. Employees may come to you with regular questions or concerns. You should be able to understand the issue, handle it where possible and involve management when the matter needs a decision. You will also help organize employee activities such as training, birthdays, small team events and other engagement activities. When an employee leaves the company, you will coordinate the exit process, including notice period follow-up, handover, company asset return, exit interview and documentation. A weekly HR update will also need to be prepared covering recruitment status, attendance, new joining's, employee issues, pending documentation and other important HR matters. If you notice repeated issues with attendance, employee behavior or any other HR matter, you should bring them to the management's attention instead of ignoring them. 
 What We Are Looking For : 
 Good communication skills (English) and the confidence to speak with employees and candidates. Someone who is comfortable making regular follow-up calls and messages. Good knowledge of basic HR and recruitment activities. Ability to conduct initial candidate discussions and understand whether a candidate is suitable for the position. Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with HRMS or other HR software will be an advantage. Good documentation and record-keeping habits. Ability to handle employee information with confidentiality. Someone who can remain calm while dealing with employee issues or difficult conversations. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes responsibility for their work and gets things done without needing constant supervision. 
 The Right Person For This Role : 
 The right person will be friendly and approachable with employees but will also know when to be firm. You should be comfortable working independently, following up with people and keeping track of several things at the same time. We do not expect you to make management-level decisions. We do expect you to identify problems, keep the management informed and make sure routine HR work does not get stuck. 
 Please Note : 
 Final decisions related to hiring, salary, increments, promotions, termination and major disciplinary matters will be taken by the Founder, CEO or the authorized manager.

description:
**Position:** Siemens PLC Automation Engineer **Location:** Ahmedabad, India **Training:** 2 Months in South Korea 
 ### Job Summary 
 We are seeking a skilled PLC Automation Engineer with experience in industrial automation, PLC programming, and automation line commissioning. The candidate will be responsible for developing, implementing, and commissioning automation systems while ensuring smooth integration of control systems, HMIs, and industrial communication networks. 
 ### Key Responsibilities 
 * Develop, program, and troubleshoot PLC control systems using Siemens PLC platforms. * Design, develop, and maintain HMI (Human Machine Interface) applications. * Integrate PLC systems with data collection and monitoring systems. * Perform control panel design and electrical circuit design for automation projects. * Commission and troubleshoot automated production lines at customer sites. * Configure and maintain Servo Drives, Inverters, Safety Controllers, and IO-Link systems. * Support machine installation, testing, startup, and performance optimization. * Coordinate with project teams to ensure successful project execution. * Prepare technical documentation, reports, and project records. 
 ### Qualifications 
 * Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. * Candidates with relevant specialized technical training in industrial automation are also encouraged to apply. 
 ### Required Skills & Experience 
 * 3-5 years of experience in industrial automation, PLC programming, or automation line commissioning. * Experience in Siemens PLC programming and system development. * Strong knowledge of HMI development and industrial communication systems. * Understanding of electrical control circuits and automation system design. * Hands-on experience with Servo Drives, Inverters, Safety Systems, and IO-Link technology. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). * Good communication skills in English. 
 ### Preferred Experience 
 * Experience in Battery Manufacturing, Automotive, Semiconductor, or related industries. * Experience leading automation projects or working as a key project team member. * Experience with secondary battery manufacturing facilities is preferred but not mandatory. 
 ### Employment Requirements 
 * Willingness to undergo approximately 2 months of training in South Korea. * Willingness to work in Ahmedabad, India. * Commitment to work with the company for a minimum of 3 years. * Willingness to work night shifts when required by project or customer demands. 
 ### Benefits 
 * International training opportunity in South Korea. * Exposure to advanced industrial automation technologies. * Opportunity to work on large-scale automation projects in automotive, battery, and semiconductor industries. Role & responsibilities

title: Immediate Hiring - Implementation Engineer
description:
We are looking for Industrial Deployment Engineers MES & IT/OT Integration who are interested in building a career in smart manufacturing, MES, Industry 4.0 and industrial digitalization. 
 You will work with manufacturing customers to understand their shop-floor processes and configure, integrate, test and deploy iTraceX for real-world manufacturing use cases. 
 This is a hands-on engineering and customer-site role , not a conventional software desk job. You will work across the complete industrial technology flow: Manufacturing Process Machine PLC/HMI Industrial Connectivity iTraceX/MES ERP & Enterprise Systems 
 Freshers are welcome. Selected candidates will receive training and project exposure across MES, manufacturing processes, industrial automation and IT/OT integration. 
 Roles & Responsibilities Understand customer manufacturing processes, production flow, stations and operational requirements. Understand production orders, routing, BOM/materials, WIP, quality, rework, rejection and traceability requirements. Translate manufacturing use cases into iTraceX/MES configurations and workflows . Configure and deploy iTraceX for customer-specific manufacturing requirements. Participate in onsite installation, integration, testing, commissioning and production go-live. Understand PLC/HMI signals, tags/registers, machine states, events and equipment handshakes required for MES integration. Work with customer automation teams, PLC programmers and machine/equipment suppliers. Work with industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP and related interfaces . Understand and troubleshoot IT/OT connectivity across machines, PLC/HMI, gateways, networks, servers and applications. Work with SQL/databases, REST APIs, JSON and system interfaces . Support integration with ERP, PLC/HMI, barcode scanners, industrial printers, RFID, vision systems and other shop-floor equipment. Perform functional, integration, negative, boundary, recovery and exception testing. Participate in FAT, SAT, UAT, commissioning, go-live and stabilization . Troubleshoot issues systematically across machine, PLC/HMI, connectivity, middleware, MES and enterprise systems. Perform root-cause analysis and coordinate issue resolution with customers, internal teams and external vendors. Work closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, IT and Automation teams. Prepare configuration documents, interface details, test cases, deployment records and RCA reports. Train customer operators, engineers and system users. Provide onsite and remote support during implementation and post-go-live stabilization. Follow configuration management, change management, version control and deployment practices. Take ownership of assigned activities through successful completion. 
 Candidate Profile We are looking for candidates who: Have strong logical and analytical thinking. Enjoy hands-on technical troubleshooting and problem solving. Are curious about how machines and manufacturing processes work. Have an interest in both IT/software and OT/industrial automation . Can approach problems systematically rather than through trial and error. Have basic computer and networking knowledge. Are willing to learn manufacturing, MES, PLC/HMI and integration technologies. Can communicate clearly with customers and technical teams. Are comfortable working in manufacturing/shop-floor environments. Are willing to travel extensively to customer locations. Are willing to support commissioning and go-live based on customer production schedules. Can work effectively with operators, engineers, IT teams, automation teams and equipment suppliers. Demonstrate ownership, discipline and professional behaviour at customer sites. Technical Skills Preferred / Good to Have Exposure to any of the following is an advantage: MES | PLC | HMI | SCADA | OPC UA | Modbus | Kepware | SQL | REST API | JSON | TCP/IP | Windows | Linux | Industrial Networking | Barcode/RFID | Industrial Printers | ERP | IIoT | Industry 4.0 | Traceability | Manufacturing Systems These skills are preferred but are not mandatory for freshers. Experience 0–3 Years Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Candidates with 1–3 years of experience in MES, PLC/HMI, SCADA, industrial automation, manufacturing IT, IIoT, system integration, industrial networking or application deployment will have an advantage. Prior MES experience is not mandatory. Travel Requirement: Candidates must be willing to travel and work at customer manufacturing facilities across India. Depending on business and project requirements, selected employees may also get opportunities for international customer deployments . Customer-site assignments may require staying at project locations for multiple days or weeks or months during implementation, commissioning go-live & hypercare. Career Growth- ThoughtMakes intends to develop selected candidates into engineers capable of working across the complete industrial execution environment. Typical career progression: Trainee Industrial Deployment Engineer Industrial Deployment Engineer Senior Industrial Deployment Engineer MES & Industrial Integration Specialist Technical/Solution Lead Solution Architect / Delivery Lead High-performing employees may get opportunities to participate in international projects and regional operations . Why Join This Role? This role provides an opportunity to build expertise across: Manufacturing + MES + Industrial Automation + OT + IT + System Integration Rather than specialising only in software or PLC programming, you will learn how manufacturing processes, machines, automation systems, industrial networks, MES and enterprise applications work together. Our objective is to develop engineers capable of going to a manufacturing facility, understanding the production requirement, interacting with production and automation teams, analysing IT/OT connectivity, configuring the MES solution, troubleshooting integration issues and taking the system successfully into production. 
 Interested candidates can share your resume to sowmiya.n@thoughtmakes.com; For further enquiry contact: N. Sowmiya HR Manager 7397748008

title: Information Security Manager
description:
About the Role We are looking for a hands-on and execution-oriented Information Security Manager to take end-to-end ownership of the organization's ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System (ISMS) while strengthening the organization's technical security, customer security assurance, Secure SDLC, and AI security practices. This is not a purely compliance or documentation-focused role. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that information security controls are continuously implemented, monitored, measured, evidenced, and improved throughout the year. The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating across GRC and technical security, independently driving security initiatives, managing audits and remediation, responding to customer security requirements, and translating security requirements into practical controls. Key Responsibilities 1. ISMS & ISO 27001 Operations 40% Own and continuously operate the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS. Manage policies, procedures, registers, risk assessments, SoA, and compliance obligations. Drive risk identification, treatment, monitoring, escalation, and closure. Define and track ISMS objectives, KPIs, corrective actions, and continuous improvement. Coordinate Management Reviews, internal audits, surveillance/recertification audits, and audit readiness. Drive security awareness, training, onboarding awareness, and phishing simulations. 2. Hands-on Technical Security 25% Manage VAPT, vulnerability scanning, remediation, and retesting. Review security configurations across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, AWS/Azure, and access controls. Drive least privilege, patch compliance, and periodic access reviews. Coordinate security incident triage, containment, RCA, corrective actions, and escalation. Support CERT-In reporting, security monitoring, threat intelligence, and control improvements. 3. Customer Security Assurance & Third-Party Risk 20% Own customer security questionnaires, assessments, due diligence, and audits. Conduct vendor and third-party security risk assessments. Review security requirements in NDAs, contracts, DPAs, and outsourcing arrangements. Support Sales/AM teams in customer security discussions and pre-sales engagements. Maintain security evidence, certification information, and a reusable security questionnaire/evidence library. 4. Secure SDLC & AI Security – 15% Drive Secure SDLC, secure coding, and application security practices. Support SAST, SCA, secret scanning, vulnerability management, and CI/CD security controls. Partner with engineering teams on security findings, project risks, architecture, and access reviews. Assess AI/LLM security risks, including prompt injection, data disclosure, excessive privileges, insecure outputs, and unauthorized access. Promote recognized AI and application security best practices Mandatory Qualifications & Experience 5–8+ years of relevant experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, GRC, ISMS, or a closely related domain. Strong hands-on experience in ISO/IEC 27001:2022 implementation and ISMS operations. Practical experience managing information security risk registers, risk assessments and treatment plans, Statement of Applicability (SoA), internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions, and audit readiness. Strong practical understanding of information security controls and their implementation within an organization. Experience in VAPT, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, and security findings management. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID security. Good understanding of cloud security across AWS and/or Azure. Experience coordinating information security incidents and response activities. Experience in responding to customer security questionnaires, assessments, and security due diligence requests. Good understanding of vendor and third-party security risk assessments. Understanding of Secure SDLC and application security practices. Exposure to SAST, SCA, secret scanning, CI/CD security controls, or similar application security practices. Awareness of emerging AI/LLM security risks. Strong documentation, analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills. Good to Have CISSP / CISM / ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or equivalent certification. Experience working in an IT services, software development, product engineering, or technology consulting organization. Experience supporting enterprise customers during security audits and due-diligence exercises. Knowledge of CERT-In and Indian information security compliance requirements. Knowledge of security frameworks such as CIS Controls, NIST CSF, OWASP, and OWASP ASVS / Top 10. Exposure to cloud security posture management and identity/security tools. Experience with AI Security, GenAI Security, or LLM application security assessments. Experience with enterprise security platforms, vulnerability management tools, SIEM, or security monitoring solutions. What We Are Looking For Hands-on and execution-oriented, rather than purely documentation-focused. Comfortable working across both GRC and technical security. Capable of independently driving security actions with IT, Engineering, Cloud, and Business teams. Confident interacting directly with enterprise customers and external auditors. Comfortable managing audits, evidence, remediation, risks, and deadlines throughout the year. Able to translate security and compliance requirements into practical and measurable controls. Strong in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration. Analytical, structured, detail-oriented, and capable of identifying security gaps proactively. Curious about emerging security risks, particularly cloud, applications, and AI security. Comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions. Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of an established ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS and play a key role in strengthening the organization’s overall information security maturity. The role provides exposure across ISMS, GRC, technical security, cloud security, application security, customer assurance, third-party risk, Secure SDLC, and emerging AI security, making it an ideal opportunity for a security professional looking to build a broad and impactful information security profile. If you enjoy turning security requirements into real-world controls, driving continuous improvement, and working closely with both technology and business teams, this role offers significant ownership and visibility.

Software Engineer III Java Developer | Kafka | Kubernetes Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
 Experience: 5+ Years
 Work Mode: Day Shift / Agile Collaboration
 Positions: 7
 Joining: Within 30 days of selection Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer III / Senior Java Developer with strong hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Kubernetes and Microservices Architecture . The ideal candidate should have experience developing and supporting enterprise-scale, distributed and highly available applications in a large corporate environment. You will be responsible for designing, developing, testing and troubleshooting secure, scalable production applications while contributing to system architecture, automation, resiliency and engineering best practices. Key Responsibilities Design and develop high-quality, production-grade applications using Java and Spring Boot . Develop scalable REST APIs and enterprise microservices . Design and implement event-driven solutions using Apache Kafka . Work with Kafka producers, consumers, topics, partitions, offsets and Kafka Streams. Develop and deploy microservices on Kubernetes environments. Manage Kubernetes deployments, pods, services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, HPA and RBAC. Troubleshoot production issues across application, Kafka and Kubernetes environments. Design resilient distributed systems using retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, bulkheads and graceful degradation . Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or ArgoCD. Work with SQL/NoSQL databases, including query optimization, indexing and schema design. Write unit and integration tests using JUnit, Mockito, TestContainers or equivalent frameworks . Follow secure coding practices and OWASP Top 10 principles. Participate in system design and contribute to architecture decisions for complex applications. Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment . Use enterprise-approved AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or Claude Code to improve development productivity while validating AI-generated code for quality, security and performance. Contribute to engineering standards, coding hygiene, automation and continuous improvement. Mandatory Technical Skills Candidates should have strong hands-on experience in the majority of the following areas: Java 8+ – 4+ years Spring Boot REST API Development Apache Kafka – 3+ years Kafka Streams Kubernetes – 3+ years Microservices Architecture – 3+ years CI/CD – 3+ years Jenkins / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / ArgoCD SQL and/or NoSQL databases System Design & Distributed Systems Application Resiliency JUnit / Mockito / TestContainers Secure Coding / OWASP Agile / Scrum Enterprise AI-assisted development tools Candidate Profile We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate real project-level experience , rather than candidates who have only listed technologies on their resumes. Candidates should be able to explain: What they built using Java/Spring Boot How Kafka was implemented in their project Kafka producer/consumer architecture How their applications were deployed on Kubernetes Their role in designing microservices CI/CD pipeline implementation Production troubleshooting experience System design and architecture decisions Resiliency mechanisms implemented Testing and code-quality practices How they have used AI coding assistants professionally Preferred Skills AWS / Azure / GCP AWS EKS / MSK / RDS / S3 / IAM Kafka on Kubernetes using Strimzi or Confluent Operator Financial Services / Banking / Payments experience GraphQL Splunk / Grafana / Prometheus React / Angular / Vue.js AI/ML or data engineering exposure Education Bachelor's degree such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology or an equivalent engineering discipline is preferred/required as per client criteria. Ideal Candidate 5+ years Software Engineering 4+ years Java/Spring Boot 3+ years Kafka 3+ years Kubernetes 3+ years Microservices 3+ years CI/CD System Design & Distributed Systems Production Resiliency & Troubleshooting Enterprise AI-assisted development experience Candidates with enterprise-scale or financial-services experience will be strongly preferred.

title: Artificial Intelligence Developer
description:
Agentic AI Developer Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Developer to design, develop, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, using tools, and executing multi-step workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Python, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, and agentic workflows , with the ability to integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications and data sources. The candidate will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and develop scalable, reliable, and production-ready Agentic AI solutions. Key Responsibilities Design and develop Agentic AI applications using LLMs, AI agents, and multi-step reasoning workflows. Build AI agents capable of planning, decision-making, tool/function calling, and autonomous task execution . Develop multi-agent and single-agent workflows for enterprise use cases. Build and integrate RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using enterprise documents and structured/unstructured data. Develop applications using Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks and libraries. Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, enterprise applications, and external tools . Implement function calling, tool use, memory, context management, and agent orchestration . Work with vector databases and embedding technologies to support semantic search and knowledge retrieval. Develop prompts and agent instructions and optimize them for accuracy, reliability, and task completion. Implement guardrails, validation, error handling, and human-in-the-loop mechanisms for AI agents. Evaluate and monitor agent performance, response quality, latency, reliability, and cost. Develop reusable AI components and frameworks that can be deployed across multiple business use cases. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI-driven solutions. Support deployment, troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI applications in production environments. Required Skills 4+ years of software development experience , with strong hands-on experience in Python. Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) . Strong experience developing AI Agents / Agentic AI workflows . Strong understanding of LLM-based application development . Experience with RAG architectures , embeddings, vector search, and knowledge retrieval. Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar platforms. Experience with agent frameworks/orchestration technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel , or equivalent. Strong experience with REST APIs, API integrations, JSON, and Python-based backend development . Experience working with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, or equivalent. Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, function/tool calling, and agent memory . Experience with SQL and working with structured and unstructured data. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Experience deploying AI solutions on Azure, AWS, or GCP . Experience with Azure OpenAI / Microsoft AI services . Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud deployment . Experience with AI observability, evaluation, and monitoring frameworks. Knowledge of AI safety, responsible AI, security, and LLM guardrails . Experience building enterprise-grade AI assistants, copilots, workflow automation, or autonomous agents. Experience integrating AI agents with enterprise applications, CRM, ERP, databases, or business APIs . Familiarity with Power BI, Power Platform, or other enterprise automation platforms is a plus. Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence , or a related field. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a hands-on Python + Generative AI developer with practical experience building Agentic AI solutions , not just prompt-based chatbots. Job Title: HR-People & Organization Manager Company: Sage Healthy Global Location: Avadi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India(Work from office) Position Type: Full-time; based in the Avadi office 
 Build a workplace where strong people join, grow, and stay. 
 Sage Healthy provides medical billing and revenue cycle management services to healthcare practices across the United States. Our Avadi team works with colleagues in North America to improve billing accuracy, reimbursement, and service delivery. Our people and technology underpin the quality and continuity of that work. 
 Position Summary: 
 The People & Organization Manager leads the full HR function for Sage Healthy Global, with accountability for recruitment, retention, rewards, recognition, employee relations, policies, and reliable HR administration. This is a hands-on management role that turns business needs into practical people initiatives and measurable improvements in hiring, employee experience, and team stability. 
 The manager partners with India operations, department leaders, Business Operations & Finance, and corporate leadership to build capable teams and support fair, consistent management. The role owns HR service quality and coaches or supervises assigned HR support staff, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and approval controls. 
 Responsibilities: 
 1. Recruitment and Onboarding Agree staffing priorities, job profiles, selection criteria, and hiring timelines with department managers within approved headcount and budgets. Build candidate pipelines through local networks, referrals, institutions, and relevant recruitment channels; lead structured screening, interviews, and offer coordination. Own joining readiness and onboarding, including documentation, induction, manager handoffs, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day check-ins; track early performance and retention. 
 2. Retention and Employee Engagement Identify preventable turnover through employee feedback, stay conversations, departure feedback, and analysis by team and tenure; agree corrective actions with managers. Run a practical engagement calendar and short employee surveys; communicate findings and follow through on agreed improvements. Support career conversations, internal mobility, and a positive employee experience for office-based and remote India staff. 
 3. Rewards and Recognition Review market information and internal pay consistency; recommend salary ranges, increments, benefits, and incentives with Finance and leadership approval. Administer approved compensation review and reward processes with documented criteria, budget checks, and clear employee communication. Build timely, fair recognition for individual and team contributions, service milestones, and company values; monitor participation across teams and work locations. 
 4. Performance and Development Coordinate goal setting, probation reviews, performance discussions, and development plans with clear deadlines and completion tracking. Coach managers on feedback, performance concerns, documentation, and fair treatment; support appropriate improvement plans and escalation. Identify training needs with department heads, coordinate delivery, and assess whether learning improves job performance and readiness for greater responsibility. 
 5. Employee Relations and Policies Provide an accessible, confidential channel for employee concerns; handle matters promptly, document outcomes, and escalate sensitive cases to designated leadership or advisers. Maintain clear people policies and support consistent application across hiring, attendance, leave, conduct, performance, and separation. Coordinate applicable employment compliance, workplace dignity and harassment-prevention processes, required training, and records with qualified local advisers. Promote respectful conduct and embed Sages values: One Team, Excellence, See It Through, Courage, and Growth. 
 6. HR Administration and Payroll Coordination Own accurate employee records, employment documentation, attendance and leave data, benefits administration, and timely updates in the HR system. Validate and submit payroll inputs, including joiners, leavers, attendance, and approved salary changes; resolve discrepancies with Business Operations & Finance. Coordinate employee benefit and statutory administration with Finance and advisers, maintaining clear owners and calendars for required actions. Manage separations, handovers, employee communications, and final-settlement inputs; coordinate access removal and asset return with Infrastructure & Support. 
 7. People Planning and Process Improvement Maintain a practical people plan aligned with staffing demand, organizational changes, and management priorities; flag capacity and succession risks early. Standardize HR workflows and service expectations, delegate routine tasks where resources permit, and improve HR system use and data quality. Coordinate confidentiality and security training with relevant teams; restrict employee information to authorized users and maintain appropriate records. 
 8. Reporting and Accountability Provide a concise monthly dashboard covering time to fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, voluntary turnover, engagement feedback, and recognition participation. Track timely onboarding, probation and performance reviews, payroll-input accuracy, and closure of employee concerns and agreed actions. Establish baselines and agree realistic targets with leadership within the first 60 days; review results monthly and own corrective actions with department managers. Operate within delegated authority. Obtain approval for headcount, compensation changes, incentive budgets, policy changes, and significant employment decisions. 
 Requirements: Ability to combine hands-on HR delivery with ownership of recruitment, retention, and employee engagement outcomes. Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through when handling sensitive employee and management matters. Ability to coach managers, resolve problems constructively, and collaborate across functions and locations. Clear written and spoken English and effective Tamil communication for the local workforce. Availability to work from Avadi and coordinate with international colleagues as required. 
 Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in human resources, business administration, psychology, or a related discipline; a postgraduate HR qualification is preferred. Experience: Typically 58 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years leading HR initiatives or a team, with evidence of improved hiring, retention, or engagement. Functional knowledge: Practical experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, compensation reviews, and HR administration. Local knowledge: Working knowledge of employment requirements and HR practices relevant to Tamil Nadu, with the judgment to seek specialist advice. Systems and analytics: Proficiency in an HR platform such as Keka, Microsoft Excel, and concise management reporting; ability to turn data into action. Industry exposure: Experience in medical billing, healthcare services, BPO, IT-enabled services, or a comparable service organization is preferred. 
 Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and role scope, paid monthly on the last working day. Annual vacation and personal time off follow company policy and applicable requirements. Bonus eligibility after the first year is subject to the approved scheme and employment terms. The role offers opportunities for professional growth. 
 Note: This profile outlines the principal responsibilities of the People & Organization Manager and may evolve with business needs. Management will confirm reporting arrangements, delegated authority, and individual performance targets.

Experience managing large-scale hybrid infrastructure environments. Experience supporting mission-critical enterprise platforms. title: Senior HR Executive (Operations & Keka HRMS Specialist)
description:
About the Role We are looking for a dynamic and highly experienced Senior HR Executive to take complete ownership of our core HR operations. This role is built for a true HR technologist and operations expert who possesses a flawless, inside-out understanding of Keka HRMS. 
 As a Senior HR Executive, you will act as the backbone of our employee lifecycle, managing everything from seamless onboarding to graceful exits. You will ensure our payroll runs without a hitch, our workplace culture remains vibrant, and our organization remains 100% compliant with Indian labor laws and IT industry standards. If you are a process-driven HR professional who knows how to leverage technology to automate and streamline HR functions, we want you on our team.
 Who You Are Personality & Interpersonal: You have a chirpy and bubbly personality that naturally connects with people. Highly emotionally intelligent, you can easily read the mood of the workforce and are deeply passionate about fostering a positive work environment. Drive & Ownership: You are driven, ambitious, and actively looking to transform into an HR Manager role. You take full ownership of the HR function, working closely with leadership to proactively identify improvement areas and close those gaps. Functional Expertise: You possess strong operational HR skills, are deeply knowledgeable about payroll and statutory compliance, and are skilled in compensation planning. Crucially, you have a strong willingness to grow from operational tasks into strategic HR leadership. Systems & Efficiency Mindset: You are comfortable leveraging AI to drive efficiency and productivity. You focus heavily on building resilient systems and processes that teams can learn from, effectively reducing the organization's dependency on any single individual. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Keka HRMS Mastery & Data Insights Act as the absolute Subject Matter Expert (SME) and primary administrator for our Keka HRMS platform. Flawlessly configure, update, and manage all Keka modules, including Leave & Attendance, Payroll, Performance Management, and Expense flows. Create and automate backend workflows and customized reports. Prepare weekly and monthly HR reports that surface workforce-related challenges in alignment with business priorities. Troubleshoot system glitches, adapt the platform to evolving company policies, and train staff on using the portal effectively. 
 2. End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management Onboarding: Handle pre-joining and onboarding formalities. Generate offer letters, conduct thorough background verifications (BGV), set up IT assets, and execute engaging induction programs. Offboarding/Exits: Manage seamless exit formalities, conduct empathetic exit interviews, manage departmental clearances, and ensure accurate Full & Final (FnF) settlements. 
 3. Payroll, Compensation & Budgeting Manage end-to-end pre-payroll activities, ensuring 100% accuracy in leave, attendance, and loss of pay (LOP) data within Keka. Oversee salary structuring, tax declarations, and take charge of compensation planning. Propose and manage the overall HR budget, working closely with the founders to allocate sufficient budget for high-impact employee welfare and engagement activities. Coordinate with the Finance/Accounts team to process monthly payroll on time, resolving grievances promptly. 
 4. Performance Management & Team Leadership Oversee and manage a 360 performance appraisal system that drives high performance and continuous growth across the company. Mentor junior HR team members , conducting regular 1:1s and empowering the team to achieve more. Promote a results-driven culture while actively maintaining high team morale. 
 5. Employee Experience & Relations Interact with remote and in-office employees, maintaining a healthy balance and cohesive culture between the remote and in-person experience. Design and execute high-impact employee engagement initiatives, team-building activities, and workplace wellness programs tailored to IT professionals. Act as the first point of contact for employee grievances, resolving conflicts professionally, empathetically, and in strict adherence to company policies. 
 6. Statutory Compliance & IT Industry Standards Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of Indian labor laws applicable to the IT sector (e.g., Shops and Establishments Act, Maternity Benefit Act, POSH). Ensure strict compliance and timely remittance of all statutory deductions (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, and Gratuity). Stay updated on changing labor regulations and minimum wage revisions to advise management on risk mitigation. 
 7. Core HR Administration Draft, update, and enforce HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs), ensuring these processes are well-documented for the team. Maintain highly confidential employee records, organizational charts, and digital files securely. 
 Qualifications & Requirements Experience: 6 to 7 years of proven experience in HR Operations, preferably within the IT/Software Services industry. Keka Proficiency (Mandatory): Must have advanced, hands-on administrative experience with Keka HRMS. You should know how to configure policies from scratch and troubleshoot backend settings. Compliance Knowledge: Deep, practical understanding of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, PT), and payroll processing. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of drafting professional internal communications, policies, and managing vendor relations. Problem-Solving: High emotional intelligence, discretion with confidential information, and a proactive approach to conflict resolution. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 What Sets You Apart Previous experience independently implementing or migrating an organization to Keka HRMS. Strong data analysis skills using Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, Pivot tables) in conjunction with Keka data exports.

Key Skills: KEKA HRMS,HRIS,Statutory Compliance,MIS Reporting,HR Policies,Payroll,Employee Engagement,Performance Management

description:
TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST 
 Job Description 
 Company 
 Indraprasstha Green Energy LLP 
 Human Resources 
 Department 
 Employment Type 
 Role 
 Full-Time 
 Talent Acquisition Specialist 
 Job Summary 
 The Talent Acquisition Specialist will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment activities while also 
 supporting key HR operations including onboarding, payroll coordination, attendance management, and statutory 
 compliance. The role will ensure timely hiring of quality talent, smooth joining processes, accurate payroll inputs, 
 proper employee documentation, and adherence to applicable labour laws and company policies. 
 Talent Acquisition & Recruitment 
 Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned positions, from understanding manpower requirements through 
 offer acceptance and joining. 
 
 Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, recruitment consultants, professional 
 networks, and other relevant channels. 
 
 Screen resumes, conduct preliminary discussions, assess candidate suitability, and prepare shortlists for hiring 
 managers. 
 
 Coordinate interviews, assessments, feedback, reference checks, and selection processes. 
 
 Maintain an active talent pipeline for critical and recurring positions. 
 
 Prepare and issue offer letters and coordinate salary discussions and joining formalities. 
 
 Track recruitment metrics such as open positions, source effectiveness, time-to-fill, offer-to-joining ratio, and 
 hiring status. 
 
 Build a strong candidate experience and maintain professional communication throughout the recruitment cycle. 
 
 Employee Onboarding & HR Operations 
 Coordinate pre-joining documentation, background verification, induction, and onboarding activities. 
 
 Ensure timely creation and maintenance of employee files, HRMS records, and personnel documentation. 
 
 Coordinate employee offboarding, exit documentation, full-and-final inputs, and exit interviews. 
 
 Support employee engagement initiatives and address routine employee queries professionally. 
 
 Maintain confidentiality of employee and recruitment information. 
 
 Payroll & Attendance 
 Coordinate monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, salary revisions, incentives, 
 deductions, and other employee changes. 
 
 Verify attendance, leave records, timesheets, and payroll-related data for accuracy before processing. 
 
 Liaise with payroll service providers or internal finance teams to ensure timely and accurate salary processing. 
 
 Support resolution of employee payroll and salary-related queries. 
 
 Assist in maintaining payroll records and reconciliation of payroll-related information. 
 
 Statutory Compliance 
 Support compliance with applicable labour and employment laws, rules, and company policies. 
 
 
 
 Coordinate statutory payroll-related requirements such as PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, and other applicable 
 deductions and filings, as relevant to the organization. 
 
 Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, declarations, and compliance records as required. 
 
 
 Coordinate with external consultants, payroll vendors, and relevant authorities for routine statutory compliance 
 matters. 
 Track compliance calendars, renewal dates, filings, payments, and documentation to help ensure timely 
 completion. 
 
 Assist with audits, inspections, notices, and statutory documentation when required. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 
 
 
 MBA/PGDM in HR preferred. 
 25 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition/Recruitment with exposure to payroll and statutory 
 compliance. 
 Experience in independently handling recruitment mandates and coordinating with hiring managers. 
 Hands-on exposure to payroll inputs, attendance, employee records, and statutory HR processes preferred. 
 
 
 Required Skills 
 Strong sourcing, interviewing, candidate assessment, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. 
 Working knowledge of recruitment portals, LinkedIn, HRMS, and MS Office/Google Workspace. 
 Practical understanding of payroll processes and statutory compliance requirements. 
 Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate HR and compliance documentation. 
 Good organizational, multitasking, follow-up, and time-management abilities. 
 High level of confidentiality, integrity, professionalism, and ownership. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Time-to-fill and time-to-hire for open positions. 
 
 Quality of hire and offer-to-joining ratio. 
 
 Recruitment pipeline strength and source effectiveness. 
 
 Recruitment cost and agency/source performance, where applicable. 
 
 Onboarding completion and candidate/employee experience. 
 
 Payroll input accuracy and timeliness. 
 
 Attendance and employee-record accuracy. 
 
 Timely completion of statutory filings, payments, registers, and compliance documentation.

 Department: Real Estate Sales Primary & Resale
 Employment Type: Full-time Job Summary We are looking for a result-driven Real Estate Sales Manager / Sales Team Lead with strong experience in the Bengaluru residential real estate market. The role will be responsible for managing the complete sales cycle from lead management and customer engagement to site visits, negotiations, deal closure, and post-sales coordination . The ideal candidate should have a proven track record in residential real estate sales and closures , strong customer-handling and negotiation skills, and the ability to work independently as well as lead and motivate a sales team. Experience in primary sales, resale, builder projects, channel partner (CP) sales, or mandate projects will be an advantage. Conduct and coordinate property/project site visits and project presentations . Develop effective sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets. Identify new business opportunities and contribute to overall sales growth. Lead Management & CRM Manage and maintain accurate lead, customer and sales information in the CRM. Track leads, follow-ups, site visits, conversions and sales closures. Ensure timely follow-up with prospective buyers throughout the sales cycle. Monitor lead conversion and identify opportunities to improve sales performance. Coordinate with the pre-sales team to ensure effective lead allocation and follow-up. Negotiation & Deal Closure Drive end-to-end sales closure for residential real estate properties. Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and other deal-related requirements with customers. Handle customer objections and resolve concerns to facilitate successful closures. Coordinate with builder/developer sales teams, CRM, legal and other internal stakeholders to ensure smooth transaction closure. Maintain strong relationships with customers to generate referrals and repeat business. Team Management & Performance Lead, mentor and motivate sales team members to achieve individual and team targets. Conduct regular team meetings to review performance, pipeline, site visits and closures. Set objectives and provide continuous guidance and feedback to improve team productivity. Monitor key sales metrics including leads, site visits, conversion ratios, revenue and closures. Support team members in negotiations and complex customer situations where required. Foster a performance-driven and collaborative sales environment. Property & Market Management Maintain awareness of Bengaluru's residential real estate market, including locations, projects, pricing and customer trends. Develop and maintain relationships with property developers, builders, channel partners and other stakeholders . Where applicable, support property listing management across real estate portals and ensure property information is accurate and updated. Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify new sales opportunities. Reporting & Compliance Prepare regular sales performance, pipeline and conversion reports. Provide sales forecasts and business updates to management. Ensure accurate documentation and adherence to company processes, regulations and ethical sales practices. Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the sales process. Mandatory Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field . 2–7 years of relevant experience in residential real estate sales . Experience in Mandate Projects . Prior experience managing or mentoring a sales team. Existing relationships with builders, developers, channel partners or real estate stakeholders. Experience with real estate portals and property listing platforms. Strong understanding of Bengaluru micro-markets, pricing and residential property trends.
