title: Finance Controller/Manager
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a Head of Finance / Finance Controller to take ownership of the finance function at Habanero Foods. This is a high-ownership role for someone who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and can independently manage the core finance function while partnering closely with the founder and the CFO. The role will cover accounting, financial reporting, MIS, AR/AP, inventory, cash flow forecasting, cash management, compliance, controls and commercial finance. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to build and lead a finance team as the business scales. 
 Role & responsibilities : 1.Finance & Accounting Own day-to-day finance and accounting operations. Drive timely monthly book closure and ensure accuracy of accounting records. Prepare monthly P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and management MIS. Ensure accurate accounting of revenue, expenses, inventory, receivables and payables. Improve accounting processes and finance systems. Coordinate with auditors, tax advisors and external stakeholders. 2. MIS & Business Reporting Own the monthly MIS and management reporting process. Prepare variance analysis against budgets, forecasts and prior periods. Develop business dashboards and management KPIs. Provide insights on revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, operating costs and profitability. Partner with the CFO and Founder on financial and business analysis. Develop reporting to enable faster and informed business decisions. 3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Own weekly and monthly cash flow forecasting. Maintain rolling cash flow forecasts and proactively identify funding requirements and cash gaps. Monitor collections, vendor payments, inventory and overall working capital. Drive improvements in the cash conversion cycle. Support cash management, banking and treasury activities. Partner with the Founder and CFO on working capital strategy and funding requirements. 4. Accounts Receivable & Payable Own the AR and AP function. Monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve deductions, claims and disputes. Ensure timely and accurate vendor payments. Establish effective credit, collection and payment processes. Track ageing and working capital metrics and proactively escalate issues. 5. Quick Commerce & Marketplace Finance Own financial reconciliations across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart and other platforms. Reconcile platform sales, settlements, commissions, discounts, claims, deductions, marketing spends and other charges. Identify and recover incorrect deductions, claims and short payments. Track platform-wise revenue, gross margin and contribution margin. Partner with sales and operations teams to improve channel profitability. Establish robust marketplace reconciliation and settlement tracking processes. Prior experience with quick-commerce or marketplace platforms will be an advantage. 6. Inventory & Cost Management Own inventory accounting and stock reconciliation. Monitor inventory levels, ageing, stock movement and holding periods. Analyse product-level gross margins and manufacturing costs. Track wastage, expiry, write-offs and inventory variances. Support costing and financial evaluation of new product launches. Partner with operations and supply chain teams to identify cost optimisation opportunities. 7. Budgeting & Financial Planning Support annual budgeting and business planning. Prepare rolling forecasts and periodic reforecasts. Build financial models for new products, channels and growth initiatives. Analyse profitability across products, channels and customers. Support decisions on pricing, promotions, marketing spends and channel expansion. 8. Compliance & Financial Controls Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate statutory and tax audits. Strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs. Establish controls across procurement, inventory, sales, collections and payments. Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes. 9. Team Building & Finance Function Development Build and develop the finance team as the business scales. Define roles, responsibilities and processes within the finance function. Mentor and develop finance team members. Establish scalable finance processes and controls. Build a finance function that supports the companys transition from an entrepreneurial setup to a larger, professionally managed organisation Qualification CA preferred CMA / MBA (Finance) with strong relevant experience may also be considered. Strong accounting and finance fundamentals are essential. Experience 46 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts / Financial Controllership. Experience in D2C, FMCG, Food & Beverage, e-commerce, consumer brands or quick commerce strongly preferred. Experience managing a finance function independently will be an advantage. Experience with Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart or similar marketplace platforms is highly desirable. Strong experience in AR/AP, inventory accounting, working capital and cash flow management . Experience in a high-growth entrepreneurial environment preferred. Technical Skills Strong accounting and financial reporting knowledge. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills. Experience with Zoho Books, Tally or similar ERP/accounting systems . Strong understanding of GST, TDS and statutory compliance. Experience in MIS preparation, budgeting and financial analysis. Strong understanding of inventory and cost accounting. Ability to build and maintain cash flow forecasts.

description:
About Company 
 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart. BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. Proven experience managing end-to-end AR and AP processes, including invoicing, collections, vendor payments, and reconciliations. Exposure to internal and external audits and the ability to support audit requirements independently. Mandatory hands-on experience in SAP (FI/CO preferred). Strong MS Excel skills with the ability to analyze and reconcile large volumes of financial data. Experience working in SLA-driven and deadline-oriented environments. title: Audit & Accounts Executive (UK Audit + Year-End Accounts)
description:
We are seeking a ACCA or part-qualified, detail-oriented Audit & Accounts Semi-Senior (ACCA preferred) to join Ark India (Support) Pvt Ltd , a subsidiary of Ark & Co Ltd (UK) . This is a dual-focus role covering UK statutory audits and preparation of year-end financial statements under FRS 102 / FRS 105. The ideal candidate will have hands-on exposure to UK audit methodology, strong technical accounting knowledge, and the ability to take ownership of sections of an audit file and a set of year-end accounts from planning through to completion. Working from our Pitampura, Delhi office as part of an international cross-border team. Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Statutory Audit (UK GAAP / ISA (UK)): Execute planning, fieldwork, and completion procedures on UK statutory audits under ISA (UK) , working under the direction of UK-based managers and the Responsible Individual (RI). Prepare audit working papers on areas such as revenue, purchases, payroll, fixed assets, cash & bank, debtors, creditors, accruals, prepayments, and related party transactions. Perform risk assessment, walkthroughs, tests of controls, substantive analytical procedures, and detailed substantive testing with appropriate sampling. Draft and refine audit file sections on CaseWare, Mercia, IRIS, or similar audit software, ensuring documentation meets ISA (UK) evidence and cross-referencing standards. Identify and escalate audit issues, control weaknesses, misstatements, and potential adjusting journal entries; draft management letter points. Support completion procedures analytical review, going concern assessment, subsequent events, and management representation letters. 
 Year-End Accounts Preparation: Prepare statutory financial statements for UK limited companies under FRS 102 (including Section 1A) and FRS 105 , in accordance with the Companies Act 2006. Post year-end adjustments depreciation, accruals, prepayments, deferred/current tax, dividends, directors' loans, corporation tax provisions and roll forward trial balances. Draft primary statements (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss / Income Statement, Cash Flow where applicable) with supporting notes and required disclosures. Assist in preparing corporation tax computations (CT600) and iXBRL tagging where required, coordinating with the tax team. Reconcile prior-year comparatives, ensure consistency with statutory filings, and prepare files for RI/manager review. 
 Compliance & Coordination: Support VAT return reviews, HMRC filings, and confirm all engagements meet UK accounting, auditing, and tax standards. Liaise with UK-based managers, partners, and clients (via email/calls under supervision) to resolve queries and request supporting information. Ensure secure, confidential handling of client data in line with GDPR and firm-wide information security policies. 
 Continuous Improvement & Client Service: Identify and propose incremental improvements to audit and accounts preparation processes, checklists, and templates. Support the UK team in delivering excellent client service through clear communication, sound time management, and proactive follow-up. Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Educational Background: ACCA (qualified or part-qualified), CA Inter (IPCC / Intermediate cleared) . Sound working knowledge of FRS 102, FRS 105, and ISA (UK) ; familiarity with the Companies Act 2006 disclosure framework. 
 Experience: 1 - 4 years of relevant experience in a UK-based accounting or audit practice (in-house UK firm or Indian GDC/KPO servicing UK clients). Demonstrable exposure to UK statutory audits and year-end accounts preparation candidates with pure bookkeeping backgrounds only will not be suitable. Prior experience across sectors such as owner-managed businesses, property/SPVs, professional services, or financial services will be an advantage. 
 Technical Skills: Proficient in CaseWare, Mercia, IRIS Accounts Production, ProAudit, or similar audit and accounts production software. Working knowledge of Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, and IRIS bookkeeping modules for extracting trial balances and reviewing underlying records. Strong Excel skills lookups, pivot tables, reconciliations, and audit sampling. Understanding of UK corporation tax, VAT, and HMRC filing processes at a supporting level. 
 Soft Skills: Strong written and verbal English communication comfortable drafting audit queries and client-facing emails. High attention to detail, professional scepticism, and ownership of assigned sections. Ability to collaborate across UKIndia time zones and meet tight statutory deadlines. Integrity, punctuality, and reliability; open to feedback and continuous learning. Awareness of UK business culture and firm-facing professionalism is a plus. 
 What to Expect in This Role Mentorship: Direct guidance from experienced UK-based Audit Managers and the Responsible Individual (RI). Technical Growth: Exposure to a broad portfolio of UK statutory audits and year-end accounts across multiple industries. Integration: A genuine cross-border team seat – not siloed back-office work – with visibility on end-to-end engagement delivery. Impact: Your work will feed directly into signed audit opinions and filed statutory accounts for UK clients. Compensation: Competitive salary, based on relevant experience and qualifications.

title: Accountant
description:
Job Description Accountant (US Accounting) Position: Accountant – US Accounting
 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Shift: 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST
 Employment Type: Full-time About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Accountant to join our team in Noida and support US accounting operations . The ideal candidate should have hands-on exposure to General Ledger (GL), Record-to-Report (R2R) processes and accounting platforms such as QuickBooks and Xero . The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, performing accounting activities, supporting month-end close, and ensuring timely and accurate reporting. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day accounting activities for US-based clients/entities.
 Perform General Ledger (GL) accounting and ensure accurate account maintenance.
 Handle Record-to-Report (R2R) activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations and month-end closing.
 Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, provisions and reclassifications.
 Perform bank, balance sheet and account reconciliations .
 Assist with month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities.
 Maintain accurate books of accounts in QuickBooks and/or Xero .
 Review transactions and ensure compliance with accounting policies and procedures.
 Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies and unusual transactions.
 Prepare schedules, reports and supporting documentation for management and clients.
 Coordinate with internal teams and stakeholders to resolve accounting-related queries.
 Ensure timely completion of assigned accounting activities while maintaining accuracy and quality.
 Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related field .
 3–8 years of relevant experience in accounting, preferably with exposure to US accounting .
 Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and/or Xero .
 Good understanding of GL and R2R processes .
 Strong knowledge of journal entries, reconciliations, accruals and month-end close.
 Good understanding of accounting principles and financial statements.
 Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
 Good communication and interpersonal skills.
 Proficiency in MS Excel and other accounting tools.
 Willingness to work in the 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST shift.
 Preferred Experience working with US clients or US GAAP .
 Experience in an accounting outsourcing/BPO environment.
 Exposure to month-end close and financial reporting.
 Knowledge of AP/AR processes would be an added advantage.
 What We’re Looking For A proactive and responsible accounting professional who can independently manage accounting activities, maintain high accuracy, and work effectively with US-based teams and clients during the designated shift.

title: Equity Research Analyst
company: Old Rice Assets Management And Advisors Private Li Mited
description:
Equity Research Analyst Job Description Location: Mumbai
 Department: Investments / Equity Research
 Reporting to: Fund Manager / CIO / Head of Research Role Objective Identify high-quality, mispriced investment opportunities in Indian equities through rigorous fundamental research, financial modelling, primary research and continuous monitoring. The analyst is expected to develop an independent investment view , clearly articulate upside/downside and actively track whether the original investment thesis is playing out. Key Responsibilities Company & Sector Research Conduct deep fundamental research on assigned companies/sectors. Understand business model, industry structure, competitive advantages, market size, growth drivers and key risks. Analyse annual reports, financial statements, investor presentations, exchange filings, credit-rating reports and other relevant information. Study competitors, customers, suppliers and the broader value chain. Conduct channel checks and primary research wherever useful. Financial Analysis & Modelling Build and maintain detailed P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow models . Forecast revenue, margins, working capital, capex, cash flows, ROCE/ROE and earnings. Identify the 35 operating KPIs that actually drive each company's earnings. Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis Bull / Base / Bear . Reconcile reported profits with cash generation and balance-sheet movement. Valuation Apply appropriate valuation methodologies including P/E, EV/EBITDA, DCF, SOTP, P/B, FCF yield, EV/Sales , etc. Compare valuations against history, peers and underlying business quality. Establish fair value, expected return and downside risk rather than merely assigning a target price. Investment Idea Generation Continuously screen the listed universe for new opportunities. Generate differentiated investment ideas rather than depending only on broker recommendations. Prepare concise investment notes covering:
 Thesis Why Now Earnings Drivers Valuation Catalysts Risks What Can Go Wrong. Present recommendations to the Fund Manager / Investment Committee. Management & Industry Interaction Attend management meetings, earnings calls, analyst meets, AGMs and industry conferences. Interact with suppliers, distributors, customers, competitors and industry experts where appropriate. Assess management quality, integrity, capital allocation and corporate governance . Maintain a structured question bank before management interactions. Portfolio Monitoring Continuously track portfolio companies and watchlist names. Review quarterly results against our estimates rather than consensus alone . Immediately identify material changes in earnings, industry structure, regulation, management commentary or competitive intensity. Maintain a clear thesis tracker : what has changed, what has not, and what would invalidate the investment case. Research Documentation & Discipline Maintain updated financial models, valuation sheets, investment notes and research databases. Document investment assumptions and subsequent changes. Maintain historical management guidance versus actual delivery. Follow applicable compliance, confidentiality and research standards. Where the role falls within SEBI's Research Analyst regulatory framework, applicable qualification/certification and conduct requirements must also be followed. 
 Preferred candidate profile MBA (Finance) with minimum 5 years of equity research experience at SEBI registered institutions. 
 Perks and benefits As per Company Policy

title: Financial Controller
description:
Role & responsibilities Core Responsibilities: 1 
 Financial Accounting & Reporting: Oversee accurate accounting and reporting of all financial transactions in compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and company policies. Ensure timely and reliable financial statements and reports to support strategic decision-making. 2 
 Day-to-Day Accounting Operations: Supervise daily accounting functions including Accounts Receivable (AR) , Accounts Payable (AP) , general ledger, journal entries, and bank reconciliations to ensure data integrity and adherence to internal controls. 3 
 AR & AP Review: Review Accounts Receivable for timely billing, collections, and credit management; oversee Accounts Payable for vendor payments, reconciliations, and compliance with internal authorization processes. Conduct periodic aging and working capital analysis. 4 
 Treasury and Cash Flow Management: Monitor customer receipts and vendor payments to maintain efficient cash flow and working capital. Prepare and review cash flow statements (actual vs forecast) to ensure optimal liquidity planning. Maintain strong banking relationships , manage fund movements, and ensure optimal utilization of banking facilities. 5 
 Capex Monitoring and Capitalization: Review and track Capex projects , ensuring correct classification and capitalization as per Ind AS 16. Maintain fixed asset registers, monitor CWIP, and ensure accurate depreciation accounting. 6 
 Month-End and Year-End Closing: Lead monthly and annual closing activities including reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and preparation of financial reports within strict timelines. 7 
 MIS, Forecasting, and Budget Reporting: Prepare and consolidate MIS reports , budgets , and financial forecasts using Oracle HFM (Hyperion Financial Management) and Excel-based tools. Perform detailed variance analysis (Actual vs Budget vs Forecast) and provide actionable insights for management decision-making. 8 
 Management Reporting & Performance Review: Prepare and deliver monthly performance presentations to the Engineering Director and Group Engineering Head , highlighting key financial results, cost trends, and operational variances. Present analysis with improvement recommendations to drive business and engineering efficiency. 9 
 Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management: Interact with the global management team on all finance-related topics including reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and compliance. Collaborate closely with plant finance and cross-functional engineering teams to support financial planning, cost control, and performance improvement initiatives. 10 
 Budgeting and Forecasting: Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting process. Track performance, analyze deviations, and support strategic planning and target setting. 11 
 Taxation: Manage Direct Tax and Indirect Tax (GST) compliance, return filing, reconciliations, and assessments. Ensure adherence to statutory deadlines and effective tax planning within the regulatory framework. 12

title: Head of Managed IT Services India
description:
Head of Managed IT Services India 
 Location: Chennai (preferred)
 Level: Director / AVP
 Employment: Full-time
 Reporting to: CEO / Managing Director
 Team: Service Delivery, Service Desk, Infrastructure/NOC and People Operations
 Working Hours: Must have daily overlap with US Eastern Time (approximately 7:30 PM11:30 PM IST)
 Travel: 2 to 3 trips to the US in the first year, plus occasional travel in India
 About the Role 
A 10-year-old health tech company is building a new managed IT Services delivery centre in India to support mid-sized companies and nonprofit organisations in the US.
We are looking for a senior leader who can build this operation from the ground up, hire the team, set up processes, launch the first client, and then manage the business as it grows.
This is not a traditional IT operations manager role. The person will be responsible for building a high-quality service organisation that US clients can trust with their day-to-day IT operations.
 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 1. Build the India IT Services Centre 
 Design the overall operating model for the India delivery centre. Decide the team structure, responsibilities, working shifts and staffing requirements. Select and implement the required IT service management and monitoring tools. Set up the required office infrastructure, security controls and business continuity arrangements. Establish relationships with local IT service partners who can provide on-site support for US clients. Create clear service processes, escalation procedures and operating guidelines. 2. Build and Lead the Team 
The initial team is expected to include:
 Service Desk Lead IT Support Engineers Level 1 and Level 2 Network / Infrastructure Engineer Microsoft 365 / Intune specialist NOC / Monitoring Engineer Cloud / Backup support Service Delivery Manager HR / Recruitment support Key responsibilities include:
 Hire the initial team. Define job descriptions and selection criteria. Create practical technical assessments and interview processes. Develop an onboarding and training programme. Ensure adequate backup resources for critical skills. Manage employee retention, especially for US-shift roles. Build a talent pipeline for future growth. 3. Launch and Transition the First Client 
The successful candidate will lead the transition of the first US client into companys managed IT services.
This includes:
 Understanding the client's existing IT environment and processes. Planning the transition from the current service provider/team to the company. Creating documentation, operating procedures and knowledge-transfer plans. Conducting testing before taking responsibility for live IT operations. Ensuring the team is ready before the client goes live. Managing major incidents and escalations during the transition. Clearly defining what Aigilx will and will not support. Important: The candidate must be comfortable managing a client transition from the beginning through to stable day-to-day operations.
 4. Manage Service Quality 
Once the centre is operational, the Head will be responsible for service quality and client satisfaction.
Key measures include:
 SLA performance meeting agreed response and resolution times. Customer satisfaction (CSAT). First-contact resolution. Ticket resolution time. Reopened tickets. Successful IT changes. Backup and recovery testing. Major incident management. The leader will regularly review performance with US clients and take corrective action where required.
 5. Manage Security and Compliance 
The candidate must ensure that employees follow strong IT security practices, including:
 Appropriate access controls. Limited administrative access. Secure handling of client information. Regular review of employee access. No use of personal devices for sensitive client information. Compliance with applicable Indian employment and data-protection requirements. Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, healthcare or HIPAA-related environments will be an advantage.
 6. Manage the Business and P&L 
This is also a business leadership role.
The candidate will:
 Own the financial performance of the India delivery unit. Manage staffing costs and utilisation. Monitor profitability. Help develop pricing for IT services. Support proposals and presentations for US clients. Work with the sales team to win new business. Grow the operation after the first client is stable. Ensure the business does not hire significantly ahead of confirmed client demand. What We Are Looking For 
 Must-Have Experience 
The ideal candidate should have:
 Experience 
 12+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, IT service management or managed IT services. At least 6 years of experience managing an IT delivery operation serving US or UK clients from India. Experience working in an MSP, GCC, captive centre or similar IT services organisation. Experience building or significantly expanding an IT delivery team. Experience taking at least one client from transition/implementation to stable operations. Experience managing US-shift/night-shift teams. Experience managing service delivery, client escalations and operational performance. Technical Understanding 
The person does not necessarily need to be the strongest hands-on engineer but must understand the major IT areas being delivered.
They should have good working knowledge of:
 Microsoft 365 Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory Microsoft Intune End-user IT support Networks and firewalls VPN IT monitoring / NOC operations Backup and disaster recovery Azure or AWS IT service management / ITIL Experience with technologies such as Fortinet and Veeam is useful.
 Leadership & Business Skills 
Look for candidates who can demonstrate:
 Strong people leadership. Client management skills. Excellent spoken and written English. Experience dealing directly with US senior IT leaders. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to manage high-pressure incidents. Experience managing budgets and operational costs. Understanding of utilisation, profitability and pricing. Ability to build processes and operating discipline. Strong documentation and governance mindset. Preferred Experience 
These are good-to-have, not mandatory :
 Healthcare or nonprofit IT services experience. HIPAA-aware environments. SOC 2 or ISO 27001 implementation experience. Experience managing third-party IT vendors/specialists. P&L ownership. Existing professional network/talent pool in Chennai or Hyderabad. Education 
 Minimum: Bachelors degree in engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
 Preferred certifications: 
 ITIL Microsoft certifications Fortinet Veeam PMP/PRINCE2 is an advantage, particularly for transition/project management.
An MBA is an advantage but is not a substitute for relevant IT delivery experience.
 Ideal Candidate will be Someone who: 
 Has built and operated an IT services centre , rather than only managed an existing team. Is comfortable working with US clients and US working hours. Can communicate confidently with senior US stakeholders. Takes ownership when there is a major client issue. Builds strong processes and documentation. Can say No when a client asks for work outside the agreed scope. Understands both technology and business. Can build a team that eventually operates without depending on the Head for every decision. Is comfortable being hands-on during the initial setup but can gradually move into a leadership role. First-Year Success Measures 
The successful candidate is expected to achieve the following:
 First 30 days 
 Finalise operating model and team structure. Identify required tools. Create hiring plan. Prepare first-client transition plan. First 60 days 
 Key leadership positions hired. IT service management system ready. Shift structure established. Local service partners identified. First 90 days 
 Core team in place. Team training completed. Major incident simulation completed. Ready for first client launch. By Month 6 
 First client operating successfully. SLA and service-quality targets achieved. Customer satisfaction of approximately 4.2/5 or higher. Annualised attrition below 18%. By Month 12 
 India unit has clear P&L visibility. SOC 2 preparation underway. Second client contracted or close to signing. Delivery centre can operate effectively without depending on the Head every day. 
 
 Compensation 
Best in the Industry
US travel will be part of the role, particularly during the first year.

title: Assistant Manager - Finance
description:
Assistant Manager Finance 
 The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As Indias first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build whats next. If youre driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, youll feel right at home here. 
 About the Role This is a high-impact role within the finance function of one of India’s fastest-scaling fintech and crypto platforms. You will play a key role in driving revenue assurance for the core business, building meaningful MIS and reporting frameworks, managing entity-level accounting and reporting, and leading automation initiatives across finance operations. The role offers hands-on exposure to VDA accounting across multiple entities and the opportunity to solve complex finance challenges across crypto, treasury, banking, and global operations while building scalable processes and controls for the future of digital finance. 
 What You’ll Do Manage financial accounting, reporting, and support consolidation activities for multiple global entities while ensuring timely and accurate closures.  Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes including preparation and review of financial statements, schedules, and disclosures.  Drive MIS-to-financial statement reconciliations to ensure accuracy and consistency across group reporting.  Support revenue assurance for the core business by validating revenue reporting, reconciliations, and maintaining proper audit-ready documentation.  Work closely with auditors, tax consultants, and regulators to ensure compliance with IGAAP/Ind AS, IFRS, Companies Act, and other applicable requirements.  Improve finance processes, internal controls, and reporting frameworks to build scalable and efficient operations.  Lead finance automation and ERP enhancement initiatives, including Oracle NetSuite optimization and reporting improvements.  Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Tax, and Operations on business and regulatory initiatives.  Assist in preparing quarterly employee engagement and spend reports for business unit heads to provide visibility into budget utilization. 
 You’ll Excel in This Role If You Think like an owner and operate with high accountability in fast-moving environments.  Thrive in ambiguity and can bring structure to complex operational and accounting challenges.  Have strong technical depth across financial reporting, audits, and compliance frameworks.  Bring exceptional attention to detail while balancing speed, accuracy, and execution.  Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across business, finance, and technology teams.  Continuously look for opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve systems and workflows.  Are comfortable working in high-growth environments where priorities evolve rapidly. 
 You’ll Know You’re Winning When Financial close processes are running smoothly with timely and accurate reporting across entities.  MIS and financial statement reconciliations are consistent, reliable, and provide clear visibility to leadership.  Revenue assurance processes are strengthened with minimal reconciliation gaps and audit-ready documentation always available.  Audit cycles are completed efficiently with reduced observations and stronger compliance readiness.  Finance processes and reporting workflows are becoming more automated, scalable, and operationally efficient.  Cross-functional stakeholders rely on you for accurate reporting, timely insights, and dependable execution.  ERP and reporting enhancements are improving data accuracy, turnaround time, and overall finance productivity. 
 Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You This is an opportunity to be part of the finance function at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech and crypto platforms. You’ll work on high-impact areas such as VDA accounting, revenue assurance, global reporting, and finance automation while partnering closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. It’s a chance to solve complex finance challenges at scale and contribute to building the future of digital finance. 
 Hiring Process Here’s what your journey with us looks like: Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving Assignment / Simulation Round – (If Required) A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios (If Required) Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit 
 Where We Work We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office , where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time. 
 Perks That Empower You We believe great people deserve great experiences. Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities 
 Ready to Build What’s Next? If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Finance Manager - Shared Services,  Pune
description:
Position Title 
 Finance Manager Shared Services (Pune) Department 
 Financial Control Reporting Line 
 Head of Shared Services/Country Head Direct Reports 
 AP/AR Manager Location 
 Pune DBG HEALTH PURPOSE 
 Our vision at DBG Health is to enhance the health and well-being of all patients and consumers, by providing affordable access to health, wellness, and beauty products that improve the quality of their lives. 
 DBG HEALTH VALUES 
 All employees are expected to demonstrate the DBG Health PACT Values of Pioneering , Accountability , Collaboration and Tenacity when carrying out the accountabilities and responsibilities of their role. Further details about DBG Health PACT Values and Behaviours can be found on People Hub. 
 POSITION PURPOSE 
 The Finance Manager Shared Services (Pune) is responsible for the day-to-day leadership and delivery of the Pune Finance Shared Services team, ensuring AP and AR activities are executed accurately, efficiently and within agreed service levels. The role will manage daily priorities, workload and performance across the Pune team, while building capability, accountability and a high-performance culture. The role will work closely with the Head of Shared Services to continuously improve processes, strengthen controls and ensure consistent service delivery to the Group 
 ACCOUNTABILITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Finance Operations & Daily Execution - Role - 25% 
 Lead the day-to-day operation of the Pune AP and AR function, ensuring all activities are completed accurately, efficiently and within agreed timelines. Set and manage daily priorities across the team, ensuring critical activities, deadlines and stakeholder requirements are clearly understood and delivered. Monitor workload and capacity across the team and appropriately allocate work to ensure balanced and effective execution. Maintain strong oversight of AP and AR processing, including invoice processing, payments, collections, reconciliations, settlements and other transactional finance activities. Ensure month-end activities are completed accurately and on time, with appropriate preparation and planning across the team. Proactively identify operational issues, bottlenecks and risks and take action to resolve them before they impact service delivery. Act as the key escalation point for complex operational matters within the Pune Shared Services team. Ensure high standards of accuracy, timeliness and customer service are maintained every day. 2. Team Leadership & Capability - Role 25% 
 Lead, manage and develop the Pune Shared Services team of approximately 12 AP and AR team members. Establish clear expectations around performance, accountability, quality and service delivery. Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews to ensure priorities, issues and expectations are understood. Develop team capability through coaching, training, knowledge sharing and on-the-job development. Identify capability gaps and implement appropriate development plans to build a strong and sustainable team. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and customer focus. Identify and develop high-performing team members and support succession planning within the Pune function. Manage performance issues proactively and in accordance with company policies and processes. Build strong engagement across the Pune team and create an environment where team members understand how their work contributes to the broader Finance function. 3. Financial Controls, Quality & Compliance - Role 25% 
 Ensure AP and AR activities are completed in accordance with Group policies, procedures, controls and accounting requirements. Maintain strong oversight of transactional controls and ensure appropriate segregation of duties and approval processes are followed. Review and monitor reconciliations, exception reports and other key control activities. Identify control weaknesses, recurring errors and process risks and implement appropriate corrective actions. Ensure audit requests and supporting documentation are completed accurately and within required timeframes. Work closely with Financial Control and other Finance stakeholders to resolve accounting, reconciliation and transactional issues. Ensure a strong control and compliance mindset is embedded within the Pune team. 4. Continuous Improvement & Efficiency - Role 10% Work closely with the Head of Shared Services and Continuous Improvement & Efficiency Lead to identify and implement process improvements.
 • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processing, improve productivity, eliminate duplication and simplify ways of working.
 • Support the implementation of automation, system enhancements and standardised processes across the Pune team.
 • Ensure process improvements are effectively implemented and embedded into BAU operations.
 • Encourage team members to identify and raise opportunities for improvement.
 • Monitor the impact of process improvements on productivity, quality and service delivery. 
 5. Stakeholder Management & Service Delivery - Role 10% 
 Build strong working relationships with Australian Finance teams and key business stakeholders.
 • Act as a key point of contact between the Pune Shared Services team and onshore Finance stakeholders.
 • Ensure stakeholder requests and escalations are appropriately prioritised and resolved.
 • Communicate proactively where deadlines, service levels or deliverables may be impacted.
 • Establish a strong customer service mindset within the Pune team.
 • Support the Head of Shared Services and AP/AR Manager in monitoring service levels and identifying opportunities to improve the Finance customer experience. 
 6. Engagement / Health, Safety and Wellbeing - Role - 5% 

 Adhere to and undertake duties in accordance with DBG Health's Health, Safety and Wellbeing policies, procedures and systems.
 • Act as an influential leader and business partner, collaborating across functions and constructively challenging existing practices to deliver better outcomes.
 • Lead by example and contribute to a positive, inclusive and high-performing team environment.
 • Embrace change and demonstrate agility when working through ambiguity and competing priorities.
 • Build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
 • Ensure confidentiality is respected and maintained at all times.
 • Participate in health and safety training and comply with relevant workplace safety requirements.
 • Identify and report hazards and incidents in accordance with DBG Health policies and procedures. 

 POSITION REQUIREMENTS Skills and Knowledge 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. Strong technical accounting knowledge and understanding of financial controls. Demonstrated ability to manage daily finance operations in a high-volume Shared Services environment. Strong ability to prioritise competing workloads and ensure critical deadlines are consistently met. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve operational issues. Strong people leadership and team management capability. Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and motivate a team. Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly across offshore/nearshore and onshore operating environments. Ability to work effectively with senior Finance stakeholders and communicate complex issues clearly. Strong understanding of month-end finance processes and transactional controls. Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify and implement process efficiencies. Strong systems aptitude and experience working with ERP and finance systems. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to analyse data, identify trends and develop reporting. Strong Microsoft Office 365 capability. 

 Desirable 
 Experience with Business Central, NetSuite or other ERP platforms. Experience working with offshore or nearshore Shared Services models. Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or other reporting and automation tools. 
 Experience 
 Minimum 7-10 years' experience in finance, accounting or Shared Services, including significant experience in AP and/or AR. Demonstrated experience managing a finance team and delivering high-quality operational outcomes. Proven experience leading a team in a high-volume, deadline-driven finance environment. Demonstrated experience managing month-end and other critical finance deadlines. Experience working with Australian or multinational Finance teams desirable. Proven ability to manage competing priorities and maintain high standards of execution. Demonstrated experience implementing process improvements and driving operational efficiencies. Experience managing performance, developing team capability and building high-performing teams. Ability to operate autonomously while maintaining strong alignment with the broader Finance leadership team. Strong commercial and service-oriented mindset. 
 Qualifications 
 CA qualified required. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or related discipline Licences 
 N/A Travel 
 Domestic and international travel as required. KEY RELATIONSHIPS / STAKEHOLDERS Internal Stakeholders 
 Chief Financial Officer / Executive Finance Leadership Financial Control Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Tax Treasury Head of Shared Services Shared Services Continuous Improvement & Efficiency Lead Finance Shared Services Team Pune Finance Business Partners IT / ERP Team Supply Chain Australian Finance Teams People, Performance & Culture 
 External Stakeholders 
 External auditors External advisors and consultants 

 DECISION MAKING Decisions this role makes alone 
 Determine and allocate the daily workload and priorities across the Pune Shared Services team. Determine appropriate operational responses to routine AP and AR issues. Manage team performance, coaching, development and day-to-day people matters within delegated authority. Determine the appropriate approach to resolving routine stakeholder and transactional issues. Implement approved process improvements and changes within the Pune team. Prioritise resources to ensure critical Finance deadlines and service levels are achieved. 
 Decisions this role makes under guidance 
 Significant changes to AP or AR processes, controls or operating procedures. Changes that may materially impact financial reporting or Group Finance policies. Significant system changes or automation initiatives. Material changes to team structure, capability or resourcing. Complex accounting matters requiring technical finance input. Decisions this role escalates 
 Material financial, operational, compliance or control risks. Significant or recurring service delivery failures. Material issues impacting month-end close or financial reporting. Significant people or performance matters requiring escalation. Issues that cannot be resolved within the Pune team or require intervention from the Head of Shared Services or broader Finance leadership. Any matter that may have a material impact on the financial performance, reputation, legal compliance or strategic objectives of DBG Health. Direct financial accountability 
 N/A

 Work Schedule: This is a 24/7 on-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week  
 Training & Assessment Requirement 
Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicable. 
 Role Description/Purpose The Delivery Manager Operations is responsible for leading and managing end-to-end Finance Operations service delivery to ensure it is efficient, scalable, and consistently meets business and customer expectations. The role focuses on designing and implementing robust service delivery frameworks, including workforce planning, utilisation, and process optimisation, while ensuring adherence to defined service level agreements and quality standards. It plays a critical role in driving continuous improvement, standardisation, and operational excellence across shared services, while proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure business continuity. The role also ensures strong governance, reporting, and compliance practices, enabling reliable and high-quality outcomes for stakeholders and customers in a global operating environment. 
 Qualifications & Experience Graduation in Commerce Written and verbal proficiency in English (British Council systems and global processes operate in English) 7+ years of experience in Finance Operations (O2C / R2R) / Shared Services 4+ years of people management experience Strong understanding of finance governance and controls Experience in reporting, dashboards, and MIS Experience in operational delivery in a global/shared services environment Strong understanding of Finance Operations & Shared Services delivery Expertise in financial governance and compliance frameworks Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills Desirable: Lean / Six Sigma certification Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.) Experience in transitions / migrations Exposure to global capability centres 
 Role Accountabilities The role operates within the English & Examinations business, a key strategic and revenue-generating unit of the organisation, delivering services across a global network of over 100 countries. It functions in a shared services environment that supports multi-country operations, requiring high levels of standardisation, automation, and efficiency in processes. The Delivery Manager must balance ongoing service delivery with transformation and digital initiatives in a cost-conscious and resource-constrained setting, working closely with global and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment with business priorities, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements, while maintaining uninterrupted service delivery. 
 You will lead end-to-end delivery of Finance Operations services, defining and implementing service delivery frameworks covering staffing, scheduling and utilisation, and ensuring SLA compliance and high-quality customer interactions. title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About the Role: " We are looking for a highly analytical, collaborative, and results-driven Supply Chain Planning & Strategic Operations to lead our end-to-end supply chain transformation. This role sits at the intersection of global demand-supply balancing, strategic sourcing, and digital supply chain innovation. The ideal candidate will manage cross-functional Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), optimize multi-million dollar direct material/CAPEX spend portfolios, and orchestrate agile distribution networks (DRP) to ensure exceptional service levels. You will act as a core business driver leveraging advanced predictive analytics, enterprise platforms, and lean frameworks to eliminate structural inefficiencies." 
 Key Responsibilities: Integrated Business Planning & S&OP: Lead consensus Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and demand forecasting cycles across multi-plant environments to align commercial forecasts with plant capacities. Inventory Optimization: Monitor and improve key performance indicators including Case Fill Rate (CFR), On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery, and Days of Cover (DOC). Manage safety stocks and Slow-Moving/Obsolete (SLOB) inventory liquidation frameworks. Strategic Sourcing & Category Operations: Oversee an annual direct material and CAPEX sourcing spend portfolio valued up to USD 50M-60M. Lead contract negotiations, Annual Rate Contracts (ARCs), and Maintenance Commitments (AMCs) with global suppliers (Americas, APAC, EMEA). Network Logistics & DRP: Refine node-level Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) configurations, focusing on Full Truck Load (FTL) thresholds, mode-mix optimization, and shipment consolidation. Digital Transformation: Act as the business system owner/SPOC for advanced planning software and business intelligence implementation. Build and scale data-driven Power BI or Tableau dashboards to automate reporting. Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement across the department by anchoring 5S audits, Kaizen loops, Lean Six Sigma workflows, and strict quality compliance. 
 Desired Candidate Profile: Education: Bachelors degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Computer Science). A Masters degree (MBA/PGDM) specializing in Operations, Supply Chain Management, or Project Management is highly preferred. Experience: 8–12 years of core experience in manufacturing, FMCG, retail supply networks, aerospace, or automotive/heavy engineering sectors. ERP & Sourcing Stack (Mandatory proficiency in one or more): ERP modules: SAP MM, SAP PP, SAP SD, SAP ECC, or SAP Hana. Sourcing/Planning Suites: SAP Ariba, o9 Planning Suite, SAP APO, Palantir Foundry, OMP Planning Software, or Infor M3. Analytics: Advanced MS Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or QlikView. 
 Certifications (Preferred): Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, IATF 16949 / ISO Quality Auditor, or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) credential. Key Competencies: High analytical acumen, strong negotiation and cross-functional communication skills, and data-driven problem-solving mindset.

 We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven General Manager – Purchase with strong expertise in Plastic Injection Molding and Plastic Raw Materials . 
 The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing the organisation’s procurement and sourcing strategy, managing strategic suppliers, driving cost optimisation, developing new vendors, supporting localisation initiatives, and managing both domestic and international sourcing/imports . 
 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of engineering plastics, commodity plastics, additives, masterbatches and other raw materials used in plastic injection molding , along with excellent negotiation and supplier management capabilities. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Strategic Sourcing Develop and implement strategic sourcing strategies for plastic raw materials, components and indirect materials. Identify and evaluate new domestic and international suppliers. Drive supplier consolidation and category management initiatives. Develop long-term sourcing strategies aligned with business requirements. Monitor commodity and raw-material price movements and market trends. 
 2. Plastic Raw Material Procurement 
 Strong understanding of PP, ABS, PC, PA, POM, PBT, PMMA, HDPE, LDPE, Nylon, TPE/TPU and engineering polymers . Knowledge of recycled and virgin plastic materials and their commercial implications. Evaluate material specifications, grades, applications and alternate sources. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, MOQ, lead times and commercial agreements. 
 3. Imports & International Sourcing 
 Manage sourcing and procurement from international suppliers. Strong understanding of import procurement processes, documentation, logistics and landed-cost calculations. Develop overseas supplier networks for plastics and related materials. Evaluate international suppliers based on quality, cost, capacity and delivery performance. Work closely with logistics and finance teams to optimise import costs. 
 4. Costing & Cost Optimisation 
 Develop and validate product and raw-material costing. Analyse should-cost, conversion cost, material cost and landed cost . Drive annual cost-reduction initiatives. Identify alternate materials, suppliers and processes to improve margins. Conduct price benchmarking and market intelligence. Negotiate annual rate contracts and long-term commercial agreements. 
 5. Localisation 
 Develop and execute localisation strategies for imported materials/components. Identify capable Indian suppliers for localisation opportunities. Conduct commercial and capability assessments of potential suppliers. Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Production teams for localisation trials. Reduce dependency on imports while maintaining quality and cost competitiveness. 
 6. Supplier Development & Vendor Development 
 Identify, qualify and develop new suppliers. Build a strong and reliable supplier base for critical materials. Monitor supplier performance in terms of Quality, Cost, Delivery and Service . Conduct supplier evaluations, audits and performance reviews. Work with suppliers to improve capacity, quality and delivery performance. Develop alternate sources for critical materials to minimise supply-chain risks. 
 7. Purchase Operations 
 Lead the complete procurement function and ensure uninterrupted availability of materials. Establish appropriate inventory and procurement strategies. Develop annual procurement budgets and monitor procurement spend. Ensure timely release and closure of purchase orders. Establish and monitor procurement KPIs. 
 8. Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Work closely with Production, Quality, R&D, Engineering, Finance, Stores and Logistics . Support new product development through early supplier involvement. Participate in supplier selection and commercial evaluation for new projects. Ensure procurement decisions support production, quality and profitability objectives. 
 Key Skills Required 
 Strategic Sourcing Plastic Raw Material Procurement Plastic Injection Molding Industry Experience International Sourcing & Imports Localisation Costing & Cost Reduction Supplier Development Vendor Development Price Negotiation Commodity & Market Analysis Supplier Evaluation Contract & Commercial Management Procurement Planning Inventory Management Team Leadership 
 Educational Qualification 
 BE/B.Tech/Diploma in Mechanical, Polymer, Plastics, Production, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Procurement or Operations will be an added advantage. 
 Preferred Industry Background 
 Candidates from the following industries are preferred: 
 Plastic Injection Molding Automotive Plastics Engineering Plastics Polymer / Plastic Processing Automotive Components Polymer Compounding Plastic Raw Materials Consumer Durables Industrial Plastics 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be a strategic procurement leader who combines strong technical knowledge of plastics with excellent commercial and negotiation skills. 
 The candidate should have a proven track record of: 
 Managing significant procurement spends. Developing domestic and international suppliers. Driving localisation of imported materials/components. Achieving measurable cost savings. Building strategic supplier partnerships. Managing plastic raw-material sourcing. Leading and developing a purchase/vendor-development team.

We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager – Purchase / Procurement who can independently manage procurement activities and develop a strong vendor network across Delhi-NCR , particularly for electronic components, electrical items, hardware, sanitary components, packaging materials and other production-related requirements. Job Summary The Assistant Manager – Purchase will be responsible for end-to-end procurement activities , including vendor identification, market sourcing, price negotiation, purchase orders, supplier development, delivery follow-up and coordination with Production, Stores, Quality, Accounts and other departments. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Delhi-NCR markets and vendors , including Chawri Bazar and other major Delhi markets , and should be capable of sourcing materials at competitive prices while maintaining required quality and delivery timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Purchase & Procurement Handle day-to-day procurement activities for electronic, electrical, sensor, sanitary, hardware, packaging and production-related materials . Review purchase requisitions from Production, Stores, R&D, Service and other departments. Identify suitable suppliers and obtain quotations based on material specifications and requirements. Compare quotations, negotiate prices and finalize commercial terms. Prepare and release Purchase Orders as per approved requirements and company policies. Ensure timely procurement of materials to support uninterrupted production. 2. Vendor Development & Management Identify, evaluate and develop new vendors across Delhi-NCR . Maintain a strong network of local suppliers, particularly in Delhi markets such as Chawri Bazar and other relevant industrial/electronic markets . Develop alternative sources for critical and frequently used materials. Negotiate prices, credit terms, delivery schedules, minimum order quantities and other commercial conditions. Maintain long-term professional relationships with reliable suppliers. Monitor vendor performance regarding price, quality, delivery and service . Resolve vendor-related issues and coordinate corrective actions where required. 3. Market Sourcing & Negotiation Conduct regular market visits and supplier interactions to understand current market prices and availability. Maintain updated knowledge of electronic components, electrical items, sensors, cables, connectors, PCB-related materials, hardware, sanitary components and other manufacturing materials . Negotiate aggressively but professionally to achieve cost savings and competitive procurement rates . Verify market rates through multiple suppliers before finalizing major purchases. Identify opportunities for cost reduction and supplier consolidation. 4. Production & Material Coordination Coordinate closely with Production and Stores to understand material requirements and delivery priorities. Ensure critical production materials are available on time. Follow up with suppliers for pending orders and committed delivery dates. title: Manager / Sr Manager  MIS and Business Intelligence
description:
Position Manager/Senior Manager Department MIS and Business Intelligence Location Noida, UP 
 Job Summary Ledure Lightings Limited is looking for an experienced MIS professional to lead the transition of the MIS function from routine, transaction-level report generation to a strategic Management Information & Business Intelligence function. The incumbent will design and own dashboards, KPI scorecards, and decision-support reporting that give Directors and senior leadership real-time, actionable visibility into the business — enabling faster and better-informed business calls across sales, production, quality, supply chain, and finance. 

 Company Overview A fast-growing, Made-in-India company shaping the future of the LED lighting and electrical solutions industry. With over a decade of industry experience, Its offers 1000+ product categories across residential, commercial, and industrial applications, supported by a state-of-the-art 2,00,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Noida and a strong network of 12,000+ retailers across India. Our portfolio extends beyond lighting to include wires & cables, modular switches, switchgears, water heaters, and electrical accessories, enabling us to provide a complete electrical ecosystem to our customers. At Company, innovation, quality, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. Our in-house R&D capabilities and NABL-accredited laboratory ensure that our products are rigorously tested and developed in line with leading industry standards, including BIS, ISO, and RoHS. Our strong industry presence is reflected in approvals from 10 Maharatna and 9 Navratna organizations, along with partnerships with leading organizations such as ONGC, HPCL, NTPC, Indian Oil, Huawei, Tata Projects, and OYO. 
 Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end evolution of the MIS function from “data reporting” to “management information” — shifting the team’s output from static reports to insight-driven decision support. Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards (Power BI / Excel / equivalent) that consolidate data from ERP, production, quality, sales, and supply-chain systems into a single, reliable view. Partner directly with Directors and functional heads to understand the business questions behind each request, and translate them into the right metrics, cuts, and visualizations. Develop and maintain KPI scorecards across Sales, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and HR, aligned with the organization’s KRA/KPI and incentive frameworks. Drive trend and variance analysis — sales vs. forecast, OEE and rejection trends, inventory ageing, SKU classification (Runner / Repeater / Stranger), and working-capital indicators — and proactively flag risks and opportunities to leadership. Automate recurring MIS reports and eliminate manual, Excel-heavy compilation; standardize data definitions, formats, and refresh cycles across departments. Establish data-governance practices — a single source of truth, data validation checks, and clear ownership — so leadership can trust every number in the dashboard. Prepare and present monthly/quarterly business review packs to Directors and senior leadership, with clear narrative, insight, and recommended actions — not just data. Evaluate and recommend upgrades to BI tools, reporting infrastructure, and automation (e.g., Power BI, Power Query, ERP reporting modules) as the business scales. Act as a cross-functional bridge — working closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Finance, and HR to source data and understand the operational context behind it. 
 Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Commerce, or a related field; MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred. 8–12 years of progressive experience in MIS, Business Analytics, or Business Intelligence roles, including at least 2–3 years managing a team or reporting function. Manufacturing, FMEG, or electrical/electronics industry background strongly preferred. Advanced Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, macros) and hands-on expertise with Power BI, Tableau, or an equivalent BI/visualization tool. Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts; exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) for data extraction and reporting. Demonstrated experience building dashboards and scorecards used directly by senior leadership for decision-making.

title: Store Keeper / Store & Dispatch Executive _ Construction Materials
description:
Job Summary Anagha Buildtech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a responsible and organized Store Keeper / Store & Dispatch Executive to manage our physical shop and support our growing e-commerce business dealing with waterproofing products, construction chemicals and building materials . The candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day operation of the store, receiving materials, checking incoming stock, proper storage, inventory management, picking and packing customer orders, and dispatching materials . Candidates with previous experience as a Store Keeper, Shop Keeper, Warehouse Executive, Store Executive or Dispatch Executive will be preferred. 
 Role & Responsibilities Shop & Store Management Manage the day-to-day operations of the physical shop/store. Keep the shop and storage area clean, organized and properly maintained. Receive materials from suppliers and verify quantities against invoices/delivery challans. Check products for damage, leakage, shortage or incorrect items at the time of receipt. Properly arrange and store products according to brand, product category, SKU and stock requirements . Maintain proper stock records for all materials. Ensure products are stored safely and appropriately. Monitor fast-moving and slow-moving products. Inform management about low-stock items and material requirements. 
 Inventory Management Maintain accurate physical and system stock . Conduct regular physical stock verification. Identify stock differences and report discrepancies immediately. Maintain records of material received, issued, sold and dispatched. Monitor product expiry dates wherever applicable. Follow FIFO / FEFO principles where applicable to the product. Assist in periodic stock audits. Ensure proper handling of construction chemicals and other materials. Supplier & Material Coordination Coordinate with suppliers for material deliveries. Receive and verify incoming materials. Maintain purchase and inward material records. Report shortages, damages or incorrect deliveries to management. Assist in loading and unloading materials where required. Coordinate with transporters and delivery personnel. Customer & Shop Support Attend customers visiting the physical shop professionally. Assist customers in locating products and basic product information. Prepare materials for customer pickup. Coordinate local deliveries as instructed. Maintain proper documentation for shop sales and material movement. Daily Reporting Maintain daily inward and outward stock records. Prepare daily dispatch and order status reports. Maintain stock registers and supporting documents. Report damaged, missing or slow-moving stock. Inform management about urgent orders, stock shortages and dispatch issues. Preferred Candidate Profile Previous experience as a Store Keeper / Shop Keeper / Store Executive / Warehouse Executive / Dispatch Executive is preferred. Experience in a hardware shop, construction material shop, building material store, electrical/plumbing store or construction chemicals business will be an added advantage. Minimum 14 years of relevant experience preferred. Should have basic knowledge of inventory and stock management . Should be comfortable using a computer/mobile phone for order and stock updates. Basic knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets is preferred. Experience with Shopify, e-commerce order processing or inventory software will be an advantage. Should be physically capable of handling and moving construction material as required. Good numerical and counting skills. Should be honest, responsible and highly organized. Good communication and customer-handling skills. Should be able to work independently and take responsibility for the store. Key Skills Store Management | Store Keeping | Inventory Management | Stock Management | Material Receiving | Material Dispatch | Order Processing | Packing | E-commerce Operations | Warehouse Management | Shop Management | Stock Verification | Logistics Coordination | Excel | Customer Handling Added Advantage Experience with: Construction Materials | Waterproofing Products | Construction Chemicals | Hardware Materials | Shopify | E-commerce | Inventory Software | Billing Software | Courier/Logistics Platforms

Key Skills: Store Keeping,Store Management,Stores Maintenance,Dispatch,Management,Maintenance,Construction,Stores

 The Customer Experience team at Navi is at the forefront of delivering a seamless,

 with empathy and efficiency. Using channels like chat, calls, and email, we aim for rapid

 automation and data insights to scale service quality as we grow. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Executive to manage customer 
 interactions across calls, emails, and chats. You will be the first point of contact for Navi 
 customers, responsible for delivering accurate, empathetic, and timely support. The role 
 requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to ensuring 
 high levels of customer satisfaction across all touchpoints.

 Handle customer queries through inbound/outbound calls, emails, and live chat. 
 Provide clear, accurate information about our products and services.

 closure.

 peak periods.

 that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services 
 across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI.

 Our Culture

 quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to 
 solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an 
 environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating 
 learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether youre shaping the future of 
 fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part 
 of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a 
 difference. 
 
 
 
 Were guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that 
 shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values 
 to see what drives us every day.

description:
Role Overview We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic & Presentation Design Intern to support marketing graphics, social media, event collateral, PowerPoint presentations, leadership decks, and internal communications. The intern will translate briefs and complex information into clear, engaging, brand-aligned visual communication while using AI-assisted workflows to improve ideation, productivity, and creative quality. Key Responsibilities Design social media, marketing campaign, digital, and event assets, including posts, banners, posters, standees, backdrops, digital screens, invitations, and signage. Create and enhance PowerPoint presentations for Marketing, Sales, Leadership, and other teams, including pitch decks, proposals, reports, and reusable templates. Turn text-heavy or complex information into clear slides using infographics, charts, diagrams, timelines, and other visual storytelling techniques. Create internal communication assets and adapt approved designs across digital, print, and presentation formats. Maintain brand consistency and quality across typography, layout, imagery, alignment, spacing, and final production files. Collaborate with the Creative Director and stakeholders to understand objectives, incorporate feedback, and deliver requirements on time. Use AI-assisted design tools for concept generation, image creation or editing, background removal, resizing, design variations, and rapid visual prototyping, with human review and brand control. Maintain reusable presentation templates, slide libraries, and organized creative assets for efficient reuse. Stay current with graphic design, presentation design, social media, and emerging AI creative tools and workflows. Skills & Qualifications Strong working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint, with working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma. Good understanding of typography, layout, composition, grids, color theory, visual hierarchy, and information design. Ability to create charts, diagrams, infographics, business visuals, social creatives, and professional presentation layouts. Familiarity with social media formats, corporate presentation design, internal communications, and basic print production. Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and presentation tools and prompt-based workflows is an advantage. A relevant portfolio is preferred; a degree or certification in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred. Core Competencies Good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to understand concepts, briefs, and requirements quickly. Eagerness to learn new tools, technologies, and creative techniques. Open to feedback and able to incorporate changes effectively. Strong attention to detail and quality. Ability to manage multiple requirements and meet deadlines. Collaborative, proactive, and adaptable approach to working within a creative team.
